cab.definition: n. a compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits\nn. small two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage; with two seats and a folding hood\nn. a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
cab.translation: n. 出租车, 出租汽车, 出租马车\nvi. 乘出租马车(或汽车)

examples.en: I took a cab to the station.
examples.zh: 我搭了计程车到车站。

examples.en: I left my umbrella in the cab.
examples.zh: 我把我的伞忘在计程车上了。

examples.en: She went to the museum by cab.
examples.zh: 她搭计程车到博物馆。

cabbage.definition: n. any of various types of cabbage\nn. any of various cultivars of the genus Brassica oleracea grown for their edible leaves or flowers
cabbage.translation: n. 卷心菜\n[医] 卷心菜, 甘兰

examples.en: There is a saying: cabbage soup and porridge are our food.
examples.zh: 俗话说：高丽菜汤和粥是我们的食物。

examples.en: "What do we want to eat today?" "How about cabbage rolls?"
examples.zh: 「今天吃什么？」「卷心菜卷怎么样？」

examples.en: At Christmas, one eats roast goose, red cabbage, and wheat buns.
examples.zh: 圣诞节时，人们会吃烤鹅、红甘蓝和小麦面包。

cabin.definition:
n. small room on a ship or boat where people sleep
n. a small house built of wood; usually in a wooded area
n. the enclosed compartment of an aircraft or spacecraft where passengers are carried
v. confine to a small space, such as a cabin
cabin.translation: n. 小屋, 客舱\nvt. 关在小屋

examples.en: The writer is living in a log cabin.
examples.zh: 那个作家生活在小木屋中。

examples.en: He built a cabin on the beach.
examples.zh: 他在沙滩上建了座小屋。

examples.en: The little cabin was bathed in moonlight.
examples.zh: 小木屋沐浴在月光之中。

cabinet.definition:
n. a piece of furniture resembling a cupboard with doors and shelves and drawers; for storage or display
n. persons appointed by a head of state to head executive departments of government and act as official advisers
n. a storage compartment for clothes and valuables; usually it has a lock
n. housing for electronic instruments, as radio or television
cabinet.translation: n. 橱柜, 内阁\na. 内阁的, 细木工做的\n[计] 机柜

examples.en: The book fell from the cabinet.
examples.zh: 书从柜子上掉下来。

examples.en: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.
examples.zh: 桌布在橱柜里。

cable.definition:
n. a telegram sent abroad
n. a conductor for transmitting electrical or optical signals or electric power
n. a very strong thick rope made of twisted hemp or steel wire
n. a nautical unit of depth
cable.translation:
n. 电缆, 海底电报, 缆, 索
vi. 打海底电报
vt. 发海底电报, 缚住
[计] 电缆

examples.en: Unplug all the cables.
examples.zh: 拔下所有的电缆。

cafe.definition: n. a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold

examples.en: I had a cup of coffee at the cafe.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡店里喝了一杯咖啡。

examples.en: Tom left the cafe in front of Maria.
examples.zh: 汤姆离开了玛丽面前的那家咖啡馆。

examples.en: Gunter and Rima met at the cafe.
examples.zh: Gunter和Rima在咖啡馆见过面。

cage.definition:
n. an enclosure made or wire or metal bars in which birds or animals can be kept
n. something that restricts freedom as a cage restricts movement
n. United States composer of avant-garde music (1912-1992)
n. the net that is the goal in ice hockey
cage.translation: n. 笼, 牢房, 战俘营\nvt. 关进笼内

examples.en: He thought that it was like a bird cage.
examples.zh: 他觉得这像个鸟笼。

examples.en: The tiger laid in the middle of the cage.
examples.zh: 老虎躺在笼子的中间。

examples.en: She set the bird free from the cage.
examples.zh: 她把小鸟从笼子里释放出来。

cake.definition: n. a block of solid substance (such as soap or wax)\nn. baked goods made from or based on a mixture of flour, sugar, eggs, and fat
cake.translation: n. 蛋糕, 块, 饼\nvt. 使结块, 加块状物于\nvi. 结块

examples.en: This is the best cake that I have ever eaten.
examples.zh: 这是我从来吃过最好吃的蛋糕。

examples.en: To make a cake, you need egg, butter and sugar.
examples.zh: 要做蛋糕，你要用到鸡蛋，黄油和糖。

examples.en: We need flour, sugar and eggs to make this cake.
examples.zh: 我们需要面粉、砂糖和鸡蛋来做这个蛋糕。

calculate.definition: v. make a mathematical calculation or computation\nv. judge to be probable\nv. specifically design a product, event, or activity for a certain public
calculate.translation: v. 计算, 预测, 计划, 打算

examples.en: I cannot calculate this. I am not an engineer.
examples.zh: 我不是工程师，不会算这个。

examples.en: Scientists can easily calculate the distances between planets.
examples.zh: 科学家们可以很容易地计算出行星之间的距离。

examples.en: We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.
examples.zh: 我们估计能在两周内到那个地方。

calculation.definition: n. the procedure of calculating; determining something by mathematical or logical methods\nn. problem solving that involves numbers or quantities\nn. planning something carefully and intentionally
calculation.translation: n. 计算, 考虑, 计算的结果\n[经] 计算

examples.en: According to my calculation, she should be in India by now.
examples.zh: 根据我的估计，她现在应该在印度了。

examples.en: The more precise the calculations, the stronger the friendship.
examples.zh: 算帐愈是精确, 友谊愈是坚定。

examples.en: The calculation of the budget for next year is based on the costs this year.
examples.zh: 明年预算的计算是基于今年的成本的。

calendar.definition:
n. a system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year
n. a list or register of events (appointments or social events or court cases etc)
n. a tabular array of the days (usually for one year)
v. enter into a calendar
calendar.translation: n. 日历, 日程表\nvt. 列入表中\n[计] 日历

examples.en: In China, they celebrate New Year by the lunar calendar.
examples.zh: 中国按阴历过新年。

examples.en: In the Spanish calendar, the week begins with Monday.
examples.zh: 在西班牙日历中，一周的开始是周一。

examples.en: 2010 was the Year of the Tiger in the Chinese lunar calendar.
examples.zh: 2010年是农历的虎年。

call.definition:
n. a telephone connection
n. a special disposition (as if from a divine source) to pursue a particular course
n. a demand especially in the phrase "the call of duty"
n. a brief social visit
call.translation:
n. 呼叫, 访问, 打电话, 号召, 召集, 要求
vt. 呼叫, 召集, 打电话
vi. 叫喊, 访问, 叫牌
[计] 调用; 呼叫; DOS内部命令:在批处理文件中调用另一个批处理文件

examples.en: How come you call on us so late at night?
examples.zh: 你怎么这么晚才来看我们？

examples.en: I'll call as soon as I am at the airport.
examples.zh: 我一到机场就会打电话。

examples.en: I need to make a phone call to my friend.
examples.zh: 我需要打电话给我的朋友。

calm.definition:
v. make calm or still
v. become quiet or calm, especially after a state of agitation
s. not agitated; without losing self-possession
a. (of weather) free from storm or wind
calm.translation:
n. 平稳, 风平浪静
a. 平静的, 冷静的
vi. 平静下来, 镇静
vt. 使平静

examples.en: Calm down, and listen to me speak from the beginning.
examples.zh: 你们冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。

examples.en: I was calm until I saw the syringe.
examples.zh: 看到针管儿之前我一直都很淡定。

examples.en: Calm down and explain it from the beginning.
examples.zh: 你冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。

camera.definition: n. equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)
camera.translation: n. 照相机, 摄影机, 密谈室, 暗箱\n[计] 摄影

examples.en: I lost the camera I had bought the day before.
examples.zh: 我把前一天才买的照相机弄不见了。

examples.en: Would you take a picture of us with this camera?
examples.zh: 你能用这台相机帮我们拍张照吗？

examples.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
examples.zh: 汤姆无论到哪里都带着照相机。

camp.definition:
n. temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
n. a group of people living together in a camp
n. temporary lodgings in the country for travelers or vacationers
n. a penal institution (often for forced labor)
camp.translation: n. 露营, 帐篷\nvi. 露营, 扎营\nvt. 使扎营

examples.en: A small rock was thrown into our camp.
examples.zh: 小石头被丢到我们营地。

examples.en: Tom and Mary said they've only gone camping three times.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽说他们只去过三次露营。

examples.en: The blizzard made it difficult for us to return to the camp.
examples.zh: 暴风雪使得我们难以返回营地。

campaign.definition:
n. a series of actions advancing a principle or tending toward a particular end
n. several related operations aimed at achieving a particular goal (usually within geographical and temporal constraints)
n. an overland journey by hunters (especially in Africa)
v. run, stand, or compete for an office or a position
campaign.translation: n. 战役, 运动, 竞选运动\nvi. 参加运动, 作战

examples.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
examples.zh: 该法案的说客把游说贿款汇入了竞选基金。

examples.en: We started a campaign against smoking.
examples.zh: 我们开始了一个反对吸烟运动。

campus.definition: n. a field on which the buildings of a university are situated
campus.translation: n. 校园, 大学生活

examples.en: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
examples.zh: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

examples.en: We met in a coffee shop near the campus.
examples.zh: 我们在校园附近的咖啡厅碰面。

examples.en: In the center of the university campus stands the statue of the founder.
examples.zh: 创校人的雕像在大学校园的中心矗立著。

can.definition:
n. airtight sealed metal container for food or drink or paint etc.
n. the quantity contained in a can
n. a buoy with a round bottom and conical top
v. preserve in a can or tin
can.translation:
vt. 装罐
n. 罐头, 容器
aux. 能, 可以
[计] 作废字符

examples.en: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.
examples.zh: 他要是成了，我跟你姓。

examples.en: If you can put up with us, put us up.
examples.zh: 如果你能忍受我们.

examples.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.
examples.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。

canal.definition: n. (astronomy) an indistinct surface feature of Mars once thought to be a system of channels; they are now believed to be an optical illusion\nn. long and narrow strip of water made for boats or for irrigation\nv. provide (a city) with a canal
canal.translation: n. 运河, 水道, 管, 沟渠\nvt. 开运河

examples.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
examples.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。

examples.en: The ship went through the Panama Canal.
examples.zh: 这艘船穿过巴拿马运河

examples.en: The ship sailed through the Suez Canal.
examples.zh: 船开过苏伊士运河。

cancel.definition:
v. postpone indefinitely or annul something that was scheduled
v. make up for
v. declare null and void; make ineffective
v. make invalid for use
cancel.translation:
n. 取消, 撤消, 盖销(邮票)
vt. 取消, 删去, 抵销, 盖销
vi. 相互抵销
[计] 作废

examples.en: I had to cancel the order because we didn't have enough money.
examples.zh: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。

examples.en: I should cancel my L.A. trip.
examples.zh: 我应该取消我到洛杉矶的旅行。

examples.en: I should cancel the trip to LA.
examples.zh: 我应该取消我到洛杉矶的旅行。

cancer.definition:
n. any malignant growth or tumor caused by abnormal and uncontrolled cell division; it may spread to other parts of the body through the lymphatic system or the blood stream
n. (astrology) a person who is born while the sun is in Cancer
n. a small zodiacal constellation in the northern hemisphere; between Leo and Gemini
n. the fourth sign of the zodiac; the sun is in this sign from about June 21 to July 22
cancer.translation: n. 癌, 恶性肿瘤\n[医] 癌

examples.en: Scientists have not found a method yet to cure cancer.
examples.zh: 科学家们还没有找到癌症的治疗方法。

examples.en: Many cancer patients lose their hair because of the chemotherapy.
examples.zh: 很多癌症患者都因为化疗而脱发。

examples.en: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
examples.zh: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。

candidate.definition: n. someone who is considered for something (for an office or prize or honor etc.)
candidate.translation: n. 候选人, 投考者\n[法] 候选, 候补者

examples.en: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是，谁也没有投那候选人一票。

examples.en: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
examples.zh: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。

examples.en: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
examples.zh: 我们希望应聘者能有4年工作经验。

candle.definition: n. stick of wax with a wick in the middle\nn. the basic unit of luminous intensity adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites; equal to 1/60 of the luminous intensity per square centimeter of a black body radiating at the temperature of 2,046 degrees Kelvin\nv. examine eggs for freshness by holding them against a light
candle.translation: n. 蜡烛\nvt. 对着光检查

examples.en: A candle without a wick is no candle at all.
examples.zh: 蜡烛没有了芯，就不能算是蜡烛了。

examples.en: There's a red candle on top of the bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 洗手台上有一个红色的蜡烛。

examples.en: The candle went out instead of having been put out.
examples.zh: 蜡烛是自己熄灭的，而不是被扑灭的。

candy.definition: n. a rich sweet made of flavored sugar and often combined with fruit or nuts
candy.translation: n. 糖果, 冰糖\nvt. 用糖煮, 使结晶为砂糖\nvi. 结晶为砂糖

examples.en: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
examples.zh: 我不论甚么时候都不该让汤姆吃那么多糖。

examples.en: My son took a candy from the box.
examples.zh: 我的儿子从盒子里拿了一粒糖。

examples.en: How much candy did you eat last week?
examples.zh: 你上星期吃了多少甜食？

cap.definition:
n. a tight-fitting headdress
n. a top (as for a bottle)
n. something serving as a cover or protection
n. a fruiting structure resembling an umbrella or a cone that forms the top of a stalked fleshy fungus such as a mushroom
cap.translation:
n. 盖子, 帽子
vt. 戴帽子, 覆盖, 胜过
vi. 脱帽致意
[计] 调用程序分析, 容量, 代码分析程序, 计算机辅助生产, 计算机辅助印刷

examples.en: The cap is too small for me.
examples.zh: 这顶帽子对我来说太小了。

examples.en: What is the price of this cap?
examples.zh: 这顶帽子多少钱？

examples.en: I paid ten dollars for this cap.
examples.zh: 我付了十美元买这顶帽子。

capable.definition: a. (usually followed by `of') having capacity or ability\ns. possibly accepting or permitting\na. (followed by `of') having the temperament or inclination for
capable.translation: a. 有能力的, 能的, 能干的

examples.en: This elevator is capable of carrying 10 persons at a time.
examples.zh: 这部电梯一次能运送10个人。

examples.en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
examples.zh: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。

examples.en: It's only the most capable who do the work.
examples.zh: 能者多劳。

capacity.definition:
n. capability to perform or produce
n. the amount that can be contained
n. the maximum production possible
n. a specified function
capacity.translation: n. 容量, 能力, 才能, 资格\n[计] 容量

examples.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
examples.zh: 细胞具有将食物转化为能量的能力。

examples.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
examples.zh: 人类适应环境变化的能力很强。

examples.en: This factory's productive capacity is 250 cars a week.
examples.zh: 这家工厂每周能够生产250台车。

capital.definition:
n. assets available for use in the production of further assets
n. wealth in the form of money or property owned by a person or business and human resources of economic value
n. a seat of government
n. one of the large alphabetic characters used as the first letter in writing or printing proper names and sometimes for emphasis; capitals were kept in the upper half of the type case and so became known as upper-case letters"
capital.translation: n. 首都, 大写字母, 资本\na. 首都的, 重要的

examples.en: The capital of the U.S. is Washington, D.C.
examples.zh: 美国的首都是华盛顿。

examples.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
examples.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

examples.en: My uncle lives in Madrid, the capital of Spain.
examples.zh: 我叔叔住在西班牙的首都马德里。

captain.definition:
n. an officer holding a rank below a major but above a lieutenant
n. the naval officer in command of a military ship
n. a policeman in charge of a precinct
n. the leader of a group of people
captain.translation: n. 船长, 指挥官, 海军上校, 首领\nvt. 率领, 指挥

examples.en: Between you and me, I don't like our new team captain.
examples.zh: 我就只告诉你，我不喜欢我们的新队长。

examples.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
examples.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。

examples.en: When a team makes its entrance, the captain leads the way.
examples.zh: 上场时,队长先上.

capture.definition:
n. the act of forcibly dispossessing an owner of property
n. a process whereby a star or planet holds an object in its gravitational field
n. any process in which an atomic or nuclear system acquires an additional particle
n. the act of taking of a person by force
capture.translation: n. 抓取, 战利品, 捕获之物\nvt. 抓取, 获得, 迷住\n[计] 截获命令

examples.en: To be honest, we came to capture you.
examples.zh: 老实说，我们是来抓你的。

examples.en: They would capture as many people as possible.
examples.zh: 他们会尽可能地抓更多的人。

examples.en: We were never able to capture him.
examples.zh: 我们一直抓不住他。

car.definition:
n. a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine
n. a wheeled vehicle adapted to the rails of railroad
n. the compartment that is suspended from an airship and that carries personnel and the cargo and the power plant
n. where passengers ride up and down
car.translation: n. 汽车, 客车\n[机] 车

examples.en: It is a lot of fun to drive a car.
examples.zh: 开车很好玩。

examples.en: I traded in my old car for a new one.
examples.zh: 我用我的旧车换了一辆新的。

examples.en: That's why I told you not to go by car.
examples.zh: 这就是我叫你别乘车去的原因。

carbon.definition: n. an abundant nonmetallic tetravalent element occurring in three allotropic forms: amorphous carbon and graphite and diamond; occurs in all organic compounds\nn. a copy made with carbon paper
carbon.translation: n. 碳, 副本, 复写纸\n[化] 碳

examples.en: Tom does not know the difference between charcoal and carbon.
examples.zh: Tom不知道碳和煤的差别。

examples.en: He is a carbon copy of his father.
examples.zh: 他是他父亲的翻版。

examples.en: Trees give off oxygen and absorb carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 树木排出氧气，吸收二氧化碳。

card.definition:
n. one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes
n. a card certifying the identity of the bearer
n. a rectangular piece of stiff paper used to send messages (may have printed greetings or pictures)
n. thin cardboard, usually rectangular
card.translation: n. 卡片, 纸牌, 节目单, 明信片, 梳棉机\nvt. 备置卡片, 记于卡片上, 梳理\n[计] 卡片, 卡

examples.en: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?
examples.zh: 你钱或者信用卡带来没有？

examples.en: Julie received a Christmas card from her brother in Italy.
examples.zh: 茱莉的哥哥从意大利寄了一张圣诞贺卡给她。

examples.en: I would like to pay with a credit card.
examples.zh: 我想用信用卡付款。

care.definition:
n. the work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something
n. a cause for feeling concern
n. attention and management implying responsibility for safety
n. activity involved in maintaining something in good working order
care.translation: n. 小心, 照料, 忧虑\nvi. 关心, 介意\nvt. 在意, 喜欢

examples.en: It fell upon me to take care of my mother.
examples.zh: 照顾母亲的责任落在了我身上。

examples.en: Please take care of my dog while I am away.
examples.zh: 麻烦在我离开的时候帮忙照顾我的狗。

examples.en: Who took care of the dog while you were away?
examples.zh: 你不在的时候谁照看狗？

career.definition: n. the particular occupation for which you are trained\nn. the general progression of your working or professional life\nv. move headlong at high speed
career.translation: n. 事业, 生涯, 成功\n[法] 职业, 专业, 履历

examples.en: She wants to go to Beijing to further her career.
examples.zh: 她想去北京发展她的事业。

examples.en: She seems to devote all her effects to her career.
examples.zh: 她似乎把自己所有的精力都投入到了事业上。

examples.en: He always kept an open mind about his future career.
examples.zh: 他一直都对他的未来事业保持着开明的心态。

careful.definition:
a. exercising caution or showing care or attention
s. cautiously attentive
s. unhurried and with care and dignity
s. full of cares or anxiety
careful.translation: a. 小心的, 谨慎的

examples.en: Be careful what you say, Andrea; the walls have ears.
examples.zh: 安德里亚，说话注意点，小心隔墙有耳。

examples.en: You should be more careful with what you speak about.
examples.zh: 你应该更注意你说的话。

examples.en: Be careful when you pass through the street's busy traffic.
examples.zh: 当你穿越交通繁忙的街道时要小心注意。

carpet.definition:

v. form a carpet-like cover (over)
v. cover completely, as if with a carpet
v. cover with a carpet
carpet.translation: n. 地毯, 地毯状物\nvt. 铺以地毯, 铺盖

examples.en: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
examples.zh: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。

examples.en: We must buy a new carpet for this room.
examples.zh: 我们要为这个房间买新地毯。

examples.zh: 这地毯在质量上比那个好得多。

carriage.definition: n. a vehicle with wheels drawn by one or more horses\nn. characteristic way of bearing one's body\nn. a machine part that carries something else

The carriage rolled on, and the peasants resumed their dancing.

carrier.definition:
n. someone whose employment involves carrying something
n. a self-propelled wheeled vehicle designed specifically to carry something
n. an inactive substance that is a vehicle for a radioactive tracer of the same substance and that assists in its recovery after some chemical reaction
n. a person or firm in the business of transporting people or goods or messages
carrier.translation: n. 运送者, 邮递员, 带菌者\n[计] 载波

examples.zh: 邮差来过了吗?

examples.en: China has the means to destroy your aircraft carriers.
examples.zh: 中国有能力摧毁你们的航空母舰。

carrot.definition:
n. deep orange edible root of the cultivated carrot plant
n. perennial plant widely cultivated as an annual in many varieties for its long conical orange edible roots; temperate and tropical regions
n. orange root; important source of carotene
n. promise of reward as in "carrot and stick";
carrot.translation: n. 胡萝卜\n[医] 胡萝卜

examples.zh: 除了胡萝卜，他没有什么是不吃的。

examples.en: In this soup there are carrots, onions, parsley, celery and potatoes.
examples.zh: 这个汤里有胡萝卜、洋葱、欧芹、芹菜和土豆。

examples.en: Daikon might be more expensive than the carrots.
examples.zh: 白萝卜可能比红萝卜贵。

carry.definition:
n. the act of carrying something
v. have with oneself; have on one's person
v. serve as a means for expressing something
v. bear or be able to bear the weight, pressure,or responsibility of
carry.translation:
n. 进位, 射程, 运载
vt. 携带, 运送, 支持, 传送, 包含
vi. 被携带, 能达到

examples.zh: 汤姆每次要是不带地图的话就会迷路。

examples.zh: 为什么小朋友得背这么重的书包呢?

examples.zh: Bob，帮我把他的行李搬到客厅。

cart.definition: n. a heavy open wagon usually having two wheels and drawn by an animal\nv. transport something in a cart
cart.translation: n. 二轮运货马车\nvi. 驾运货马车\nvt. 用车装载

examples.zh: 计划时如果过于谨慎的话，可能会反把计划搞乱。

examples.en: A horse pulled the cart along the road.
examples.zh: 一匹马拉着大车沿着大路走。

examples.en: I saw a horse pulling a cart.
examples.zh: 我看见一匹马拉著一架马车。

carve.definition: v. form by carving\nv. engrave or cut by chipping away at a surface\nv. cut to pieces

examples.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
examples.zh: 这座雕像是由樱木雕刻而成。

examples.en: The boy carved his name on the tree.
examples.zh: 男孩把他的名字刻在树上。

examples.en: The boy carved his name into the tree.
examples.zh: 男孩把他的名字刻在树上。

case.definition:
n. an occurrence of something
n. the actual state of things
n. a portable container for carrying several objects
n. a person requiring professional services
case.translation: n. 情形, 情况, 箱, 容器, 事实, 病例, 案例, 框子\nvt. 装箱, 包盖

examples.en: Such being the case, I can not go with you.
examples.zh: 这样的话我不能和你一起去。

examples.en: She may be late, in which case we will wait.
examples.zh: 她可能迟到，然后我们就要等。

examples.en: In that case, I think you should come in today.
examples.zh: 在这种情况下，我认为你今天应该来。

cash.definition:
n. money in the form of bills or coins
n. prompt payment for goods or services in currency or by check
n. United States country music singer and songwriter (1932-2003)
v. exchange for cash

examples.zh: 我没现金，写张支票可以吗？

examples.en: Did you bring cash or your credit card with you?
examples.zh: 你钱或者信用卡带来没有？

cashier.definition: n. a person responsible for receiving payments for goods and services (as in a shop or restaurant)\nv. discard or do away with\nv. discharge with dishonor, as in the army
cashier.translation: n. 出纳员\n[经] 司库, 出纳员, 收支员

examples.en: Currently, my sister works as a cashier at a supermarket.
examples.zh: 目前，我妹妹在一家超市当收银员。

examples.en: Pay the cashier on the way out.
examples.zh: 在出口处的收银台付款。

examples.en: Mary works as a cashier.

cast.definition:

n. object formed by a mold
cast.translation: n. 演员阵容, 投掷, 铸件, 预测, 特性\nvt. 投, 掷, 抛, 脱落, 铸, 使弯曲, 计算\nvi. 投, 计算, 浇铸成型

examples.en: She cast a shy glance on the young man.
examples.zh: 她羞怯地看了一眼那个年轻人。

examples.en: She cast a shy glance on the youth.
examples.zh: 她羞怯地看了一眼那个年轻人。

castle.definition:
n. a large building formerly occupied by a ruler and fortified against attack
n. (chess) the piece that can move any number of unoccupied squares in a direction parallel to the sides of the chessboard
n. interchanging the positions of the king and a rook
v. move the king two squares toward a rook and in the same move the rook to the square next past the king
castle.translation: n. 城堡, 象棋中的车\nvt. 置于城堡中, 盘踞于

examples.en: The river outside of the castle is called a moat.
examples.zh: 城堡外面的河叫做护城河。

examples.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。

examples.en: When you go to Romania, you will visit Dracula's Castle.
examples.zh: 当你去罗马尼亚的时候，你将会造访吸血鬼之王的城堡。

casual.definition:
s. marked by blithe unconcern
s. without or seeming to be without plan or method; offhand
s. appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
s. occurring or appearing or singled out by chance
casual.translation: a. 偶然的, 不经意的, 便装的\nn. 临时工, 待命士兵

examples.en: This is an error not seen by the casual observer.
Sami was still trying to have casual conversation with Layla.
That topic is too intimate to share with casual acquaintances.

casualty.definition: n. someone injured or killed or captured or missing in a military engagement\nn. someone injured or killed in an accident\nn. a decrease of military personnel or equipment
casualty.translation: n. 意外事故, 伤亡, 受害者\n[化] 事故

Ziri may have been a casualty to the hurricane.
Tom had to go to casualty by ambulance.

cat.definition: n. feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats\nn. a spiteful woman gossip\nv. beat with a cat-o'-nine-tails

vi. 呕吐
计算机辅助教育, 计算机辅助测试, 计算机辅助翻译, 计算机辅助排版

examples.zh: 我们有一只猫。我们都喜欢猫。

examples.zh: 我们弄丢了车，Tom帮我们找了回来。

catalog.definition: n. a book or pamphlet containing an enumeration of things\nn. a complete list of things; usually arranged systematically
catalog.translation: n. 目录, 大学概况手册\nvt. 编目录\n[计] 目录; 编目

Please restrict your orders to what is in our catalog.

catch.definition:

examples.zh: 他把他的书分为五类。

examples.en: He divided his books into five categories.
examples.zh: 他把他的书分为五类。

cater.definition: v. supply food ready to eat; for parties and banquets
cater.translation: v. 提供饮食及服务, 投合, 迎合

examples.zh: 这是一家专门为学生提供服务的商店。

cathedral.definition: n. any large and important church\nn. the principal Christian church building of a bishop's diocese\na. relating to or containing or issuing from a bishop's office or throne

examples.zh: 我和她约了今晚八点半在大教堂见。

cattle.definition: n. domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age
cattle.translation: n. 牛, 家畜\n[法] 家畜

examples.zh: 他们的牛都很肥。

examples.zh: 生日同乐！

examples.zh: 我没请他来参加庆祝会，感到有点内疚。

examples.zh: 风俗习惯包括食物，庆祝和舞蹈。

examples.zh: 我没有我的手机的时候会感到很孤独。

examples.zh: "你有看到我的手机吗?" "它在桌子上。"

examples.zh: 地下室里的信号很差。

examples.zh: 我意识到这个可怕的地下室是唯一可以救我们命的地方。

cement.definition:
n. concrete pavement is sometimes referred to as cement

n. something that hardens to act as adhesive material

examples.zh: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。

examples.zh: 别坐在水泥地上。

examples.zh: 别躺在水泥地上。

census.definition: n. a periodic count of the population\nv. conduct a census
census.translation: n. 户口普查\nvt. 实施统计调查

examples.zh: 根据最新的人口普查，语言的发言人人数好像稳定，或者是甚至在上升。

center.definition: n. an area that is approximately central within some larger region\nn. a building dedicated to a particular activity\nn. a point equidistant from the ends of a line or the extremities of a figure

a. 中央的, 位在正中的
vt. 集中, 定中心
vi. 居中
[计] 居中; 中央

examples.zh: 太阳在太阳系的中心。

examples.zh: 我们学校在市中心。

examples.zh: 图书馆位于城市中心。

examples.zh: 大多数大星系的中心都有一个超大质量黑洞。

examples.zh: 这个计划的主要目的是甚么？

examples.zh: 哈萨克是中亚最大的国家。

examples.zh: 婚礼会在一座十七世纪的教堂里举行。

examples.zh: 典礼结束时，新人接了吻。

examples.zh: 奥运会已经开幕了。

examples.zh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。

a. having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
a. established beyond doubt or question; definitely known

examples.zh: 我不确定他什么时候来。

examples.zh: 谁能赢这场比赛还说不定。

examples.zh: 我们连汤姆会不会出席会议都不知道。

certainly.definition: r definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')

examples.zh: 我当然不想被人看见跟汤姆在一起。

examples.zh: 你已经辛苦地工作好几个月了, 当然可以休假。

n. (business) a number of similar establishments (stores or restaurants or banks or hotels or theaters) under one ownership
chain.translation: n. 链, 枷锁, 束缚\nvt. 用铁练锁住, 束缚, 囚禁

examples.en: Man is born free; and everywhere he is in chains.
examples.zh: 人是生而自由的，但却无往不在枷锁之中。

examples.en: The proletarians lose nothing in this revolution but their chains.
examples.zh: 无产者在这个革命中失去的只是锁链。

examples.en: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
examples.zh: 我们想和一个阿尔及利亚的供应商一起打造一条新的供应链。

chair.definition: n. a seat for one person, with a support for the back\nn. a particular seat in an orchestra\nv. act or preside as chair, as of an academic department in a university
chair.translation: n. 椅子, 显要的席位, 主席\nvt. 使入座, 使就任要职

examples.en: Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?
examples.zh: 猫在椅子上面，还是在椅子下面呢？

examples.en: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
examples.zh: 请把椅子拿走，它挡著道儿了。

examples.en: Betty sat in the chair with her legs crossed.
examples.zh: Betty 翘起双腿，在椅子上坐著。

chairman.definition: n the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization\nv act or preside as chair, as of an academic department in a university
chairman.translation: n. 主席, 会长\n[经] 主席

examples.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
examples.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。

examples.en: They made him the chairman of a club.
examples.zh: 他们选他做俱乐部主席。

examples.en: They made John chairman of the committee.
examples.zh: 他们让约翰做了委员会的主席。

challenge.definition:
n. a demanding or stimulating situation
n. a call to engage in a contest or fight
n. questioning a statement and demanding an explanation
n. a formal objection to the selection of a particular person as a juror
challenge.translation: n. 挑战, 盘问\nvt. 向...挑战, 要求, 怀疑\nvi. 挑战, 对(证据等)表示异议

examples.en: I don't get enough challenge in this job.
examples.zh: 这份工作没什么挑战性。

examples.en: Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
examples.zh: 生命中你无法选择接踵而至的挑战，但是你可以选择不成为一个失败者。

examples.en: The challenge we are going to face is how to increase work efficiency.
examples.zh: 如何提高工作效率是我们现在要面临的难题。

chamber.definition:
n. a natural or artificial enclosed space
n. an enclosed volume in the body
n. a room where a judge transacts business
n. a deliberative or legislative or administrative or judicial assembly
chamber.translation: n. 室, 房间, 枪膛\nvt. 装(弹药), 把...关在室内\na. 室内的

examples.en: In the most secret chamber of the castle lay the greatest treasure on earth—the Book of Truth.
examples.zh: 在城堡最秘密的密室里有全球宝中之宝——《真理经》。

champion.definition:
n. someone who has won first place in a competition
n. someone who fights for a cause
v. protect or fight for as a champion
s. holding first place in a contest
champion.translation: n. 冠军, 拥护者, 战士\nvt. 保卫, 拥护\na. 优胜的

examples.en: Everyone is anxious to know what has become of the former champion.
examples.zh: 大家都渴望知道前冠军得主发生了什么。

examples.en: There can only be one world champion. The question is: Who will it be?
examples.zh: 只有一个人能成为世界冠军。问题是：会是谁呢？

championship.definition: n. the status of being a champion\nn. a competition at which a champion is chosen
championship.translation: n. 冠军身份, 冠军称号, 捍卫

examples.en: I competed with him for the championship.
examples.zh: 我和他竞争冠军。

examples.en: Build your own championship team in a new football management simulation game, launching in early November.
examples.zh: 全新足球经理模拟游戏将于 11 月初推出，邀你打造属于自己的冠军球队。

chance.definition: n. a risk involving danger\nv. be the case by chance
chance.translation: n. 机会, 意外, 可能性\nvi. 偶然发生\nvt. 冒险

examples.en: Give me a chance to make you proud of me.
examples.zh: 给我机会来让你为我感到自豪。

examples.en: I haven't had a chance to see the movie yet.
examples.zh: 我还没有机会看那部电影。

examples.en: Do you really think we have a chance to win?
examples.zh: 你真觉得我们有机会赢吗？

change.definition:
n. an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another
n. a relational difference between states; especially between states before and after some event
n. the action of changing something
n. the result of alteration or modification
change.translation: n. 变化, 找回的零钱, 找头, 更换\nvt. 改变, 更换, 兑换

examples.en: Tom suggested that I change the lock on my door.
examples.zh: 汤姆建议我换我的门锁。

examples.en: The fans all hope the club will change the manager.
examples.zh: 球迷们都希望球队能换个教练。

examples.en: I am convinced that things will change for the better.
examples.zh: 我深信事情会往更好的方向转变。

channel.definition:
n. a path over which electrical signals can pass
n. a passage for water (or other fluids) to flow through
n. a deep and relatively narrow body of water (as in a river or a harbor or a strait linking two larger bodies) that allows the best passage for vessels
n. (often plural) a means of communication or access
channel.translation: n. 海峡, 航道, 频道\nvt. 引导, 在...上挖沟, 形成河道\n[计] 信道, 通道

examples.en: He is the only American who has swum the English Channel.
examples.zh: 他是游过英吉利海峡的唯一一个美国人。

examples.en: Start your own YouTube channel.
examples.zh: 开始你自己的 YouTube 频道。

examples.en: What is on Channel 10?
examples.zh: 第十台在播甚么节目？

chapter.definition:
n. a subdivision of a written work; usually numbered and titled
n. any distinct period in history or in a person's life
n. a local branch of some fraternity or association
n. an ecclesiastical assembly of the monks in a monastery or even of the canons of a church
chapter.translation: n. 章, 篇, 重要章节\n[计] 章; 段

examples.en: You can omit the last chapter of the book.
examples.zh: 你可以删去书里面的最后一章。

examples.en: We will deal with this problem in Chapter Three.
examples.zh: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。

examples.en: This chapter is the heart of the novel.
examples.zh: 这个章节是这部小说的核心。

character.definition:
n. the inherent complex of attributes that determines a persons moral and ethical actions and reactions
n. an actor's portrayal of someone in a play
n. a person of a specified kind (usually with many eccentricities)
n. good repute
character.translation: n. 个性, 字符, 人物, 性质, 品格, 资格\n[计] 字符

examples.en: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.
examples.zh: 他是个性格强、稳定且可靠的男人。

examples.en: Do you think our climate has an influence on our character?
examples.zh: 你觉得气候会不会影响人的性格呢？

examples.en: His failure seems to have something to do with his character.
examples.zh: 看来他的失败和他的性格有关。

characteristic.definition:
n. a distinguishing quality
n. the integer part (positive or negative) of the representation of a logarithm; in the expression log 643 = 2.808 the characteristic is 2
n. any measurable property of a device measured under closely specified conditions
a. typical or distinctive
characteristic.translation: n. 特性, 特征, 特色\na. 特性的, 特有的, 有特色的\n[计] 阶; 指数

examples.en: The aurora is a phenomenon characteristic of the polar regions.
examples.zh: 极光是极地特有的自然现象。

examples.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
examples.zh: 我凭韧性克服了困难。

examples.en: What are the characteristics of this new type of urban life?
examples.zh: 这种新型的城市生活有什么特点？

characterize.translation: vt. 描绘...的特性, 刻划...的性格

examples.en: How would you characterize the economy right now?
He spoke of the three traits that characterized him most.
The US is characterized by some as an international pariah.

charge.definition:
n. an impetuous rush toward someone or something
n. (criminal law) a pleading describing some wrong or offense
n. the price charged for some article or service
n. the quantity of unbalanced electricity in a body (either positive or negative) and construed as an excess or deficiency of electrons
charge.translation: n. 指控, 费用, 冲锋, 电荷, 炸药, 主管, 被托管人, 命令\nvt. 控诉, 加罪于, 使充满, 使充电, 使承担\nvi. 冲锋, 要价, 收费

examples.en: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
examples.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

examples.en: He was in prison on a charge of robbery.
examples.zh: 他以偷窃罪入狱。

examples.en: The charge for a front row seat is 5 dollars.
examples.zh: 第一排的座位5美元。

charity.definition:
n. a foundation created to promote the public good (not for assistance to any particular individuals)
n. a kindly and lenient attitude toward people
n. an activity or gift that benefits the public at large
n. an institution set up to provide help to the needy
charity.translation: n. 慈悲, 博爱, 慈善团体, 施舍\n[法] 宽大, 宽恕, 慈善机关

examples.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
examples.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

examples.en: It is justice, not charity, that is wanting in the world.
examples.zh: 世界需要的是公正，不是施舍。

examples.en: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
examples.zh: 当地企业正在联手举办一项慈善活动。

charm.definition:
n. something believed to bring good luck
n. (physics) one of the six flavors of quark
v. control by magic spells, as by practicing witchcraft
v. protect through supernatural powers or charms
charm.translation: n. 吸引力, 魔力, 符咒\nvt. 迷住, 使陶醉, 行魔法\nvi. 用符咒, 有魅力

examples.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
examples.zh: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。

examples.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.
examples.zh: 魅力冲击视觉，美德征服心灵。

examples.en: He had a certain charm.
examples.zh: 他有一种魅力。

chart.definition:
n. a visual display of information
n. a map designed to assist navigation by air or sea
v. make a chart of
v. plan in detail
chart.translation: n. 图表, 海图\nvt. 制成图表\n[计] 图表

examples.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
examples.zh: 下面的图标显示了这个流程图

charter.definition: n. a document incorporating an institution and specifying its rights; includes the articles of incorporation and the certificate of incorporation\nn. a contract to hire or lease transportation\nv. grant a charter to
charter.translation: n. 特许状, 执照, 宪章\nvt. 特许, 发给特许执照

examples.en: They will dispatch four charter buses to pick everyone up.
The charter flight is to take off at three.
We've got a charter flight waiting to take us to Boston.

chase.definition:
n. United States politician and jurist who served as chief justice of the United States Supreme Court (1808-1873)
n. a rectangular metal frame used in letterpress printing to hold together the pages or columns of composed type that are printed at one time
v. go after with the intent to catch
v. pursue someone sexually or romantically
chase.translation: n. 追求, 狩猎, 追逐\nvt. 追捕, 追逐, 雕刻, 在...上镶嵌宝石\nvi. 追赶, 奔跑

examples.en: The cat chased the mouse around the house.
examples.zh: 猫在房子里追老鼠。

examples.en: The hunter chases the rabbit in the fields.
examples.zh: 猎人在田野追兔子

examples.en: I see a cat chasing a dog.
examples.zh: 我看见一只猫追着一只狗跑。

chat.translation: n. 闲谈\nvi. 闲谈, 聊天

examples.en: Tom, I want to have a chat with you.
examples.zh: Tom，我想和你谈谈。

examples.en: I'm here, so do you want to chat?
examples.zh: 我在这，你想聊天吗？

examples.en: Sorry, Tom, I don't have time to chat.
examples.zh: 汤姆，抱歉，我没时间闲聊。

cheap.definition: a. relatively low in price or charging low prices\ns. embarrassingly stingy
cheap.translation: a. 便宜的, 不值钱的, 可鄙的\nadv. 便宜地

examples.en: Do you know of a cheap hotel in the area?
examples.zh: 您知道这附近有便宜的旅馆吗？

examples.en: This car was so cheap that he could afford it.
examples.zh: 这车便宜得让他能买得起。

examples.en: Do you know if there's a cheap hotel near here?
examples.zh: 您知道这附近有便宜的旅馆吗？

cheat.definition:
n. a deception for profit to yourself
v. deprive somebody of something by deceit
v. defeat someone through trickery or deceit
v. engage in deceitful behavior; practice trickery or fraud
cheat.translation: n. 欺骗, 作弊, 骗子\nv. 欺骗, 逃脱, 骗取

examples.en: Never did I dream that George would cheat me.
examples.zh: 我连做梦也没有想过乔治会骗我。

examples.en: The man cheated the old woman out of her money.
examples.zh: 他骗了老婆婆的钱。

examples.en: It is wrong to cheat at cards.
examples.zh: 玩牌作弊是错误的。

check.definition:
n. a written order directing a bank to pay money
n. the bill in a restaurant
n. the act of inspecting or verifying
n. a mark left after a small piece has been chopped or broken off of something
check.translation:
n. 检查, 支票, 阻止物, 寄物牌, 象棋中将军
vt. 检查, 阻止, 核对, 寄存, 托运
vi. 逐项相符, 开支票
[计] 复选

examples.en: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?
examples.zh: 你把购物单上的全都检查过了吗？

examples.en: Check the tools and see if anything is missing.
examples.zh: 检点一下工具，看有无丢失。

examples.en: Please give it a check, then hand in the examination paper.
examples.zh: 请大家认真检查一次，再把考卷交上来。

cheek.definition: n. either side of the face below the eyes\nv. speak impudently to
cheek.translation: n. 颊, 厚颜, 脸蛋\n[医] 颊

examples.en: After slapping Tom's right cheek, Mary stomped on his left foot.
examples.zh: 玛丽给了汤姆的右脸一巴掌，然后踩了他的左脚。

examples.en: He gave her a peck on the cheek.
examples.zh: 他在她的脸上轻轻的亲了一下。

examples.en: Tom has a scar on his cheek.
examples.zh: 汤姆的脸颊上有一块伤痕。

cheer.definition:
n. a cry or shout of approval
v. give encouragement to
v. show approval or good wishes by shouting
v. cause (somebody) to feel happier or more cheerful
cheer.translation: n. 愉快, 振奋, 欢呼\nvi. 欢呼, 喝彩, 快活起来\nvt. 使振奋, 欢呼

examples.en: He tried to cheer up his wife, but wasn't able to.
examples.zh: 他试着哄他老婆开心，但他没做到。

examples.en: The situation is improving, so cheer up!
examples.zh: 情况正在改善，所以振作起来！

examples.en: My sister is cheering for a young Sumo wrestler.
examples.zh: 我的姊姊为一个年轻的相扑力士加油。

cheerful.definition: a. being full of or promoting cheer; having or showing good spirits\ns. pleasantly (even unrealistically) optimistic
cheerful.translation: a. 快活的, 高兴的, 兴高采烈的

examples.en: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
examples.zh: 她开朗的个性使我觉得快乐。

examples.en: He is not the cheerful man he was.
examples.zh: 他已经不再是以前那个快乐的男孩了。

examples.en: She's always been a very cheerful person.
examples.zh: 她是一直是个很欢快的人

cheese.definition: n. a solid food prepared from the pressed curd of milk\nv. used in the imperative (get away, or stop it)\nv. wind onto a cheese

examples.en: The store sells foodstuffs, such as butter, cheese, and sugar.
examples.zh: 这家店卖的是牛油、奶酪、砂糖之类的食品。

examples.en: This cake tastes like it has cheese in it.
examples.zh: 这块蛋糕尝起来有奶酪的味道。

examples.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
examples.zh: 我的三明治里有肉，奶酪和番茄。

chemical.definition: n. material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules\na. relating to or used in chemistry\na. of or made from or using substances produced by or used in reactions involving atomic or molecular changes
chemical.translation: n. 化学药品\na. 化学的, 化学上用的

examples.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
examples.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

examples.en: Once the chemical plant caught fire, it exploded.
examples.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

examples.en: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.
examples.zh: 把水加热不改变它的化学成分。

chemistry.definition: n. the science of matter; the branch of the natural sciences dealing with the composition of substances and their properties and reactions\nn. the chemical composition and properties of a substance or object\nn. the way two individuals relate to each other
chemistry.translation: n. 化学, 化学过程\n[化] 化学

examples.en: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
examples.zh: 这里是普通中学的化学实验室。

examples.en: Which do you like better, physics or chemistry?
examples.zh: 物理和化学你更喜欢哪个？

examples.en: I found him a genius at chemistry.
examples.zh: 我发现了他在化学方面的天赋。

cherry.definition: n. wood of any of various cherry trees especially the black cherry\nn. any of numerous trees and shrubs producing a small fleshy round fruit with a single hard stone; many also produce a valuable hardwood\nn. a red fruit with a single hard stone
cherry.translation: n. 樱桃, 樱桃树, 樱桃色\n[医] 樱桃

examples.en: I'm not a cherry! I've gotten laid lots of times!
examples.zh: 我不是处男！我做过很多次爱了！

examples.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
examples.zh: 这座雕像是由樱木雕刻而成。

examples.en: There used to be a big cherry tree behind my house.
examples.zh: 我家后面曾经有棵大樱桃树。

chess.definition: n. weedy annual native to Europe but widely distributed as a weed especially in wheat\nn. a board game for two players who move their 16 pieces according to specific rules; the object is to checkmate the opponent's king
chess.translation: n. 国际象棋\n[建] 雀麦

examples.en: If you like, I will teach you to play chess.
examples.zh: 你要是想学的话我可以教你下象棋。

examples.en: I moved a chess piece on the board one forward.
examples.zh: 我在棋盘上把一个棋子向前移动一步。

examples.en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
examples.zh: 他在国际象棋比赛中取得了冠军。

chest.definition: n. box with a lid; used for storage; usually large and sturdy
chest.translation: n. 胸, 胸部, 衣柜, 箱子\n[医] 胸, 胸廓

examples.en: Tom has a tattoo of a skull on his chest.
examples.zh: 汤姆在胸上有个头骨文身。

examples.en: I just need to get something off my chest.
examples.zh: 我只是想敞开心扉。

examples.en: Do you think that chest hair is sexy?
examples.zh: 你觉得胸毛是性感的吗？

chew.definition: n. a wad of something chewable as tobacco\nn. biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow\nv. chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth
chew.translation: vt. 咀嚼, 嚼碎\nvi. 咀嚼, 细想\nn. 咀嚼, 咀嚼物

examples.en: It is hard for me to chew.
examples.zh: 我不太能嚼东西。

examples.en: There was some chewing gum on the sole of Tom's shoe.
examples.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

examples.en: Some chewing gum was stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
examples.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

chicken.definition:
n. the flesh of a chicken used for food
n. a domestic fowl bred for flesh or eggs; believed to have been developed from the red jungle fowl
n. a foolhardy competition; a dangerous activity that is continued until one competitor becomes afraid and stops
s. easily frightened

examples.en: I had chicken pox when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我小时候发水痘。

examples.en: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
examples.zh: 母鸡孵蛋，孵出小鸡。

examples.en: The child has a case of chicken pox.
examples.zh: 这孩子有水痘的症状。

chief.translation: n. 领袖, 酋长, 长官, 主要部分\na. 主要的, 首位的

examples.en: He is the chief of my department.
examples.zh: 他是我部门的主管。

examples.en: I got acquainted with the chief executive.
examples.zh: 我认识了这位行政长官。

child.definition:
n. a young person of either sex
n. a human offspring (son or daughter) of any age
n. an immature childish person
n. a member of a clan or tribe
child.translation: n. 孩子, 产物, 追随者\n[医] 儿童

examples.en: I used to play alone when I was a child.
examples.zh: 我小时候常常独自玩耍。

examples.en: I could swim well even when I was a child.
examples.zh: 我很小的时候就游得很好了。

examples.en: This is the house where I lived as a child.
examples.zh: 这就是我小时候住的房子。

childhood.definition: n. the time of person's life when they are a child\nn. the state of a child between infancy and adolescence
childhood.translation: n. 孩童时期\n[医] 儿童期

examples.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
examples.zh: 我从小的梦想就是做一名糕点师。

examples.en: When I heard that song, it reminded me of my childhood.
examples.zh: 我一听到那首歌，就想起来我小的时候。

examples.en: Did you have a lot of happy experiences in your childhood?
examples.zh: 你小时候是不是有很多快乐的经历呢？

chill.definition:
n. coldness due to a cold environment
n. a sensation of cold that often marks the start of an infection and the development of a fever
n. a sudden numbing dread
v. depress or discourage
chill.translation:
n. 寒冷, 寒意, 失意
a. 寒冷的, 冷漠的
vt. 使寒心, 冷冻
vi. 变冷

examples.en: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.
examples.zh: 在你侍酒前最好先将白葡萄酒冷却一下。

examples.en: She was wearing a thick coat against the chill.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件厚外套以防止冷。

examples.en: A chill ran down his spine as he crossed the park.
examples.zh: 他穿过公园时，一阵寒意顺著脊背蔓延而下。

chin.definition: n. the protruding part of the lower jaw\nv. raise oneself while hanging from one's hands until one's chin is level with the support bar
chin.translation: n. 下巴, 颏\n[医] 颏

examples.en: He was listening with his chin resting on his hand.
examples.zh: 他用手撑着下巴，听着。

examples.en: Be patient and keep your chin up. Some things just take time.
examples.zh: 耐心地坚持下去，有些事急不来。

examples.en: She slapped me on the chin.
examples.zh: 她打了我的下巴。

chip.definition:
n. a triangular wooden float attached to the end of a log line
n. a piece of dried bovine dung
n. a thin crisp slice of potato fried in deep fat
n. a small disk-shaped counter used to represent money when gambling
chip.translation:
n. 屑片, 薄片, 碎片
vt. 削, 切, 削成碎片, 使摔倒, 凿
vi. 削下屑片
[计] 孔屑; 组件; 晶片; 芯片

examples.en: There was a single potato chip on each plate.
examples.zh: 每个盘子里都有一块薯片。

examples.en: The chip in Yanni's windshield became a huge crack.
examples.zh: 雅尼的挡风玻璃上的碎片变成了一条巨大的裂缝。

examples.en: Yanni has a star chip in his windshield.
examples.zh: 雅尼的挡风玻璃上有一颗星形碎片。

chocolate.definition: n. a food made from roasted ground cacao beans\nn. a medium brown to dark-brown color
chocolate.translation: n. 巧克力\na. 巧克力制的

examples.en: Fifty-two per cent of British women prefer chocolate to sex.
examples.zh: 有百分之五十二的英国女性喜欢巧克力胜于性。

examples.en: Which one of you would like some hot chocolate?
examples.zh: 哪位要热巧克力？

examples.en: The more chocolate you eat, the fatter you'll get.
examples.zh: 你越是吃巧克力，越是会变胖。

choice.definition:
n. the person or thing chosen or selected
n. the act of choosing or selecting
s. of superior grade
s. appealing to refined taste
choice.translation:
n. 选择, 精选品, 选择权
a. 精选的, 挑三拣四的, 上等的
[计] DOS内部命令:在批处理文件中
该命令用于提示用户作出选择, 决定批处理文件的流程

examples.en: I hope Tom and I are making the right choice.
examples.zh: 我希望汤姆和我做的是正确选择。

examples.en: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.
examples.zh: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。

examples.en: I had no choice but to accept the offer.
examples.zh: 除了接受报价，我别无选择。

choose.definition: v. pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives\nv. select as an alternative over another\nv. see fit or proper to act in a certain way; decide to act in a certain way
choose.translation: vt. 选择, 宁愿, 欲\nvi. 作出选择, 愿意\n[计] 选取

examples.en: It took her a long time to choose a hat.
examples.zh: 她花了好长时间挑帽子。

examples.en: Our soldiers cannot choose whether there is war or peace.
examples.zh: 无论是战争，还是和平，我们军人是无法选择的。

examples.en: It is sometimes hard to choose between dreams and reality.
examples.zh: 梦想和现实有时真的很难取舍。

chop.definition:
n. the irregular motion of waves (usually caused by wind blowing in a direction opposite to the tide)
n. a small cut of meat including part of a rib
n. a jaw
n. a tennis return made with a downward motion that puts backspin on the ball
chop.translation: n. 肋条肉, 排骨, 砍, 戳记, 商标\nvt. 剁碎, 砍, 切击, 割断\nvi. 砍, 突然转向

examples.en: It still costs energy to chop it off.
examples.zh: 还要花能量砍掉。

examples.en: Add the honey, lemon juice, chopped almonds and the chopped apples.
examples.zh: 加入蜂蜜，柠檬汁，切碎的杏仁和切碎的苹果。

examples.en: Cook the peeled and chopped potatoes for 20 minutes in boiling water.
examples.zh: 把去皮切成小块的土豆放在滚水里煮20分钟。

chronic.definition: a. being long-lasting and recurrent or characterized by long suffering\ns. of long duration\ns. habitual
chronic.translation: a. 慢性的, 习惯性的\nn. 慢性病患者

examples.en: Tom went to see a doctor about his chronic dyspepsia.
Calvin had become a chronic sufferer from ague and catarrh.
COPD, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, blocks airflow through the lungs.

church.definition:
n. one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship
n. a place for public (especially Christian) worship
n. the body of people who attend or belong to a particular local church
v. perform a special church rite or service for
church.translation: n. 教堂, 礼拜, 教会\nvt. 使人接受宗教仪式\na. 教堂的

examples.en: The wedding will be held in a 17th century church.
examples.zh: 婚礼会在一座十七世纪的教堂里举行。

examples.en: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
examples.zh: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。

examples.en: The church is at the foot of a mountain.
examples.zh: 教堂位于山脚。

cigarette.definition: n. finely ground tobacco wrapped in paper; for smoking

examples.en: Smoking one cigarette a day is a good habit.
examples.zh: 每天吸一根香烟是个好习惯。

examples.en: Don't throw cigarette butts on the ground. Cockroaches might get cancer.
examples.zh: 别把烟头往地上扔，要不然蟑螂会得癌症的。

examples.en: Do you mind if I smoke a cigarette?
examples.zh: 你介意我抽根烟吗？

cinema.definition: n. a theater where films are shown

examples.en: Where shall we go now? To the theatre or cinema?
examples.zh: 我们现在去哪里？去剧场还是电影院？

examples.en: If you're bored, I suggest you go to the cinema.
examples.zh: 如果你感到无聊，我建议你去电影院。

examples.en: I'd like to go to the cinema with her.
examples.zh: 我想和她一起去看电影。

circle.definition:
n. ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point
n. something approximating the shape of a circle
n. a curved section or tier of seats in a hall or theater or opera house; usually the first tier above the orchestra
n. any circular or rotating mechanism
circle.translation: n. 圆周, 社交圈, 循环, 范围\nvt. 围着, 环绕\nvi. 盘旋, 循环

examples.en: I really like him, but not his circle of friends.
examples.zh: 我真的很喜欢他, 可是我不喜欢他周围的朋友。

examples.en: I'm glad you're not in my circle of friends.
examples.zh: 我很开心你不在我朋友卷里。

examples.en: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 我们的数学老师在黑板上画了一个圆。

circuit.definition:
n. an electrical device that provides a path for electrical current to flow
n. an established itinerary of venues or events that a particular group of people travel to
n. (law) a judicial division of a state or the United States (so-called because originally judges traveled and held court in different locations); one of the twelve groups of states in the United States that is covered by a particular circuit court of appeals
v. make a circuit
circuit.translation: n. 电路, 环(行)道, 巡回\n[计] 线路; 电路

examples.en: I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.
examples.zh: 我把果酱撒到电源插座上短路了。

circular.definition: n. an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution\ns. describing a circle; moving in a circle
circular.translation: a. 圆形的, 循环的, 间接的\n[医] 环状的, 循环的

examples.en: It is orbiting around the Earth along a circular path.
Thanks, I'll file this memo away in the circular file.
The house looks circular, but it isn't a complete circle.

circulate.definition:
v. cause to become widely known
v. cause be distributed
v. move through a space, circuit or system, returning to the starting point
v. cause to move in a circuit or system

examples.en: Was there a need to circulate that news bulletin?
Rumors started to circulate in town about Yanni having an affair.
Money needs to circulate more efficiently in Algeria.

circulation.definition:
n. the dissemination of copies of periodicals (as newspapers or magazines)
n. movement through a circuit; especially the movement of blood through the heart and blood vessels
n. (library science) the count of books that are loaned by a library over a specified period
n. number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold
circulation.translation: n. 流通, 循环, 发行量\n[化] 环流

examples.en: He works for a newspaper with a large circulation.
examples.zh: 他为一份印刷量很大的报纸工作。

circumstance.definition: n. a condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity\nn. information that should be kept in mind when making a decision\nn. formal ceremony about important occasions
circumstance.translation: n. 环境, 状况, 事件

examples.en: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.
examples.zh: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。

examples.en: Please consider that the maximum doesn't exist in some circumstances.
examples.zh: 请考虑一下，最大值在有些情况下是不存在的。

examples.en: The circumstances did not allow me to go abroad.
examples.zh: 情况不允许我出国。

cite.definition:
n a short note recognizing a source of information or of a quoted passage
v make reference to
v commend
v refer to
v repeat a passage from
v refer to for illustration or proof
v advance evidence for
v call in an official matter, such as to attend court
cite.translation: vt. 引用, 引证, 表彰\n[建] 引证, 指引

examples.en: In the 1950's, the Finns were cited as having one of the least healthy diets in the world.
examples.zh: 50年代，芬兰人被认为是世界上饮食最不健康的例子。

citizen.definition: n. a native or naturalized member of a state or other political community
citizen.translation: n. 市民, 公民\n[法] 公民, 国民, 市民

examples.en: She is a British citizen, but she was born in France.
examples.zh: 她是一个英国公民，但她是在法国出生的。

examples.en: She is a British citizen, though she was born in France.
examples.zh: 她是一个英国公民，但她是在法国出生的。

examples.en: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
examples.zh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

citizenship.definition: n. the status of a citizen with rights and duties\nn. conduct as a citizen
citizenship.translation: n. 国籍, 市民权, 市民的身份\n[法] 公民权, 公民资格, 公民身分

examples.en: Tom and François are trying to get French citizenship.
Tom has moved to Hungary and applied for Hungarian citizenship.
I can't believe he renounced his U.S. citizenship.

city.definition: n. a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts\nn. an incorporated administrative district established by state charter\nn. people living in a large densely populated municipality
city.translation: n. 城市, 市\n[法] 都市, 城市, 市

examples.en: There is a park in the middle of the city.
examples.zh: 城市中央有一座公园。

examples.en: It is said that Tokyo is a very safe city.
examples.zh: 人们都说，东京是座很安全的城市。

examples.en: The city isn't the one I left six years ago.
examples.zh: 城市已经不是我六年前离开时的城市。

civil.definition:
s. applying to ordinary citizens as contrasted with the military
a. not rude; marked by satisfactory (or especially minimal) adherence to social usages and sufficient but not noteworthy consideration for others
a. of or occurring within the state or between or among citizens of the state
a. of or relating to or befitting citizens as individuals
civil.translation: a. 市民的, 公民的, 有礼貌的\n[法] 公民的, 国民的, 民用的

examples.en: He wrote a book about the American Civil War.
examples.zh: 他写了本关于美国南北战争的书。

examples.en: The novel is centered on the Civil War.
examples.zh: 这篇小说的中心点是南北战争。

examples.en: After decades of civil war, order was restored.
examples.zh: 经过几十年的内战，秩序恢复了。

civilian.definition: n. a nonmilitary citizen\na. associated with civil life or performed by persons who are not active members of the military
civilian.translation: n. 平民, 民法专家\na. 平民的, 百姓的, 民用的

examples.en: Thousands upon thousands of soldiers and civilians died.
examples.zh: 成千上万的士兵和市民死去了。

examples.en: All oil-rich countries should be invaded and annihilated by US forces to protect their civilian populations and teach them democracy.
examples.zh: 所有石油资源丰富的国家都应该被美国军队入侵并摧毁，以保护那里的平民并向他们传授民主。

civilization.definition: n. a society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations)\nn. the social process whereby societies achieve an advanced stage of development and organization
civilization.translation: n. 文明, 教化\n[法] 文明, 文化, 文明国家的总称

examples.en: Do you know how many years old human civilization is?
examples.zh: 你知道人类文明有多少年的历史吗？

examples.en: One step forward is a step forward for civilization.
examples.zh: 向前一步，走向文明。

examples.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
examples.zh: 神话让我们能透悉古文明。

claim.definition:
n. an assertion of a right (as to money or property)
n. an assertion that something is true or factual
n. demand for something as rightful or due
n. an informal right to something
claim.translation: n. 要求, 要求权, 断言, 权利\nvt. 要求, 认领, 主张\nvi. 提出要求, 主张, 断言

examples.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
examples.zh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

examples.en: Mary claimed the bag was a gift from her husband.
examples.zh: 玛莉表示，包包是丈夫送的礼物。

examples.en: Tom and Mary claim that they're happy.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽声称他们很快乐。

clap.definition:
v. put quickly or forcibly
v. cause to strike the air in flight
v. clap one's hands together
v. strike the air in flight
clap.translation: n. 拍手, 拍手声, 霹雳声, 花柳病\nv. 鼓掌, (使)啪地关上

examples.en: Inside the venue, sounds of clapping, whistling, yelling, laughing blended together.
examples.zh: 会场内，掌声、哨声、喊声、笑声乱成了一锅粥。

examples.en: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.
examples.zh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。

examples.en: All the students clapped their hands.
examples.zh: 所有的学生都拍手。

clarify.definition: v. make clear and (more) comprehensible\nv. make clear by removing impurities or solids, as by heating
clarify.translation: vi. 澄清, 阐明\nvt. 使明晰

examples.en: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
examples.zh: 感谢你帮我解释明白。

examples.en: The point we must clarify here is that the lines between amateur and professional in sport are beginning to disappear.
examples.zh: 我们必须阐明这个观点，在运动项目上，业余选手和专业选手的界限开始消失了。

clash.definition:
n. a state of conflict between persons
n. a state of conflict between colors
v. be incompatible; be or come into conflict
v. disagree violently
clash.translation:
n. 冲突, 撞击声, 抵触
vi. 冲突, 抵触
vt. 使发出撞击声
[计] 对撞

examples.en: Every now and then they clash over their differences.
examples.zh: 他们有时候有矛盾冲突

clasp.definition:
n. a fastener (as a buckle or hook) that is used to hold two things together
n. the act of grasping
v. hold firmly and tightly
v. grasp firmly
clasp.translation: n. 扣子, 钩, 紧握\nv. 扣紧, 紧握

examples.en: He held her hand in a firm clasp.
examples.zh: 他紧握她的手。

class.definition:
n. a collection of things sharing a common attribute
n. a body of students who are taught together
n. people having the same social, economic, or educational status
n. a league ranked by quality
class.translation: n. 班级, 阶级, 种类, 课\nvt. 分类\n[计] 类别; 类; 种类; 类程

examples.en: Tom is by far the tallest boy in our class.
examples.zh: 汤姆远比我们班其他男孩高。

examples.en: She was by far the best singer in the class.
examples.zh: 她曾是班上唱歌绝对的第一名。

examples.en: Your English is too good to be in this class.
examples.zh: 你的英文成绩很好，不会被分派到这一班。

classic.definition: n. a creation of the highest excellence\nn. an artist who has created classic works
classic.translation: n. 古典作品, 杰作, 大艺术家\na. 第一流的, 最优秀的, 古典的

examples.en: Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
examples.zh: 麦根沙士被视为一种经典的美式碳酸饮品。

examples.en: Several classic, family-friendly games will also join the service next month.
examples.zh: 多款经典家庭游戏也将于下个月同步上架。

examples.en: Almost no students get full marks in Chinese classics.
examples.zh: 很少有学生能在古汉语考试上拿满分。

classical.definition:
a. of or relating to the most highly developed stage of an earlier civilisation and its culture
a. of or relating to the study of the literary works of ancient Greece and Rome
s. (language) having the form used by ancient standard authors
s. of or pertaining to or characteristic of the ancient Greek and Roman cultures
classical.translation: a. 古典的, 正统派的, 经典的\n[医] 古典的; 标准的, 典型的

examples.en: My sister likes classical music no less than I do.
examples.zh: 我姊姊对古典音乐的热爱不亚于我。

examples.en: Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
examples.zh: 你比较喜欢哪一个，摇滚乐还是古典音乐？

examples.en: You should memorize a piece of classical literature every day.
examples.zh: 你必须每天背一篇古典文献。

classify.definition: v. arrange or order by classes or categories\nv. declare unavailable, as for security reasons
classify.translation: vt. 分类, 归类, 分等\n[建] 分类, 分级, 分粒

examples.en: We should classify them before throwing them out.
examples.zh: 我们在扔掉之前得分类。

classroom.definition: n. a room in a school where lessons take place

examples.en: There were only a few pupils left in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室里只剩下几个学生了。

examples.en: This classroom is separated from that one by a wall.
examples.zh: 这间教室与那间隔着一堵墙。

examples.en: The teacher tells us to clean our classroom every day.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们每天都打扫教室。

clause.definition: n. (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence
clause.translation: n. 子句, 条款\n[计] 子句

examples.en: A clause is composed of a subject and a predicate.
The notwithstanding or override clause in Canadian law is controversial.
We need to modify how the clause is written.

clay.definition: n. a very fine-grained soil that is plastic when moist but hard when fired\nn. United States general who commanded United States forces in Europe from 1945 to 1949 and who oversaw the Berlin airlift (1897-1978)\nn. United States politician responsible for the Missouri Compromise between free and slave states (1777-1852)
clay.translation: n. 泥土, 肉体, 黏土\n[化] 粘土

examples.en: Tom worked the clay into a vase.
examples.zh: 汤姆把黏土塑成了一个花瓶。

examples.en: "My new animated movie is called 'Stretchie: End of Clays Part II,'" said Tom.
examples.zh: 汤姆说：「我推出的全新动画电影叫做《伸展世界：黏土的末日 (下)》。」

clean.definition:
v. make clean by removing dirt, filth, or unwanted substances from
v. remove unwanted substances from, such as feathers or pits
v. be cleanable
v. deprive wholly of money in a gambling game, robbery, etc.
clean.translation:
a. 干净的, 清白的, 简洁的
adv. 清洁地, 完全地
vt. 清理, 使干净, 出空
vi. 被搞干净
n. 打扫

examples.en: I want to clean the house before my parents come.
examples.zh: 我想在我父母来之前收拾干净屋子。

examples.en: I want to clean the house before my parents return.
examples.zh: 我想在爸爸妈妈回来之前把房子打扫干净。

examples.en: The teacher tells us to clean our classroom every day.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们每天都打扫教室。

clear.definition:
n. the state of being free of suspicion
v. make a way or path by removing objects
v. remove
v. be debited and credited to the proper bank accounts
clear.translation:
a. 清楚的, 明确的, 澄清的
adv. 清晰地
vt. 澄清, 清除障碍
vi. 放晴, 变清澈
n. 空隙
[计] 清除

examples.en: I will make it clear that I won't come again.
examples.zh: 我要明确表示我不会再来了。

examples.en: It isn't clear what the writer is trying to say.
examples.zh: 不知作者在说什么。

examples.en: It's not clear what the writer is trying to say.
examples.zh: 不知作者在说什么。

clerk.definition: n. an employee who performs clerical work (e.g., keeps records or accounts)\nv. work as a clerk, as in the legal business
clerk.translation: n. 办事员, 职员, 文书\nvi. 当店员

examples.en: Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
examples.zh: 每周六鲍勃在杂货店做店员。

examples.en: She is a clerk in the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她在超市做秘书。

examples.en: Among the audience, there were students, teachers, clerks, and so on.
examples.zh: 听众中有学生、老师还有职员，等等。

clever.translation: a. 聪明的, 精明的

examples.en: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
examples.zh: 他很聪明，但却不太帮得上忙。

examples.en: Although he may be clever, he is not wise.
examples.zh: 他只不过是有点小聪明。

examples.en: He is a clever boy, to be sure.
examples.zh: 他确实是个聪明的小孩。

click.definition:
n. depression of a button on a computer mouse
v. make a clicking or ticking sound
v. produce a click
v. become clear or enter one's consciousness or emotions
click.translation:
n. 咔哒声, 啪嗒声
vi. 作咔哒声
vt. 使发咔哒声
[计] 单击

examples.en: Click the picture to go to the next page!
examples.zh: 点击图片进入下一页!

examples.en: Did you hear the click?
examples.zh: 你听到了点击声吗？

examples.en: Don't click on that link.
examples.zh: 不要点击那个链接。

client.definition: n. a person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
client.translation: n. 客户, 顾客, 委托人\n[计] 客户, 客户机, 客户机程序

examples.en: The investor stole the capital of his client.
examples.zh: 投资者把他客户的资金窃取了.

examples.en: The lawyer warned his client against testifying, but he did it anyway.
examples.zh: 律师警告过他的当事人反对作证, 但是他还是这么做了。

examples.en: This shows they have listened to the needs of their clients.
examples.zh: 这表明它们注意听了顾客的需要。

cliff.definition: n. a steep high face of rock

examples.en: A single step, and you will fall over the cliff.
examples.zh: 只迈一步，你就会落下悬崖。

examples.en: They climbed to the top of a cliff.
examples.zh: 他们一直爬到悬崖顶上。

examples.en: They'd have been killed if the car had gone over the cliff.
examples.zh: 车子若是掉落悬崖他们早就没命了。

climate.definition: n. the weather in some location averaged over some long period of time\nn. the prevailing psychological state
climate.translation: n. 气候, 社会趋势, 气候区\n[医] 气候

examples.en: The climate here is very similar to that of England.
examples.zh: 这里的气候和英国十分相似。

examples.en: The climate here is very similar to that in England.
examples.zh: 这里的气候和英国十分相似。

examples.en: The climate of England is similar to that of Hokkaido.
examples.zh: 英国的气候和北海道很相似。

climb.definition:
n. an event that involves rising to a higher point (as in altitude or temperature or intensity etc.)
n. the act of climbing something
v. go upward with gradual or continuous progress
v. move with difficulty, by grasping
climb.translation: v. 攀登, 上升, 爬\nn. 攀登, 爬升

examples.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.
examples.zh: 对猴子来说，爬树很容易。

examples.en: How did the cat manage to climb on the roof?
examples.zh: 那只猫是怎么爬上屋顶的？

examples.en: A lot of people climb the railing, and even litter.
examples.zh: 很多人跳过栏杆，还丢垃圾。

cling.definition:
n. fruit (especially peach) whose flesh adheres strongly to the pit
v. come or be in close contact with; stick or hold together and resist separation
v. to remain emotionally or intellectually attached
v. hold on tightly or tenaciously
cling.translation: vi. 粘紧, 附着, 紧贴, 坚持

examples.en: Some people clung to tree branches for several hours to avoid being washed away by the floodwaters.
examples.zh: 为了不被洪水冲走，有的人紧紧地抱着树干长达数个钟头。

clinic.definition: n. a medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists\nn. meeting for diagnosis of problems and instruction or remedial work in a particular activity\nn. a healthcare facility for outpatient care
clinic.translation: n. 诊所, 临床教学\n[医] 诊所(门诊部); 临床(讲解); 临床(学)科

examples.en: A new health clinic is set to open next month.
examples.zh: 一家新的健康诊所将于下个月开幕。

examples.en: Tom works at a harm reduction clinic.
examples.zh: 汤姆在一家减害诊所工作。

examples.en: She went to the Takasu clinic.
examples.zh: 她去了高须诊所。

clinical.definition: a. relating to a clinic or conducted in or as if in a clinic and depending on direct observation of patients\ns. scientifically detached; unemotional
clinical.translation: a. 临床的, 门诊部的\n[医] 临床的, 临证的

examples.en: Not all clinical studies are hypothesis-driven.
examples.zh: 不是所有的临床研究都是假设驱动的。

clip.definition:
n. any of various small fasteners used to hold loose articles together
n. an article of jewelry that can be clipped onto a hat or dress
n. the act of clipping or snipping
n. a sharp slanting blow
clip.translation: n. 修剪, 夹子, 回形针, 剪下来的东西\nvt. 修剪, 痛打, 夹牢, 剪报\nvi. 剪报

examples.en: I have a newspaper clipping file.
examples.zh: 我有一本剪报夹。

examples.en: He clipped the sheep.
examples.zh: 他为羊只修剪羊毛。

clock.definition: n. a timepiece that shows the time of day\nv. measure the time or duration of an event or action or the person who performs an action in a certain period of time
clock.translation:
n. 时钟, 计时器, (袜子上的)绣花边花
vt. 绣花样, 记时, 记录
vi. 记录时间
[计] 时钟

examples.en: Most important of all a clock has to be accurate.
examples.zh: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。

examples.en: They guarantee this clock can be used for a year.
examples.zh: 他们保证这个时钟可用一年。

examples.en: Even a broken clock is right twice a day.
examples.zh: 凡人皆有得意时。

clone.definition: n. a group of genetically identical cells or organisms derived from a single cell or individual by some kind of asexual reproduction\nv. make multiple identical copies of
clone.translation: n. 无性系\n[计] 代用件

examples.en: What animals have they been able to clone to date?
The aliens replaced the US president with a clone.
Of course, Labour under Keir Starmer is just a Tory clone.

close.definition:
v. move so that an opening or passage is obstructed; make shut
v. become closed
v. finish or terminate (meetings, speeches, etc.)
v. complete a business deal, negotiation, or an agreement
close.translation:
n. 结束, 完结
a. 靠近的, 亲近的, 亲密的, 严密的, 关闭的, 狭窄的, 秘密的
vt. 关, 结束, 使靠近, 封闭, 使接近
vi. 关闭, 结束, 靠近
adv. 接近地, 紧密地
[计] 关闭

examples.en: She rented a flat close the to the city centre.
examples.zh: 她在离市中心不远处租了间公寓。

examples.en: The museum had to close due to lack of finances.
examples.zh: 博物馆资金不足，只好关门。

examples.en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
examples.zh: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。

cloth.definition: n artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
cloth.translation: n. 布料, 织品, 布\n[建] 布

examples.en: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
examples.zh: 她买了六码的布做衣服。

examples.en: This kind of cloth is both cheap and sturdy.
examples.zh: 这种布既便宜又结实。

examples.en: She cut up the cloth to make bandages.
examples.zh: 她裁下布制作绷带。

clothes.definition:
n clothing in general
v provide with clothes or put clothes on
v furnish with power or authority; of kings or emperors
v cover as if with clothing

examples.en: They took off my clothes in front of her eyes.
examples.zh: 他们在她眼前脱下我的衣服。

examples.en: I know that Tom is in his room changing clothes.
examples.zh: 我知道汤姆在他房间里换衣服。

examples.en: Did you take the clothes out of the washing machine?
examples.zh: 你把衣服从洗衣机里拿出来了吗？

clothing.definition: n. a covering designed to be worn on a person's body

examples.en: The color of this clothing is neither red nor orange.
examples.zh: 这衣服颜色既不是红色，也不是橙色。

examples.en: Tomorrow afternoon, I will be inside my mom's clothing store.
examples.zh: 明天下午我在我妈妈的衣服店里。

examples.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
examples.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

cloud.definition:
n. any collection of particles (e.g., smoke or dust) or gases that is visible
n. a visible mass of water or ice particles suspended at a considerable altitude
n. out of touch with reality
n. a cause of worry or gloom or trouble
cloud.translation: n. 云, 阴暗, 烟雾, 疑团\nvt. 以云遮敝, 笼罩, 使黯然\nvi. 乌云密布, 阴沉

examples.en: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
examples.zh: 云是天空中的水汽团。

examples.en: Not a single cloud could be seen in the sky.
examples.zh: 天上万里无云。

examples.en: Viewed from a distance, the island looked like a cloud.
examples.zh: 这个岛从远方看起来像一片云。

club.definition:
n. a formal association of people with similar interests
n. stout stick that is larger at one end
n. a playing card in the minor suit that has one or more black trefoils on it
v. unite with a common purpose
club.translation:
n. 俱乐部, 木棍, 球棒
vt. 用棍棒打, 缴纳
vi. 联合起来
a. 俱乐部的

examples.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.
examples.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。

examples.en: He became a member of this club five years ago.
examples.zh: 他在五年前成为了这个俱乐部的成员。

examples.en: You may as well withdraw from the club right away.
examples.zh: 你还不如立刻退出这个俱乐部。

clue.definition: n. evidence that helps to solve a problem\nv. roll into a ball
clue.translation: n. 线索, 暗示\nvt. 暗示, 提供线索

examples.en: The authorities have no clue, but everyone else knows.
examples.zh: 旁观者清，当局者迷。

examples.en: I haven't got a clue as to why he quit so suddenly.
examples.zh: 我完全不明白他为甚么会突然辞职。

examples.en: I have no clue.
examples.zh: 我一无所知。

clumsy.definition:
s lacking grace in movement or posture
s not elegant or graceful in expression
s difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape
s showing lack of skill or aptitude
clumsy.translation: a. 笨拙的, 不雅观的, 粗陋的

examples.en: My sister is clumsy, which is a disadvantage to her.
I know that Tom is a very clumsy guy.
Has no-one ever told you how clumsy you are?

cluster.definition: v. come together as in a cluster or flock
cluster.translation:
n. 串, 丛, 群, 簇
vi. 成串, 丛生
vt. 使聚集
[计] 簇

examples.en: There was a cluster of large rocks in the area.
Sami saw a cluster of kids standing on the balcony.
The cluster of cells continued to grow in the laboratory.

clutch.definition:
n. a tense critical situation
n. a number of birds hatched at the same time
n. a pedal or lever that engages or disengages a rotating shaft and a driving mechanism
n. a coupling that connects or disconnects driving and driven parts of a driving mechanism
clutch.translation:
n. 抓紧, 掌握, 离合器, 一窝小鸡
vt. 抓住, 踩汽车离合器踏板
vi. 抓
[计] 联轴器; 离合器

examples.en: He clutched her arm firmly.
examples.zh: 他牢牢地抓住了她的手臂。

coach.definition:
n. (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team
n. a person who gives private instruction (as in singing, acting, etc.)
n. a carriage pulled by four horses with one driver
v. teach and supervise (someone); act as a trainer or coach (to), as in sports
coach.translation: n. 四轮大马车, 教练\nvt. 训练, 指导\nvi. 坐马车旅行, 作指导

examples.en: According to the coach, Bob is a good swimmer.
examples.zh: 教练说，鲍伯游泳游得很好。

examples.en: She liked tennis and became a tennis coach.
examples.zh: 她喜欢网球并成为了一个网球教练。

examples.en: The last three coaches of the train were badly damaged.
examples.zh: 火车的尾三节车厢损坏得很严重。

coal.definition: n. fossil fuel consisting of carbonized vegetable matter deposited in the Carboniferous period\nv. supply with coal\nv. take in coal
coal.translation: n. 煤, 木炭\nv. 加煤

examples.en: Many workers were trapped in the coal mine.
examples.zh: 有很多工人被困在煤矿里了。

examples.en: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.
examples.zh: 煤和天然气是天然燃料。

examples.en: Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。

coalition.definition: n. the state of being combined into one body
coalition.translation: n. 结合体, 结合, 联合\n[经] 联合, 联盟

examples.en: I hope the SPD forms a coalition with Die Linke.
The coalition is trying to paper over the cracks.
I hope the SPD doesn't form a coalition with Die Linke.

coarse.definition: a. of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles\ns. lacking refinement or cultivation or taste\ns. of low or inferior quality or value
coarse.translation: a. 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的\n[计] 粗略的

examples.en: Her dress was made of coarse wool.
examples.zh: 她的裙子是用粗糙的羊毛造的。

coast.definition: n. a slope down which sleds may coast\nn. the area within view\nv. move effortlessly; by force of gravity
coast.translation: n. 海岸, 滑坡\nv. 沿海岸而行

examples.en: The town is two miles away from the coast.
examples.zh: 那小镇离岸边有两英里。

examples.en: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.
examples.zh: 大部分的学生来自西海岸。

examples.en: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.
examples.zh: 他们沿着非洲西岸航行了。

coat.definition:
n. an outer garment that has sleeves and covers the body from shoulder down; worn outdoors
n. growth of hair or wool or fur covering the body of an animal
v. put a coat on; cover the surface of; furnish with a surface
v. cover or provide with a coat
coat.translation: n. 外套\nvt. 外面覆盖, 给...穿外套

examples.en: There were a hat and a coat on the wall.
examples.zh: 墙上挂着一顶帽子和一件大衣。

examples.en: He rushed into the room with his coat on.
examples.zh: 他穿着衣服冲进房间。

examples.en: She was wearing a thick coat against the chill.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件厚外套以防止冷。

code.definition:
n. a set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones)
n. a coding system used for transmitting messages requiring brevity or secrecy
n. (computer science) the symbolic arrangement of data or instructions in a computer program or the set of such instructions
v. attach a code to
code.translation: n. 代码, 密码, 法规, 法典\nvt. 把...编码\n[计] 代码

examples.en: Frank left a message by means of a secret code.
examples.zh: 法兰克用暗号留下了一则讯息。

examples.en: With data, he's a genius. But with code -- complete numbskull.
examples.zh: 在处理资料上，他很有天赋。但编写代码的话，只能说一窍不通。

examples.en: I remember its color code should be 39C5BB.
examples.zh: 我记得它的颜色代码应该是39C5BB。

coffee.definition: n. a beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans\nn. any of several small trees and shrubs native to the tropical Old World yielding coffee beans
coffee.translation: n. 咖啡, 咖啡色\n[医] 咖啡, 咖啡豆

examples.en: I had a cup of coffee at the coffee shop.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡店里喝了一杯咖啡。

examples.en: Every day I go to the café and have coffee.
examples.zh: 我每天去咖啡店喝咖啡。

examples.en: How many cups of coffee do you drink a day?
examples.zh: 你一天喝几杯咖啡？

cognitive.definition: a. of or being or relating to or involving cognition
cognitive.translation: a. 认知的, 认识的

examples.en: Do you believe language learning can enhance cognitive abilities? Why?
I plan to major in cognitive science in college.
How do you handle the cognitive load of switching between languages?

coherent.definition:
a. marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts
s. capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner
a. (physics) of waves having a constant phase relation
s. sticking together
coherent.translation: a. 互相耦合的, 清晰的, 明了的，凝聚性的, 连贯的

examples.en: The two sentences are both coherent.
examples.zh: 两个句子是一致的。

coil.definition: n. a structure consisting of something wound in a continuous series of loops\nn. a round shape formed by a series of concentric circles (as formed by leaves or flower petals)\nn. a transformer that supplies high voltage to spark plugs in a gasoline engine
coil.translation: n. 线圈, 盘绕, 骚动, 卷\nvt. 盘绕, 卷
