examples.en: Coil whine may sometimes be annoying, but it's usually harmless.
Immanuel's landlord promised to replace the broiler coil before winter.
Dust collected on the coil of the air conditioner.

coin.definition: n. a flat metal piece (usually a disc) used as money\nv. make up
coin.translation: n. 硬币, 金钱, 货币\nvt. 铸币, 创造, 杜撰

examples.en: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
examples.zh: 他偶然在古董店里发现了这个旧硬币。

examples.en: People must examine the front and back of a coin.
examples.zh: 人们必须查看硬币的正反面。

examples.en: The coin toss decides who will kick off the match.
examples.zh: 裁判抛硬币来决定谁来开球。

coincide.definition: v. go with, fall together\nv. be the same
coincide.translation: vi. 一致, 符合\n[化] 重合

examples.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
examples.zh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

examples.en: The date of the festival coincides with that of the exam.
examples.zh: 节日和考试碰巧在同一天。

examples.en: His opinion coincides with ours.
examples.zh: 他的意见和我们的相符。

coincidence.definition: n. an event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental\nn. the quality of occupying the same position or area in space
coincidence.translation: n. 巧合, 同时发生\n[电] 符合计数器

examples.en: By coincidence, these two are still being serviced.
examples.zh: 真的凑巧，这两样现在还在维修。

examples.en: Tom doesn't think this is a coincidence.
examples.zh: 汤姆不认为这是一个巧合。

examples.en: It could be just a coincidence.
examples.zh: 可能只是巧合。

cold.definition:
n. a mild viral infection involving the nose and respiratory passages (but not the lungs)
n. the sensation produced by low temperatures
a. having a low or inadequate temperature or feeling a sensation of coldness or having been made cold by e.g. ice or refrigeration
a. extended meanings; especially of psychological coldness; without human warmth or emotion
cold.translation: n. 感冒, 寒冷\na. 寒冷的, 冷淡的, 冷静的\nadv. 完全地

examples.en: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
examples.zh: 一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。

examples.en: I didn't call on him because I had a cold.
examples.zh: 我没有拜访他，因为我感冒了。

examples.en: Since I had a cold, I didn't go visit him.
examples.zh: 我没有拜访他，因为我感冒了。

collaborate.definition: v. work together on a common enterprise of project\nv. cooperate as a traitor
collaborate.translation: vi. 合作, 勾结\n[法] 合作, 合著, 通敌

examples.en: The African ground squirrels collaborate and are not aggressive to other mammals.
examples.zh: 非洲地松鼠互帮互助，对其他哺乳动物没有攻击性。

collaboration.definition: n. act of working jointly\nn. act of cooperating traitorously with an enemy that is occupying your country
collaboration.translation: n. 合作, 勾结\n[法] 通敌卖国者, 奸细

examples.en: The fortuitous coincidence of circumstances led to an unexpected collaboration.
I would like to thank you for your collaboration.
Collaboration has apparently paid off for both of them.

collapse.definition:
n. an abrupt failure of function or complete physical exhaustion
n. a natural event caused by something suddenly falling down or caving in
v. break down, literally or metaphorically
v. fold or close up
collapse.translation:
n. 崩溃, 倒塌, 虚脱
vi. 倒塌, 崩溃, 瓦解
vt. 使倒塌, 折叠
[计] 折叠

examples.en: If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!
examples.zh: 若有大地震，房屋会倒塌呀！

examples.en: The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
examples.zh: 那座老桥正面临坍塌的危险。

examples.en: The house collapsed under the weight of the snow.
examples.zh: 那房子在积雪的重量下坍塌了。

collar.definition:
n. a band that fits around the neck and is usually folded over
n. (zoology) an encircling band or marking around the neck of any animal
n. anything worn or placed about the neck
n. a short ring fastened over a rod or shaft to limit, guide, or secure a machine part
collar.translation: n. 衣领, 颈圈\nvt. 控制, 扭住衣领, 给...装上领子

examples.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
examples.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

colleague.definition: n. an associate that one works with\nn. a person who is member of one's class or profession

examples.en: My colleague arranged the work files for me.
examples.zh: 同事为我准备好了工作文件。

examples.en: Lucy and I are not colleagues, we are classmates.
examples.zh: 我和露西不是同事，是同学。

examples.en: We have a colleague in Australia.
examples.zh: 我们在澳洲有一位同事。

collect.definition:
n. a short prayer generally preceding the lesson in the Church of Rome or the Church of England
v. call for and obtain payment of
v. get or bring together
v. gather or collect
collect.translation: v. 收集, 聚集, 集中, 搜集\na. 由收到者付款的\nadv. 由收到者付款地

examples.en: Tom and Mary went into the forest to collect mushrooms.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽亚到树林里采集蘑菇去了。

examples.en: Why hasn't the landlord come to collect rent this month?
examples.zh: 为什么这个月房东还不来收房租？

examples.en: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
examples.zh: 在我们的城市那，我们非常谨慎地分类收集垃圾。

collection.definition: n. several things grouped together or considered as a whole\nn. a publication containing a variety of works\nn. the act of gathering something together
collection.translation: n. 收集, 采集, (一批)收藏品, 募捐\n[医] 收集; 收集品, 标本

examples.en: My school library has a collection of 2.5 million books.
examples.zh: 我校图书馆藏书二百五十万册。

examples.en: The spatulas, ramekins, plates, and mugs are all from the collection.
examples.zh: 这些锅铲、烤盅、盘子和马克杯都来自这套集合。

examples.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
examples.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

collective.definition: n. members of a cooperative enterprise\na. forming a whole or aggregate\ns. set up on the principle of collectivism or ownership and production by the workers involved usually under the supervision of a government
collective.translation: a. 集体的, 聚集的, 共同的\n[医] 集体的, 集合的

examples.en: Collective responsibility means irresponsibility.
examples.zh: 全体负责就是无责。

examples.en: The best refutation of the imaginary Malthusian laws of "land depletion" is the practice of Soviet collective farming.
examples.zh: 对马尔萨斯虚构的「土地耗尽」定律最有力的反驳，是苏联集体农场的时间。

college.definition: n. the body of faculty and students of a college\nn. an institution of higher education created to educate and grant degrees; often a part of a university\nn. a complex of buildings in which an institution of higher education is housed
college.translation: n. 学院, 大学, 学会

examples.en: I decided to go to college to major in English.
examples.zh: 我决定上大学主修英语。

examples.en: I wonder where Tom is planning to go to college.
examples.zh: 我想知道汤姆计划去哪里上大学。

examples.en: He is fresh from college, so he has no experience.
examples.zh: 他刚刚大学毕业，所以没什么经验。

collision.definition: n. (physics) a brief event in which two or more bodies come together\nn. an accident resulting from violent impact of a moving object\nn. a conflict of opposed ideas or attitudes or goals
collision.translation: n. 碰撞, 冲突, 抵触\n[计] 冲突

examples.en: The bike was mangled in its collision with the truck.
Are the US and China on a collision course?
The car exploded a few moments after the collision.

colony.definition:
n. a body of people who settle far from home but maintain ties with their homeland; inhabitants remain nationals of their home state but are not literally under the home state's system of government
n. a group of organisms of the same type living or growing together
n. one of the 13 British colonies that formed the original states of the United States
n. a place where a group of people with the same interest or occupation are concentrated
colony.translation: n. 殖民地, 移民队\n[医] 菌(集)落, 菌丛; 移民区

examples.en: Some say that China was like a Russian colony.
examples.zh: 有人说中国像是俄国的殖民地。

examples.en: At one time Nigeria was a British colony.
examples.zh: 尼日利亚曾经是英国的殖民地。

examples.en: Kenya used to be a British colony.
examples.zh: 肯尼亚曾经是英国的殖民地。

color.definition: n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect\nn. interest and variety and intensity\nn. the timbre of a musical sound
color.translation: n. 颜色, 面色, 颜料, 外貌\nvt. 把...涂上颜色, 粉饰, 使脸红, 歪曲\nvi. 变色

examples.en: The color red is beautiful, but it can't beat blue.
examples.zh: 红色很漂亮，但还比不过蓝色。

examples.en: Tom and Mary even always wear the same color clothes.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽甚至经常穿同样颜色的衣服。

examples.en: The color of this clothing is neither red nor orange.
examples.zh: 这衣服颜色既不是红色，也不是橙色。

column.definition:
n. a line of units following one after another
n. a vertical glass tube used in column chromatography; a mixture is poured in the top and washed through a stationary substance where components of the mixture are adsorbed selectively to form colored bands
n. a vertical array of numbers or other information
n. anything that approximates the shape of a column or tower
column.translation: n. 专栏, 圆柱, 纵队, 列, 柱形物\n[计] 列, 柱形图

examples.en: The opinion column discusses the importance of voting.
examples.zh: 意见栏讨论了投票的重要性，

examples.en: I found this column interesting.
examples.zh: 我发现这个专栏很有趣。

combat.definition: n. an engagement fought between two military forces
combat.translation: n. 争斗, 战斗\nvi. 战斗, 争斗\nvt. 与...战斗, 与...斗争

examples.en: In real combat, you must not forget that hesitation is a very dangerous thing.
examples.zh: 在实战中，你要知道三心二意是很危险的。

examples.en: Ziri cleaned his combat boots.
examples.zh: 齐里擦拭他的军靴。

examples.en: Tom died in combat.
examples.zh: 汤姆在战斗中死了。

combination.definition:
n. a collection of things that have been combined; an assemblage of separate parts or qualities
n. a coordinated sequence of chess moves
n. a sequence of numbers or letters that opens a combination lock
n. a group of people (often temporary) having a common purpose
combination.translation: n. 组合, 合并, 联合\n[计] 组合图

examples.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
examples.zh: 融合爵士是摇滚乐与爵士乐的融合。

examples.en: Cottage cheese and canned peaches are a delicious combination.
examples.zh: 干酪加桃子罐头是美味的搭配。

examples.en: Here you can see beautiful colour combinations.
examples.zh: 这里你可以看到漂亮的颜色组合。

combine.definition: n. harvester that heads and threshes and cleans grain while moving across the field\nv. add together from different sources\nv. join for a common purpose or in a common action
combine.translation: v. (使)联合, (使)结合\nn. (企业的)联合, 联合收割机

examples.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
examples.zh: 我们可能会将你的私人信息和其他信息结合在一起。

examples.en: Their combined weight was too much and caused the truck to break down.
examples.zh: 总重量过大，导致卡车抛锚。

examples.en: I combined black-eyed beans with corn.
examples.zh: 我用玉米搭配豇豆。

come.definition:
v. move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody
v. come to pass; arrive, as in due course
v. reach or enter a state, relation, condition, use, or position
v. to be the product or result
come.translation: vi. 过来, 来, 到达, 出现, 开始\ninterj. 喂

examples.en: How come you call on us so late at night?
examples.zh: 你怎么这么晚才来看我们？

examples.en: I asked him to come with me and he agreed.
examples.zh: 我让他随我来，他同意了。

examples.en: He gave me a promise to come here at five.
examples.zh: 他答应了我五点钟过来。

comedy.definition: n. light and humorous drama with a happy ending
comedy.translation: n. 喜剧, 有趣的事情

examples.en: We were all amused with the comedy.
examples.zh: 我们都被这出喜剧逗乐了。

examples.en: Dante wrote "The Divine Comedy."
examples.zh: 但丁写了《神曲》。

comfort.definition:
n. a state of being relaxed and feeling no pain
n. a feeling of freedom from worry or disappointment
n. satisfaction or physical well-being provided by a person or thing
n. assistance, such as that provided to an enemy or to a known criminal
comfort.translation: n. 舒适, 安慰, 安慰者\nvt. 安慰

examples.en: You need to get out of your comfort zone.
examples.zh: 你需要离开你的舒适区。

examples.en: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
examples.zh: 他的薪金很高，所以生活也过得很舒适。

examples.en: He worked hard in order that his family might live in comfort.
examples.zh: 他努力工作为了让他的家人可以过舒适的生活。

comfortable.definition:
a. providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal)
a. free from stress or conducive to mental ease; having or affording peace of mind
s. more than adequate
s. sufficient to provide comfort
comfortable.translation: a. 舒服的, 轻松的\nn. 盖被

examples.en: My room is comfortable, if it is a little small.
examples.zh: 我的房间很舒适, 即使它小了一点。

examples.en: Each day our life becomes more comfortable and more automated.
examples.zh: 我们的生活日益变得更舒适更自动化。

examples.en: You don't seem to be comfortable. Are you ill?
examples.zh: 你看起来不太舒服。是生病了吗？

command.definition:
n. an authoritative direction or instruction to do something
n. a military unit or region under the control of a single officer
n. the power or authority to command
n. availability for use
command.translation: n. 命令, 指挥, 控制, 部队, 司令部\nv. 命令, 指挥, 控制\n[计] 命令; 指令; DOS外部命令:启动新的命令处理器

examples.en: Do you know how to use these command line tools?
examples.zh: 你知道怎样使用这些命令行工具吗？

examples.en: Linux experts are able to use the command line.
examples.zh: Linux系统的高手都会用命令行。

examples.en: I learned to use a command block today.
examples.zh: 我今天学会用命令方块了。

commander.definition: n. someone in an official position of authority who can command or control others\nn. a commissioned naval officer who ranks above a lieutenant commander and below a captain
commander.translation: n. 司令官, 指挥官

examples.en: The commander gave orders that his men fire at once.
He rose in rank to become commander of the battalion.
They were beginning to lose faith in their commander.

comment.definition: n. a written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material\nv. make or write a comment on\nv. explain or interpret something
comment.translation: n. 注解, 批评, 评论, 备注\nvi. 评论, 注解\n[计] 备注

examples.en: All you have to do is to make a comment.
examples.zh: 你所要做的就是留下意见。

examples.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
examples.zh: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。

examples.en: His comment was concise and to the point.
examples.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

commentary.definition: n a written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material
commentary.translation: n. 注释, 评论, 说明\n[法] 注释, 评注, 评论

examples.en: Tom's running commentary made it impossible to focus on the film.
The football highlights were broadcast without presenters or commentary.
People sometimes narrate their actions to themselves as a running commentary.

commerce.definition: n. transactions (sales and purchases) having the objective of supplying commodities (goods and services)\nn. social exchange, especially of opinions, attitudes, etc.
commerce.translation: n. 商业, 商务, 贸易\n[经] 商业, 贸易, 商务

examples.en: Osaka is the center of commerce in Japan.
examples.zh: 大坂是日本的商业中心。

examples.en: English is useful in commerce.
examples.zh: 英语在商业中很有用。

commercial.definition:
n. a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
a. connected with or engaged in or sponsored by or used in commerce or commercial enterprises
a. of or relating to commercialism
s. of the kind or quality used in commerce; average or inferior
commercial.translation: a. 商业的, 商用的, 商品化的\nn. 商业广告节目

examples.en: The economist and statistician based in Ivory Coast says commercial trade in the region is primarily conducted with France.
examples.zh: 这位常驻科特迪瓦的经济学家兼统计学家表示，该地区的商业贸易主要与法国进行。

commission.definition:
n. a fee for services rendered based on a percentage of an amount received or collected or agreed to be paid (as distinguished from a salary)
n. the act of granting authority to undertake certain functions
n. the state of being in good working order and ready for operation
n. a formal statement of a command or injunction to do something
commission.translation: n. 委任状, 任官令, 所委职责, 佣金, 犯, 委托, 所托之事\nvt. 委任, 委托制作, 使服役

examples.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
examples.zh: 他的薪水包括基本工资和提成。

examples.en: How much is the commission?
examples.zh: 手续费是多少？

examples.en: A friend of mine commissioned a well-known artist to paint a portrait of his wife.
examples.zh: 我的一个朋友请了个著名画家给妻子画肖像。

commit.definition: v. cause to be admitted; of persons to an institution\nv. engage in or perform
commit.translation: vt. 委托(托付), 犯罪, 指派...作战, 使承担义务\n[法] 犯, 做, 把...交托给

examples.en: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?
examples.zh: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？

examples.en: He ought to be punished if he commits a crime.
examples.zh: 如果他犯了罪，他应该受到惩罚。

examples.en: I want you to commit seppuku.
examples.zh: 我要你切腹。

commitment.definition:
n. the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action
n. an engagement by contract involving financial obligation
n. a message that makes a pledge
n. the official act of consigning a person to confinement (as in a prison or mental hospital)
commitment.translation: n. 委托, 交押, 承担义务, 赞助\n[医] 院禁

examples.en: You've got to carry out your commitment at all costs.
Layla knew that wearing the hijab was a big commitment.
Marriage succeeds only as lifetime commitment with no escape clauses.

committee.definition: n. a special group delegated to consider some matter\nn. a self-constituted organization to promote something
committee.translation: n. 委员会\n[经] 委员会

examples.en: The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
examples.zh: 委员会是由三男七女组成的。

examples.en: Her girlfriend is part of the itty bitty titty committee.
examples.zh: 她的女朋友真算飞机场。

examples.en: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 委员会调查了事故的原因。

commodity.translation: n. 农产品, 商品, 有用的物品\n[经] 商品, 货物, 日用品

examples.en: Daily commodities increased in price.
examples.zh: 日常用品变得愈加贵了。

common.definition:
a. belonging to or participated in by a community as a whole; public
a. having no special distinction or quality; widely known or commonly encountered; average or ordinary or usual
s. common to or shared by two or more parties
s. commonly encountered
common.translation: a. 通常的, 共同的, 通俗的, 公共的\n[计] 公用块

examples.en: I am sure we have a lot in common.
examples.zh: 我们肯定有很多共通点。

examples.en: The surname Wang is the most common in China.
examples.zh: 中国姓王的人最多。

examples.en: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
examples.zh: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。

communicate.definition:
v. transmit information
v. transmit thoughts or feelings
v. join or connect
v. be in verbal contact; interchange information or ideas
communicate.translation: vt. 显露, 传达, 感染\nvi. 通讯

examples.en: Can you communicate in English what you want to say?
examples.zh: 您能用英语沟通您想要说的话吗？

examples.en: Ted was finally able to communicate his thoughts in Japanese.
examples.zh: Ted最终能用日语交流他的想法了。

examples.en: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
examples.zh: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

communication.definition: n. the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information\nn. something that is communicated by or to or between people or groups\nn. a connection allowing access between persons or places
communication.translation: n. 交流, 交通, 通讯\n[计] 通信

examples.en: The third generation Japanese communication methods are W-CDMA and CDMA2000.
examples.zh: 日本的第三代通信方式有W-CDMA和CDMA2000。

examples.en: This is a fast and effective way of communication.
examples.zh: 这是快速且有效的交流方式。

examples.en: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.
examples.zh: 网络是一个相通的渠道，而不是物质或具体的活动。

communist.definition: n. a member of the communist party\nn. a socialist who advocates communism\na. relating to or marked by communism
communist.translation: n. 共产主义者, 共产党员\n[法] 共产主义的, 共产党的

examples.en: There would be no New China without the communist party.
examples.zh: 没有共产党就没有新中国

examples.en: Comrades! Let's transform Moscow into a model communist city.
examples.zh: 同志们，让我们转换莫斯科为理想的共产主义城市。

examples.en: I willingly join the Chinese Communist Party.
examples.zh: 我自愿加入中国共产党。

community.definition:
n. a group of people living in a particular local area
n. common ownership
n. a group of nations having common interests
n. agreement as to goals
community.translation: n. 社区, 公众, 共有, 共同体\n[经] 公众, 共有, 社会

examples.en: Every month at our company, they run a community activity.
examples.zh: 在我们公司每月都会举办社团活动。

examples.en: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
examples.zh: 联邦、州及地方官员立即承诺将其重建。

examples.en: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?
examples.zh: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？

companion.definition: n. a friend who is frequently in the company of another\nn. a traveler who accompanies you\nn. one paid to accompany or assist or live with another
companion.translation: n. 朋友, 陪伴, 指南, 升降口围罩\nvt. 陪伴

examples.en: He and his companion asked me to come along with them.
examples.zh: 他和他的伙伴让我跟他们一起去。

examples.en: His dog is his good companion.
examples.zh: 他的狗是他的好伴侣。

examples.en: Whether the characters in a book are real or completely imaginary, they can become your friends and companions.
examples.zh: 无论书中的人物是真实的还是完全假想的，他们能成为你的伙伴和朋友。

company.definition:
n. an institution created to conduct business
n. small military unit; usually two or three platoons
n. the state of being with someone
n. organization of performers and associated personnel (especially theatrical)
company.translation: n. 公司, 友伴, 交往, 连队, 朋友, 一群\nvt. 陪伴\nvi. 交往

examples.en: He's the new CEO from the parent company in France.
examples.zh: 他是来自法国母公司的新任执行长。

examples.en: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
examples.zh: 该公司在这个企划中投入了很多钱。

examples.en: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.
examples.zh: 这个公司三分之二的雇员是工程师。

compare.definition:
v. examine and note the similarities or differences of
v. be comparable
v. consider or describe as similar, equal, or analogous
v. to form the comparative or superlative form on an adjective or adverb
compare.translation:
vt. 比较, 比喻, 对照
vi. 相比
n. 比较
[计] 比较

examples.en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
examples.zh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。

examples.en: I want to compare plans before making a choice.
examples.zh: 做选择之前，我想要多方面比较。

examples.en: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
examples.zh: 比较一下你写的句子和黑板上的句子。

comparison.definition: n. the act of examining resemblances\nn. relation based on similarities and differences\nn. qualities that are comparable
comparison.translation: n. 比较, 对照, 比喻\n[经] 比较, 对比

examples.en: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
examples.zh: 和都市生活相比，乡村生活和谐多了。

examples.en: The comparison between the two was to his disadvantage.
examples.zh: 两相比较，他那边的形势更不利一些。

examples.en: In comparison to him, I am still older.
examples.zh: 我比他年纪还大。

compass.definition:
n. navigational instrument for finding directions
n. the limit of capability
n. drafting instrument used for drawing circles
v. bring about; accomplish
compass.translation: n. 指南针, 范围, 音域\nvt. 包围, 达到, 图谋, 理解

examples.en: Tom doesn't know how to use a compass.
examples.zh: 汤姆不会使用指南针。

examples.en: The compass points to the north.
examples.zh: 指南针指向北边。

examples.en: Compass needles point to the north.
examples.zh: 指南针的指针指向北边。

compel.definition: v. force somebody to do something\nv. necessitate or exact

examples.en: No one may be compelled to belong to an association.
examples.zh: 不可以强迫任何人加入某个协会。

examples.en: We were compelled to stay at home on account of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

examples.en: He felt compelled to report the incident.
examples.zh: 他觉得必须报道这件事。

compensate.definition: v. adjust for\nv. make amends for; pay compensation for\nv. make payment to; compensate
compensate.translation: v. 偿还, 补偿, 付报酬

examples.en: You must compensate him for the money he lost.
examples.zh: 你需要赔偿他损失的钱。

compensation.definition: n. something (such as money) given or received as payment or reparation (as for a service or loss or injury)\nn. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that conceals your undesirable shortcomings by exaggerating desirable behaviors
compensation.translation: n. 补偿, 赔偿金, 工资\n[医] 代偿(机能), 补偿

examples.en: The compensation will be paid out as a lump sum.
Did the ruling abrogate your right to seek compensation?
Did you receive any compensation for the damaged luggage?

compete.definition: v. compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others

examples.en: Only four horses competed in the race.
examples.zh: 只有四匹马参加了比赛。

examples.en: I competed with him for the championship.
examples.zh: 我和他竞争冠军。

examples.en: Ten teams competed for the prize.
examples.zh: 十支队伍竞逐奖项。

competence.definition: n. the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually
competence.translation: n. 胜任, 职称, 能力\n[医] 能力, 活性

examples.en: No one doubts his competence for this position.
Ted doesn't have the competence to teach English.
Develop your linguistic competence as much as possible.

competent.definition: a. properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient\ns. adequate for the purpose\na. legally qualified or sufficient
competent.translation: a. 能干的, 胜任的, 有效的, 足够的\n[经] 有权的, 授权的, 胜任的

examples.en: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
examples.zh: 有人说你是个很有能力的人。

examples.en: They are both very competent judges.
examples.zh: 他们俩都是很称职的法官。

examples.en: You are very competent.
examples.zh: 你很能干。

competition.definition: n. a business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers\nn. the act of competing as for profit or a prize
competition.translation: n. 竞争, 竞赛\n[经] 竞争, 竞销, 比赛

examples.en: This soccer match is full of energetic and splendid competition.
examples.zh: 这场足球赛充满着激情和精彩的竞争。

examples.en: He would like to take part in the competition.
examples.zh: 他想参加比赛。

examples.en: Who do you think will win today's competition?
examples.zh: 你觉得今天的比赛谁会赢？

competitive.definition: a. involving competition or competitiveness\ns. subscribing to capitalistic competition\ns. showing a fighting disposition
competitive.translation: a. 竞争的\n[经] 竞争的

examples.en: To remain competitive, we've got to play to our strengths.
examples.zh: 为了保持竞争力，我们得发挥我们的优势。

examples.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
examples.zh: 有时候冰球运动员相互挑衅得太厉害以至于会引发斗殴。

examples.en: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
examples.zh: 攀比心理会让人产生负面情绪。

competitor.definition: n the contestant you hope to defeat
competitor.translation: n. 竞争者\n[经] 竞争者, 竞争对手

examples.en: She's a tough competitor, isn't she?
examples.zh: 她是强大的对手，不是吗？

examples.en: In consequence of a new agreement between two competitors, we need to readjust our strategies.
examples.zh: 由于两个竞争对手的一项新协议，我们需要重新调整战略。

compile.definition: v. use a computer program to translate source code written in a particular programming language into computer-readable machine code that can be executed
compile.translation: vt. 编译, 编辑, 编纂, 收集\n[计] 编译

examples.en: Compiling a dictionary demands an enormous amount of time.
examples.zh: 编字典是一项极花时间的工作。

examples.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
examples.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。

complain.definition: v. express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness\nv. make a formal accusation; bring a formal charge
complain.translation: v. 抱怨, 抗议, 控诉

examples.en: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.
examples.zh: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。

examples.en: A lot of housewives complain about the high prices of goods.
examples.zh: 许多家庭主妇抱怨物价非常高。

examples.en: The dog stopped walking, as if to complain.
examples.zh: 狗停下了脚步，好像在抗议。

complaint.definition: n. (formerly) a loud cry (or repeated cries) of pain or rage or sorrow\nn. an expression of grievance or resentment\nn. (civil law) the first pleading of the plaintiff setting out the facts on which the claim for relief is based
complaint.translation: n. 诉苦, 抱怨, 控诉\n[医] 陈诉; 病

examples.en: I do not want to hear your complaints again.
examples.zh: 我不想再听到你的抱怨了。

examples.en: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
examples.zh: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

examples.en: An increase in customer complaints might mean business is going downhill.
examples.zh: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

complement.definition:
n. a word or phrase used to complete a grammatical construction
n. a complete number or quantity
n. number needed to make up a whole force
n. something added to complete or embellish or make perfect
complement.translation: n. 补足物, 补语, 补数\nvt. 补充, 补足\n[计] 补码; 反相器; 补数

examples.en: A complete intransitive verb takes neither complement nor object.
examples.zh: 一个完完全全的不及物动词既没有补语，又没有宾语。

complete.definition:
v. come or bring to a finish or an end; others finished in over 4 hours"
v. bring to a whole, with all the necessary parts or elements
v. complete a pass
v. write all the required information onto a form
complete.translation: a. 完全的, 十足的, 完成的\nvt. 完成, 完工, 使圆满

examples.en: It's a complete mess, and it's getting on my nerves.
examples.zh: 这完全一团乱，让我心烦意乱。

examples.en: Pushing customers to complete a task can be a headache.
examples.zh: 催促客户去完成一件任务是很让人头疼的事。

examples.en: Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
examples.zh: 第一还是第二的版本比较齐全？

complex.definition:
n. a conceptual whole made up of complicated and related parts
n. a compound described in terms of the central atom to which other atoms are bound or coordinated
n. (psychoanalysis) a combination of emotions and impulses that have been rejected from awareness but still influence a person's behavior
a. complicated in structure; consisting of interconnected parts
complex.translation: n. 综合体, 情结, 络合物\na. 复杂的, 组合的

examples.en: The situation was much more complex than he had thought.
examples.zh: 事情可比他所想的要复杂得多。

examples.en: How can I rid myself of my inferiority complex?
examples.zh: 我有什么办法可以脱离我的自卑情结吗？

examples.en: Things are always more complex than we think.
examples.zh: 事情总比我们想的要复杂得多。

complexity.definition: n. the quality of being intricate and compounded
complexity.translation: n. 复杂, 复杂性, 复杂的事物

examples.en: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
examples.zh: 他思考着现代生活的复杂性。

complicate.definition: v. make more complicated\nv. make more complex, intricate, or richer
complicate.translation: vt. 弄复杂, 使错综, 使恶化\nvi. 变复杂

examples.en: I don't want to complicate my life with all that!
You just complicate the argument when you split hairs that way.
Don't complicate the problem by raising new issues.

complicated.definition: s. difficult to analyze or understand
complicated.translation: a. 复杂的\n[医] 并发的

examples.en: This form looks kind of complicated. Help me fill it out.
examples.zh: 这个表格好像有点复杂，你可以帮我填吗？

examples.en: In this city finding a taxi is complicated.
examples.zh: 这个城市很难打到出租车。

examples.en: He is good at solving complicated mathematical problems.
examples.zh: 他擅长解答数学难题。

complication.definition:
n. the act or process of complicating
n. a situation or condition that is complex or confused
n. any disease or disorder that occurs during the course of (or because of) another disease
n. a development that complicates a situation
complication.translation: n. 复杂化, 复杂情况\n[医] 并发症, 并发病

examples.en: The emergence of a third gender has added legal and administrative complications, creating unnecessary burdens.
examples.zh: 第三性别的出现增加了法律和行政上的麻烦，徒增无谓的负担。

compliment.definition: n. a remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration\nv. say something to someone that expresses praise\nv. express respect or esteem for
compliment.translation: n. 称赞, 恭维, 敬意\nvt. 称赞, 褒扬, 恭维

examples.en: You should compliment it with a white camisole.
examples.zh: 你里面要搭一件白色的吊带。

examples.en: I will take that as a compliment.
examples.zh: 我就当你夸我了。

examples.en: He took her words as a compliment.
examples.zh: 他把她的话当作是一种赞美。

comply.definition: v. act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
comply.translation: vi. 顺从, 依从\n[法] 遵守, 承诺, 照做

examples.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
examples.zh: 一些海滩没能遵守环保规定。

examples.en: Hopefully you'll comply with traffic regulations after this.
examples.zh: 希望你们以后严格遵守交通规则。

examples.en: Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.
examples.zh: 不遵守命名规则会导致解析错误。

component.definition: n. an abstract part of something\nn. an artifact that is one of the individual parts of which a composite entity is made up; especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system
component.translation: n. 元件, 组件, 成分\na. 组成的, 构成的\n[计] 组件

examples.en: The clan system is a key component of traditional Chinese culture.
examples.zh: 宗族制度是中国传统文化的重要组成部分。

examples.en: The basic components of Chinese characters are called "radicals".
examples.zh: 汉字的基本单位称作「部首」。

examples.en: Many companies have attempted to manufacture this complex component at scale, but so far only ours has succeeded.
examples.zh: 许多公司都尝试过大规模生产这种复杂的零件，但目前只有我们成功了。

compose.definition:
v. form the substance of
v. write music
v. put together out of existing material
v. calm (someone, especially oneself); make quiet
compose.translation: vt. 组成, 写作, 作曲, 使平静\nvi. 创作, 排字\n[计] 编写

examples.en: The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
examples.zh: 委员会是由三男七女组成的。

examples.en: Shizuko composed a poem about the change of the seasons.
examples.zh: 志津子写了一首关于季节变化的诗。

examples.en: The United States is composed of 50 states.
examples.zh: 美国是由五十个州组成的。

composition.definition:
n. the spatial property resulting from the arrangement of parts in relation to each other and to the whole
n. a mixture of ingredients
n. an essay (especially one written as an assignment)
n. something that is created by arranging several things to form a unified whole
composition.translation: n. 作文, 创作, 组成\n[化] 成分; 组成

examples.en: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
examples.zh: 你的作文非常好，而且错误很少。

examples.en: Errors are few, if any, in his English composition.
examples.zh: 他的英文作文没有甚么错处。

examples.en: I wish someone would help me with English composition.
examples.zh: 我希望有人能教我英语作文。

compound.definition:
n. a whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts
n. (chemistry) a substance formed by chemical union of two or more elements or ingredients in definite proportion by weight
n. an enclosure of residences and other building (especially in the Orient)
v. put or add together
compound.translation:
n. 混合物, 复合词, 化合物, 院子
a. 复合的, 混合的, 化合的
vi. 化合, 和解, 妥协
vt. 使复合, 使化合

examples.en: Do you know what compound words are?
examples.zh: 你知道什么是复合词吗？

comprehend.definition: v get the meaning of something\nv to become aware of through the senses\nv include in scope; include as part of something broader; have as one's sphere or territory

examples.en: Many people are unable to comprehend the actions of hackers.
examples.zh: 很多人无法理解黑客们的行为。

examples.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
examples.zh: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

examples.en: The professor was unable to comprehend what I meant.
examples.zh: 教授不明白我说了甚么。

comprehension.definition: n. an ability to understand the meaning or importance of something (or the knowledge acquired as a result)

examples.en: That was beyond my comprehension.
examples.zh: 那超出了我的理解。

examples.en: Good day, lords. In what way can I refine upon my adroitness in aural comprehension?
examples.zh: 早安，师傅。我应该怎么样提高听力能力？

comprehensive.definition: a. including all or everything\ns. broad in scope
comprehensive.translation: a. 广泛的, 有理解力的, 综合的\n[经] 广泛的, 综合的, 全面的

examples.en: The service is also part of a comprehensive subscription plan, allowing users to choose the pricing and features that best fit individual and family needs.
examples.zh: 此服务亦包含于综合订阅方案中，使用者可依个人或家庭方案选择适合的价格与内容。

compromise.definition:
n. a middle way between two extremes
n. an accommodation in which both sides make concessions
v. make a compromise; arrive at a compromise; we all must compromise"
v. settle by concession
compromise.translation: n. 妥协, 折中, 折中方案, 和解\nvi. 妥协处理\nvt. 危害

examples.en: We tried to come to a compromise with them.
examples.zh: 我们试著和他们妥协。

examples.en: In our view, we have already made the biggest possible compromise.
examples.zh: 对于我们来说，这已经是做出了最大限度的让步了。

examples.en: He had refused to compromise on the issue.
examples.zh: 他拒绝在这件事上作出妥协。

compulsory.translation: a. 被强制的, 强迫的, 义务的\n[经] 强迫的, 强制的

examples.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members.
examples.zh: 全员均须出席。

compute.definition: v make a mathematical calculation or computation
compute.translation: v. 计算, 估算\nn. 计算, 估算

examples.en: Can you compute the distance of the moon from the earth?
examples.zh: 你可以把地球和月亮之间的距离计算出来吗？

examples.en: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
examples.zh: 科学家们可以很容易地计算出行星之间的距离。

examples.en: Some of my classmates are pure noobs; they know nothing about computing sciences.
examples.zh: 我的一些同学真是菜鸟，他们一点都不懂计算机。

computer.definition: n. a machine for performing calculations automatically
computer.translation: n. 电脑, 电子计算机\n[计] 计算机

examples.en: I don't know if the computer is good or not.
examples.zh: 不知道电脑好不好。

examples.en: The computer is placed to the left of the women.
examples.zh: 电脑放在女士们的左边。

examples.en: I have to make money to buy a personal computer.
examples.zh: 必须要赚钱才能买一台个人计算机。

conceal.definition: v. hold back; keep from being perceived by others
conceal.translation: vt. 隐藏, 掩盖, 隐瞒\n[法] 隐瞒, 隐匿, 保守秘密

examples.en: We can normally conceal our thoughts from others.
examples.zh: 我们通常会对其他人隐瞒自己的想法.

examples.en: Don't conceal what you feel about it.
examples.zh: 不要隐瞒你对此的想法。

examples.en: The crevice in the boulder on the ocean floor conceals an octopus.
examples.zh: 海底的岩石缝里藏着一只章鱼。

concede.definition:
v. admit (to a wrongdoing)
v. be willing to concede
v. give over; surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another
v. acknowledge defeat
concede.translation: vt. 承认, 退让\nvi. 让步

examples.en: England’s goalkeeper was criticized for the amount of goals he conceded.
examples.zh: 英格兰的守门员因为自己失球过多而被批评。

conceive.translation: vt. 构思, 认为\nvi. 怀孕

examples.en: I can't conceive of living without him.
examples.zh: 我无法想像生命中没有他。

concentrate.definition:
n. a concentrated form of a foodstuff; the bulk is reduced by removing water
n. a concentrated example of something
v. make denser, stronger, or purer
v. direct one's attention on something
concentrate.translation: n. 浓缩, 精选\nv. 集中, 专心

examples.en: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
examples.zh: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。

examples.en: I can't concentrate. Do you mind turning off the TV?
examples.zh: 我没法集中注意力。你介意关掉电视吗?

examples.en: It is too noisy around here; I can't concentrate.
examples.zh: 周围太吵了，我无法专心学习。

concentration.definition:
n. the strength of a solution; number of molecules of a substance in a given volume
n. the spatial property of being crowded together
n. strengthening the concentration (as of a solute in a mixture) by removing diluting material
n. increase in density
concentration.translation: n. 集中, 专心\n[化] 浓度; 浓缩

examples.en: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
examples.zh: 新竹市区的房价因为科技产业聚集而水涨船高。

concept.definition: n. an abstract or general idea inferred or derived from specific instances
concept.translation: n. 观念, 概念\n[医] 概念

examples.en: I really like the concept of this website.
examples.zh: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。

examples.en: They implemented a communication policy so as to promote their new concept.
examples.zh: 他们到位了实行新概念的广告策略。

examples.en: To him, hunger was an abstract concept; he always had enough to eat.
examples.zh: 对他来说，「肚子饿」是个抽象的概念，因为他从来就没有饿过。

concern.definition:
n. something that interests you because it is important or affects you
n. an anxious feeling
n. a feeling of sympathy for someone or something
n. something or someone that causes anxiety; a source of unhappiness
concern.translation: n. 关心, 忧虑\nvt. 与...有关, 使担心, 使挂念

examples.en: Tom always meddles in affairs that do not concern him.
examples.zh: 汤姆总是多管闲事。

examples.en: Don't interfere with matters that do not concern you!
examples.zh: 不要干预不关你的事！

examples.en: My primary concern is your safety.
examples.zh: 我最关心的是你的安全。

concerning.definition: v be relevant to\nv be on the mind of

examples.en: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
examples.zh: 关于下面的内容，我想确认两件事情。

examples.en: Concerning this problem, our views are not the same.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上，我们的看法不一样。

examples.en: Concerning this word, each expert has a different point of view.
examples.zh: 对这个词，专家们各有不同的看法。

concert.definition: n. a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging\nv. contrive (a plan) by mutual agreement\nv. settle by agreement
concert.translation:
n. 音乐会, 和声, 一致
vt. 协力, 协调
vi. 协力
[计] 美国北卡罗来纳州Internet网

examples.en: I would like to go to the concert with you.
examples.zh: 我想和你一起去音乐会。

examples.en: I was sick, so I couldn't go to the concert.
examples.zh: 我生病了，所以没能去看演唱会。

examples.en: I wish I had bought a ticket for the concert.
examples.zh: 我当初要是买音乐会的票就好了。

conclude.definition:
v. bring to a close
v. reach a conclusion after a discussion or deliberation
v. come to a close
v. reach agreement on
conclude.translation: vt. 结束, 作结论, 推断\nvi. 结束, 推断

examples.en: From this you can conclude that feminism is still necessary.
examples.zh: 从这来看，你能因此论定女权主义还是必要的。

examples.en: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
examples.zh: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。

examples.en: After looking at the research, most of us conclude that vaccines are a good thing.
examples.zh: 看完研究以后，我们其中大部分人论定疫苗是件好事。

conclusion.definition:
n. an intuitive assumption
n. the proposition arrived at by logical reasoning (such as the proposition that must follow from the major and minor premises of a syllogism)
n. a final settlement
n. the last section of a communication
conclusion.translation: n. 结论, 结尾, 推论\n[法] 缔结, 结论, 推论

examples.en: I came to the conclusion that I had been deceived.
examples.zh: 我得到一个结论 ﹣ 我被骗了。

examples.en: Our conclusion is based on previous studies of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们的结论基于之前对这个问题的研究。

examples.en: We spent three hours to come to this conclusion.
examples.zh: 做出这个结论花了我们三个小时。

concrete.definition:
n. a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water
v. cover with cement
v. form into a solid mass; coalesce
a. capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
concrete.translation: n. 凝结物, 混凝土\na. 具体的, 实在的, 混凝土的\nv. (使)凝结, 用混凝土浇筑

examples.en: When we looked down, we saw a concrete jungle.
examples.zh: 我们往下看，是一片水泥丛林。

examples.en: Looking down, we saw a concrete jungle.
examples.zh: 我们往下看，是一片水泥丛林。

examples.en: He was only bothered about concrete questions.
examples.zh: 他一向只关心具体问题。

condemn.definition:
v. express strong disapproval of
v. declare or judge unfit for use or habitation
v. compel or force into a particular state or activity
v. demonstrate the guilt of (someone)
condemn.translation: vt. 判刑, 责备, 谴责\n[法] 定罪, 判刑, 宣告有罪

examples.en: It is important to condemn racism, but that alone is not enough.
examples.zh: 谴责种族主义很重要，但光是谴责种族主义是不够的。

examples.en: Your soul has been condemned to hell.
examples.zh: 你的灵魂已坠进了地狱。

examples.en: Shocked by the events of September 11th, politicians all over the world condemned the terrorists for their reprehensible deed.
examples.zh: 911事件让世人震惊，全球所有的政治家都一致谴责恐怖分子的这一应受人斥责的行径。

condition.definition:
n. a state at a particular time
n. an assumption on which rests the validity or effect of something else
n. a mode of being or form of existence of a person or thing
n. the state of (good) health (especially in the phrases `in condition' or `in shape' or `out of condition' or `out of shape')
condition.translation: n. 情况, 条件\nvt. 使健康, 以...为条件, 决定, 使适应\n[计] 条件

examples.en: This patient's condition is getting worse day by day.
examples.zh: 这病人的情况一天比一天糟。

examples.en: He does not seem pleased with his condition.
examples.zh: 他似乎对自己的状况不满意。

examples.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.
examples.zh: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。

conduct.definition: v. direct the course of; manage or control\nv. lead, as in the performance of a composition; Barenboim conducted the Chicago symphony for years"\nv. lead musicians in the performance of
conduct.translation: n. 行为, 举动, 指导\nvt. 为人, 指挥, 管理, 实施\nvi. 领导, 传导, 指挥

examples.en: One must be responsible for one's conduct.
examples.zh: 人要为自己的行为负责。

examples.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
examples.zh: 他们在无重力状态下进行了一连串的实验。

examples.en: I don't approve of his conduct.
examples.zh: 我不认可他的行为。

conductor.definition:
n. the person who leads a musical group
n. a substance that readily conducts e.g. electricity and heat
n. the person who collects fares on a public conveyance
n. a device designed to transmit electricity, heat, etc.
conductor.translation: n. 领导者, 指挥者, 售票员, 向导\n[化] 导体

examples.en: Ziri was the conductor of the train that crashed in 2004.
Elias produced his ticket and showed it to the conductor.
He stands alone as a conductor of ballet music.

conference.definition: n. a prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda)\nn. a discussion among participants who have an agreed (serious) topic
conference.translation: n. 会议\n[经] 会议, 讨论会, 协商会

examples.en: Tom and Mary participated in a model U.N. conference.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽参加了一个模拟联合国会议。

examples.en: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
examples.zh: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。

examples.en: The abbreviation of "Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference" is "CPPCC".
examples.zh: “中国人民政治协商会议”的简称是“人民政协”。

confess.definition: v. confess to a punishable or reprehensible deed, usually under pressure\nv. confess to God in the presence of a priest, as in the Catholic faith
confess.translation: v. 承认, 坦白, 忏悔, 供认

examples.en: There's no point torturing him anymore, he won't confess.
examples.zh: 再折磨他也没用，他不会招供的。

examples.en: There's no point in torturing him, he isn't going to confess.
examples.zh: 再折磨他也没用，他不会招供的。

examples.en: Dan eventually confessed that he got the gun from Linda.
examples.zh: 丹最后承认他从琳达那里拿到枪。

confidence.definition:
n. a feeling of trust (in someone or something)
n. a state of confident hopefulness that events will be favorable
n. a trustful relationship
n. a secret that is confided or entrusted to another

examples.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
examples.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

examples.en: Where does all that confidence come from?
examples.zh: 哪来那么大的自信啊？

examples.en: He has what I lack; confidence.
examples.zh: 他有我所缺乏的东西: 信心。

confident.definition: a. having or marked by confidence or assurance\ns. not liable to error in judgment or action
confident.translation: a. 有信心的, 有把握的

examples.en: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
examples.zh: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。

examples.en: I'm fairly confident I can do that.
examples.zh: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。

examples.en: Tom is very confident, isn't he?
examples.zh: 汤姆很有信心，不是么？

confidential.definition:
s. entrusted with private information and the confidence of another
s. (of information) given in confidence or in secret
s. denoting confidence or intimacy
s. the level of official classification for documents next above restricted and below secret; available only to persons authorized to see documents so classified
confidential.translation: a. 机密的, 获他人信赖的, 易于信任他人的\n[经] 秘密件

examples.en: I know where you live, Madam. But that is confidential.
Layla's new job gave her access to confidential prison files.
Layla's job gave her access to lots of confidential information.

confine.definition: v. prevent from leaving or from being removed\nv. deprive of freedom; take into confinement
confine.translation: vt. 限制, 使不外出, 禁闭\nvi. 邻接, 交界\nn. 边缘, 范围, 区域

examples.en: He is confined to bed now.
examples.zh: 他现在卧床不起。

confirm.definition:
v. establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts
v. strengthen or make more firm
v. make more firm
v. support a person for a position
confirm.translation: vt. 证实, 确定, 批准, 使巩固\n[计] 确认

examples.en: Can you confirm that it is a correctable error?
examples.zh: 你确认那是可纠正的错误吗？

examples.en: I want to quickly confirm my flight again.
examples.zh: 我想要再确认一下我的航班。

examples.en: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
examples.zh: 我既不能确认也不能否定。

conflict.definition:
n. an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)
n. opposition between two simultaneous but incompatible feelings
n. a state of opposition between persons or ideas or interests
n. an incompatibility of dates or events
conflict.translation: n. 战斗, 冲突, 矛盾, 争执\nvi. 争执, 战斗, 冲突, 抵触\n[计] 冲突

examples.en: Diplomatic dialogue helped put an end to the conflict.
examples.zh: 外交谈判帮助结束了冲突。

examples.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
examples.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

examples.en: Euthanasia comes into conflict with the Hippocratic oath.
examples.zh: 安乐死与希波克拉底誓言相冲突。

conform.definition: v. be similar, be in line with
conform.translation: vt. 使一致, 使遵守, 使符合\nvi. 一致, 符合, 适应

examples.en: We must conform to the rules.
examples.zh: 我们必须遵守规则。

confront.definition:
v. oppose, as in hostility or a competition
v. deal with (something unpleasant) head on
v. present somebody with something, usually to accuse or criticize
v. be face to face with
confront.translation: vt. 使面对, 对抗, 遭遇, 使对质, 比较\n[法] 对证, 使对质, 比较

examples.en: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
examples.zh: 日本正面临著严重的经济问题。

examples.en: I didn't confront them.
examples.zh: 我没跟他们发生冲突。

examples.en: He is confronted by many difficulties.
examples.zh: 他面临著许多困难。

confuse.definition:
v. mistake one thing for another
v. be confusing or perplexing to; cause to be unable to think clearly
v. cause to feel embarrassment
v. make unclear, indistinct, or blurred
confuse.translation: vt. 使混乱, 使狼狈, 使困惑\n[法] 混淆

examples.en: We must never confuse the two.
examples.zh: 我们决不能把它两个混淆。

examples.en: That was the part that Tom and I were most confused about.
examples.zh: 这是我和汤姆最困惑的部分。

examples.en: Never confuse pity with love.
examples.zh: 同情心和爱心绝不可混为一谈。

confusion.definition:
n. disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably
n. a mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior
n. a feeling of embarrassment that leaves you confused
n. an act causing a disorderly combination of elements with identities lost and distinctions blended
confusion.translation: n. 混乱, 混淆, 无秩序\n[计] 含混

examples.en: Every function should have comments describing its purpose in order to avoid confusion.
examples.zh: 每一个函数都应该有描述其目的的注释以避免误解。

examples.en: The accident caused traffic confusion.
examples.zh: 那场意外使交通大乱。

congress.definition: n. the legislature of the United States government\nn. a meeting of elected or appointed representatives\nn. a national legislative assembly
congress.translation: n. 国会, 会议, 讨论会\n[医] 会议, 会合

examples.en: Tom is running for Congress.
examples.zh: 汤姆在竞选国会议员。

connect.definition:
v. connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces
v. be or become joined or united or linked
v. join by means of communication equipment
v. land on or hit solidly
connect.translation: v. 连接, 联合, 联系

examples.en: I often use SSH to remotely connect to my computer.
examples.zh: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。

examples.en: Do you feel like you can't connect with other people?
examples.zh: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？

examples.en: Do you feel like you cannot connect with other people?
examples.zh: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？

connection.definition:
n. a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it)
n. the state of being connected
n. an instrumentality that connects
n. (usually plural) a person who is influential and to whom you are connected in some way (as by family or friendship)
connection.translation: n. 连接, 关系, 前后关系\n[计] 连接

examples.en: That parrot was Tobias's only connection with his late father.
examples.zh: 那只鹦鹉是托比亚斯与他已故父亲之间唯一的连结。

examples.en: A connection between personality and blood type has not been scientifically proven.
examples.zh: 科学上，血型和性格的关联性没有被证明。

examples.en: Why is my Internet connection so slow?
examples.zh: 我的网怎么会这么慢？

conquer.translation: vt. 克服, 征服, 战胜\nvi. 得胜

examples.en: Do you know who conquered Mt. Everest first?
examples.zh: 你知道是谁第一个征服珠穆朗玛峰的吗?

examples.en: They can conquer their fear.
examples.zh: 他们可以克服恐惧。

examples.en: I came, I saw, I conquered.
examples.zh: 我来，我见，我征服。

conscience.definition: n. motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions\nn. conformity to one's own sense of right conduct\nn. a feeling of shame when you do something immoral
conscience.translation: n. 良心\n[法] 良心, 道德感, 正义感

examples.en: A clear conscience is an extraordinarily soft pillow.
examples.zh: 问心无愧是一个非常柔软的枕头。

examples.en: "Having a clear conscience" is an idiom.
examples.zh: 问心无愧是一个成语。

examples.en: Do you have a guilty conscience?
examples.zh: 是你心里有鬼吧？

conscious.definition: s. intentionally conceived\na. knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts\ns. (followed by `of') showing realization or recognition of something
conscious.translation: a. 有意识的, 知觉的, 觉察的\n[医] 有意识的, 清醒的

examples.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
examples.zh: 战士知道自己的力量和弱点。

examples.en: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
examples.zh: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。

examples.en: Tom is environmentally conscious.
examples.zh: 汤姆有环保意识。

consciousness.definition: n. an alert cognitive state in which you are aware of yourself and your situation
consciousness.translation: n. 意识, 知觉, 自觉\n[医] (有)意识, 清醒

examples.en: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.
examples.zh: 他在麻醉剂的作用下，他失去了知觉。

examples.en: He regained consciousness and was able to talk.
examples.zh: 他恢复了意识，还能开口说话了。

examples.en: Suddenly everything went black and I lost consciousness.
examples.zh: 突然一切变成漆黑一片，我失去了意识。

consensus.definition: n. agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
consensus.translation: n. 合意, 一致, 同感\n[计] 合意

examples.en: Just what time period is "Hong Fan" a product of? Although people have debated this issue for ages, there is still no clear consensus to this day.
examples.zh: 《洪范》到底是什么时代的作品, 千百年来人们见仁见智, 至今仍无定论。

consent.translation: n. 同意, 许可\nvi. 同意, 赞同

examples.en: Do you give your consent to the operation?
examples.zh: 你是否同意手术？

examples.en: We will only consent on that condition.
examples.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

examples.en: He consented to help the old lady.
examples.zh: 他同意帮助这位老太太。

consequence.definition: n. a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon\nn. the outcome of an event especially as relative to an individual\nn. having important effects or influence
consequence.translation: n. 结果, 重要性\n[法] 结果, 后果, 推断

examples.en: It is of no consequence to me that he is coming.
examples.zh: 他要来这件事对我而言无关紧要。

examples.en: Don't run away from consequences, don't fear them; face them.
examples.zh: 不要逃避后果，别怕它们；面对它们。

examples.en: As a consequence, additional tests must be carried out to ensure complete security.
examples.zh: 因此，必须进行额外的测试以确保完整的安全性。

consequently.definition: r. (sentence connectors) because of the reason given\nr. as a consequence

examples.en: Monsieur D'Espilly, in the year 1772, calculated the population of France at upwards of 22 millions; namely, 10,562,631 males, and 11,451,726 females; consequently the proportion of females to males was about 14 to 13.
examples.zh: 1772 年，埃斯皮利先生计算出法国人口超过 2,200 万人；其中男性 10,562,631 人，女性 11,451,726 人；因此，女性与男性的比例约为 14 比 13。

conservation.definition: n. an occurrence of improvement by virtue of preventing loss or injury or other change\nn. the preservation and careful management of the environment and of natural resources\nn. (physics) the maintenance of a certain quantities unchanged during chemical reactions or physical transformations
conservation.translation: n. 保护, 保存\n[医] 保存

examples.en: During the holidays, some university students go to Africa as volunteers and help to perfect local wildlife conservation.
examples.zh: 一些大学生在假期去非洲做志愿者 ，帮助当地完善野生生物管理。

examples.en: The giant panda is recognised as a national treasure of China, but in some conservation areas it is still killed by poachers.
examples.zh: 大熊猫被认为是中国的国宝，但在一些保护区，它仍被偷猎。

conservative.definition:
n. a person who is reluctant to accept changes and new ideas
n. a member of a Conservative Party
a. resistant to change
s. having social or political views favoring conservatism
conservative.translation: a. 保守的, 守旧的, 有保存力的\n[化] 防腐剂; 保存剂

examples.en: Many conservative women still can't accept fishnet stockings.
examples.zh: 很多保守的女生还是接受不了网袜。

examples.en: A conservative is not always a reactionary.
examples.zh: 保守分子不一定是反动分子。

examples.en: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.
examples.zh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。

conserve.definition:
n. fruit preserved by cooking with sugar
v. keep constant through physical or chemical reactions or evolutionary change
v. keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction
v. use cautiously and frugally
conserve.translation: n. 蜜饯, 果酱\nvt. 保存, 使(能量等)守恒

examples.en: It's important to conserve energy, so switch off the lights.
Don't overwork yourself. You must conserve your energy for tomorrow.
We need to conserve energy, so lights off, please.

consider.definition:
v. take into consideration for exemplifying purposes
v. show consideration for; take into account
v. think about carefully; weigh
v. regard or treat with consideration, respect, and esteem
consider.translation: v. 考虑, 思考, 认为

examples.en: Many Chinese people consider red to be the best colour.
examples.zh: 很多中国人认为红色是最好的颜色。

examples.en: Some analysts consider Somalia as the failed state par excellence.
examples.zh: 一些分析家认为索马里是非常失败的国家。

examples.en: Please consider that the maximum doesn't exist in some circumstances.
examples.zh: 请考虑一下，最大值在有些情况下是不存在的。

considerable.definition: a. large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree
considerable.translation: a. 相当的, 可观的, 重要的

examples.en: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
examples.zh: 已经花费了很多的时间和精力。

consideration.definition:
n. the process of giving careful thought to something
n. a discussion of a topic (as in a meeting)
n. kind and considerate regard for others
n. a considerate and thoughtful act
consideration.translation: n. 考虑, 原因\n[法] 考虑, 思考, 报酬

examples.en: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
examples.zh: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

examples.en: We should have taken the schedule into consideration.
examples.zh: 我们本该考虑一下行程。

examples.en: I gave careful consideration to the problem.
examples.zh: 我仔细地考虑了这个问题。

consist.definition: v. have its essential character; be comprised or contained in; be embodied in\nv. be consistent in form, tenor, or character; be congruous\nv. be composed of
consist.translation: vi. 组成, 存在于, 一致

examples.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
examples.zh: 我们呼吸的空气是由氧气和氮气组成的。

examples.en: The bat's diet consists mainly of insects and fruit.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠的食物主要包括昆虫和水果。

examples.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
examples.zh: 他的薪水包括基本工资和提成。

consistent.definition: a. (sometimes followed by `with') in agreement or consistent or reliable\ns. the same throughout in structure or composition
consistent.translation: a. 一致的, 坚持的, 并立的, 坚固的

examples.en: His daily behavior is not consistent with his principles.
examples.zh: 他的日常行为并不和他的原则相一致。

examples.en: Her behavior is consistent with her words.
examples.zh: 她言行一致。

consolidate.definition:
v. unite into one
v. make firm or secure; strengthen
v. bring together into a single whole or system
v. form into a solid mass or whole
consolidate.translation: vt. 巩固, 使联合, 统一\nvi. 巩固\n[计] 合并计算

examples.en: The fake king plays golf while the real king consolidates his power.
examples.zh: 真正的王在巩固他的权利，然而虚假的王却在打高尔夫。

conspiracy.definition: n. a secret agreement between two or more people to perform an unlawful act\nn. a plot to carry out some harmful or illegal act (especially a political plot)\nn. a group of conspirators banded together to achieve some harmful or illegal purpose
conspiracy.translation: n. 同谋, 阴谋, 阴谋集团\n[法] 阴谋, 通谋, 共谋

examples.en: My friend believes conspiracy theories; should I try to prove him wrong?
examples.zh: 我的朋友相信阴谋论，我该试着向他指出他错了吗？

constant.definition: n. a quantity that does not vary\nn. a number representing a quantity assumed to have a fixed value in a specified mathematical context\na. steadfast in purpose or devotion or affection
constant.translation: n. 常数, 恒量\na. 不变的, 一定的, 时常的\n[计] 常量; 常数; 恒值

examples.en: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
examples.zh: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。

examples.en: Constant dripping wears away a stone.
examples.zh: 水滴石穿。

examples.en: Lately there have been constant dance rehearsals; Performances will be on Friday and Saturday.
examples.zh: 最近一直在舞蹈排练，周五周六要演出啊。

constantly.definition: r. without variation or change, in every case\nr. without interruption
constantly.translation: adv. 不变地, 不断地, 时常地

examples.en: The Red Cross constantly supplies food to the disaster areas.
examples.zh: 红十字会不断地给灾区提供食物援助。

examples.en: I constantly went over this problem in my mind.
examples.zh: 我的脑海里不停地翻腾着这个问题。

examples.en: She is constantly in and out of hospital.
examples.zh: 她一直在进进出出医院。

constitute.translation: vt. 构成, 组成, 任命\n[建] 构造, 组成

examples.en: These things constitute a balanced meal.
examples.zh: 这些东西构成了一顿营养均衡的饭。

examples.en: A committee was constituted to investigate prices.
examples.zh: 为了调查物价，成立了一个委员会。

constitution.definition: n. the act of forming or establishing something\nn. the way in which someone or something is composed\nn. a United States 44-gun frigate that was one of the first three naval ships built by the United States; it won brilliant victories over British frigates during the War of 1812 and is without doubt the most famous ship in the history of the United States Navy; it has been rebuilt and is anchored in the Charlestown Navy Yard in Boston
constitution.translation: n. 构成, 宪法, 体格\n[医] 体质; 结构, 组织

examples.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.
examples.zh: 思想自由为宪法所保障。

examples.en: The U.S. Constitution was poorly written.
examples.zh: 美国宪法写得很烂。

examples.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
examples.zh: 平等是由宪法保障的。

construct.definition:
v. make by combining materials and parts
v. draw with suitable instruments and under specified conditions
v. create by linking linguistic units
v. create by organizing and linking ideas, arguments, or concepts
construct.translation: vt. 构造, 建造, 对...进行构思, 作图\nn. 构成物

examples.en: The purpose of criticism is to construct, not to destroy.
examples.zh: 批评的目的是建设而不是破坏。

examples.en: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.
examples.zh: 读完他的书后，我觉得我可以构建一栋房子。

examples.en: Take my hand. The two of us are going to construct a utopia.
examples.zh: 握著我的手。我们两个将要建立一个乌托邦。

construction.definition:
n. the act of constructing something
n. a group of words that form a constituent of a sentence and are considered as a single unit
n. the creation of a construct; the process of combining ideas into a congruous object of thought
n. drawing a figure satisfying certain conditions as part of solving a problem or proving a theorem
construction.translation: n. 建筑, 构造, 建筑物\n[化] 施工

examples.en: There is a shortage of good construction timber right now.
examples.zh: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。

examples.en: I need to go to the China Construction Bank.
examples.zh: 我需要去一趟中国建设银行。

examples.en: The first phase of construction has been completed.
examples.zh: 工程的第一阶段已经完成了。

consult.definition: v. get or ask advice from\nv. seek information from\nv. advise professionally
consult.translation: vi. 商讨, 商量, 协商, 会诊\nvt. 向...请教, 查阅, 考虑

examples.en: You should consult with a pharmacist before buying that medicine.
examples.zh: 你在买这药之前应该问一下药剂师的建议。

examples.en: Why didn't you consult me before taking this decision?
examples.zh: 你做这个决定之前，为什么不先问过我？

examples.en: He's already retired but is often asked by them to consult.
examples.zh: 已经退休了，但还常常被他们请去做顾问。

consultant.definition: n an expert who gives advice
consultant.translation: n. 顾问, 征询意见者\n[医] 顾问医师

examples.en: Don't worry, I also happen to be a financial consultant.
I work as a web consultant on the side.
The debate over which consultant to use went on for hours.

consume.definition:
v. serve oneself to, or consume regularly
v. spend extravagantly
v. destroy completely
v. use up (resources or materials)
consume.translation: vt. 消耗, 消费, 消灭\nvi. 耗尽, 毁灭

examples.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
examples.zh: 瑞士人消耗不少啤酒。

examples.en: Zeal for your house will consume me.
examples.zh: 我为你的殿，心里焦急，如同火烧。

examples.en: That fat girl consumes too much sugary food.
examples.zh: 那个胖女孩吃了太多含高糖份的饮食。

consumer.definition: n. a person who uses goods or services
consumer.translation: n. 消费者\n[经] 消费者, 用户

examples.en: Europeans are the largest consumers of alcohol in the world.
examples.zh: 欧洲人是世界上最大的酒精消费者。

examples.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
examples.zh: 公司欢迎消费者对他们产品的反馈

examples.en: Europeans are the world's largest consumers of alcohol.
examples.zh: 欧洲人是世界上最大的酒精消费者。

consumption.definition: n. the process of taking food into the body through the mouth (as by eating)\nn. (economics) the utilization of economic goods to satisfy needs or in manufacturing\nn. the act of consuming something
consumption.translation: n. 消费, 消费量, 痨病\n[化] 消耗量; 耗量

examples.en: In America, the consumption of fast-food has tripled between 1977 and 1995.
examples.zh: 美国人快餐食物的消耗量在一九七七至一九九五年间大幅增长了三倍。

examples.en: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.
examples.zh: 东欧的酒精消耗量比西欧高。

examples.en: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
examples.zh: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。

contact.definition:
n. close interaction
n. the act of touching physically
n. the state or condition of touching or of being in immediate proximity
n. the physical coming together of two or more things
contact.translation: n. 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触\nvi. 接触, 联系\nvt. 使接触

examples.en: We'll contact you by phone as soon as we arrive.
examples.zh: 我们到了就打电话跟您联系。

examples.en: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?
examples.zh: 你还和你的高中同学保持联系吗？

examples.en: Our staff will contact you in three working days.
examples.zh: 我们的工作人员会在三个工作日内联系您。

contain.definition: v. be divisible by\nv. be capable of holding or containing
contain.translation: vt. 包含, 容纳, 控制\nvi. 自制

examples.en: This bottle is able to contain two liters of hot water.
examples.zh: 这个瓶子可以装两升热水。

examples.en: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.
examples.zh: 这个垃圾袋不含任何有害化学物质。

examples.en: This room is too small to contain 50 men.
examples.zh: 这房间太小了，容纳不下五十人。

container.definition: n. any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)
container.translation: n. 容器, 集装箱\n[化] 集装箱; 贮存箱; 容器(任何一种)

examples.en: These containers are airtight.
examples.zh: 这些容器是密封的。

contaminate.definition: v. make radioactive by adding radioactive material
contaminate.translation: vt. 弄污, 弄脏, 污染, 毒害\n[化] 污染

examples.en: A cell phone is as contaminated with bacteria as a toilet is.
examples.zh: 手机如同马桶一样被细菌污染。

examples.en: Twenty-five years after Chernobyl, milk, mushrooms and berries are still contaminated in some parts of Ukraine.
examples.zh: 在切尔诺贝利核电厂事故二十五年后，在乌克兰的某些地区，牛奶，蘑菇和浆果仍然受到了污染。

contemplate.definition: v. look at thoughtfully; observe deep in thought\nv. consider as a possibility
contemplate.translation: vt. 注视, 沉思, 盘算\nvi. 冥思苦想

examples.en: He is contemplating whether or not to buy the book.
examples.zh: 他在纠结要不要买这本书

examples.en: He contemplated taking a trip to Paris.
examples.zh: 他打算去巴黎旅行。

examples.en: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
examples.zh: 他思考着现代生活的复杂性。

contemporary.definition: n. a person of nearly the same age as another\ns. characteristic of the present\ns. belonging to the present time
contemporary.translation: n. 同时代的人\na. 同时代的, 属于同一时期的

examples.en: Contemporary Chinese youth culture is very shallow.
examples.zh: 中国的当代青年文化很空洞。

examples.en: He's contemplating the complexity of contemporary life.
examples.zh: 他思考着现代生活的复杂性。

examples.en: He studies contemporary literature.
examples.zh: 他学习现代文学。

contempt.definition:
n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n. a manner that is generally disrespectful and contemptuous
n. open disrespect for a person or thing
n. a willful disobedience to or disrespect for the authority of a court or legislative body
contempt.translation: n. 轻视, 轻蔑\n[法] 藐视, 侮辱, 轻视

examples.en: He is below contempt.
examples.zh: 他让人讨厌透顶。

contend.definition: v. maintain or assert\nv. be engaged in a fight; carry on a fight
contend.translation: vi. 奋斗, 斗争, 竞争\nvt. 为...斗争

examples.en: He has to contend with many difficulties in his new job.
Against stupidity, the gods themselves contend in vain.
A canny one, I do contend, simply tips their glass on end.

content.definition:
n. everything that is included in a collection and that is held or included in something
n. the proportion of a substance that is contained in a mixture or alloy etc.
n. the sum or range of what has been perceived, discovered, or learned
v. satisfy in a limited way
content.translation:
n. 内容, 满足, 意义, 要旨
a. 满足的, 满意的
vt. 使...满足, 使...安心
[计] 内容

examples.en: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
examples.zh: 关于下面的内容，我想确认两件事情。

examples.en: She says that she is content with her life.
examples.zh: 她说很满意她的生活。

examples.en: Use your own words to retell the content of the lesson.
examples.zh: 用自己的语言把课文内容复述。

contest.definition: n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants\nn. a struggle between rivals\nv. to make the subject of dispute, contention, or litigation
contest.translation: n. 竞赛, 争论\nvt. 竞争, 争取, 争辩\nvi. 竞争

examples.en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
examples.zh: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。

examples.en: She won first prize in the speech contest.
examples.zh: 她在演讲比赛中取得了第一名。

examples.en: She got first prize in the eating contest.
examples.zh: 她在吃东西比赛里得了一等奖。

context.definition: n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation\nn. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
context.translation: n. 上下文, 背景, 来龙去脉\nn. 上下文\n[计] 上下文

examples.en: Get the meaning of a word from its context.
examples.zh: 从前文后理来推断一个字的意思。

examples.en: If you don't understand something, it's because you aren't aware of its context.
examples.zh: 如果你不明白一件事，那是因为你没有意识到它的背景。

examples.en: The meaning of a word is determined by the context where it is used.
examples.zh: 一个字的意思是由上文下理决定的。

continent.definition: n. one of the large landmasses of the earth\nn. the European mainland\na. having control over urination and defecation
continent.translation: n. 大陆, 洲\na. 自制的

examples.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
examples.zh: 哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。

examples.en: The Himalayas are a mountain range located on the Asian continent.
examples.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉是位于亚洲大陆的山脉。

examples.en: Africa is a continent, but Greenland is not.
examples.zh: 非洲是一个大陆, 而格陵兰不是。

continual.definition: a. occurring without interruption; chiefly restricted to what recurs regularly or frequently in a prolonged and closely spaced series\ns. `continual' (meaning seemingly uninterrupted) is often used interchangeably with `continuous' (meaning without interruption)
continual.translation: a. 持续不断的, 继续的\n[建] 连续的

examples.en: Today is the fifth day of continual stock price decline.
He struggled to deal with her continual criticism of him.
You're a continual source of wonder for me.

continue.definition:
v. continue a certain state, condition, or activity
v. continue talking
v. keep or maintain in unaltered condition; cause to remain or last
v. do something repeatedly and showing no intention to stop
continue.translation: vi. 继续, 延续, 延长\nvt. 使继续, 使延长

examples.en: For how long will I continue to have these symptoms?
examples.zh: 这种症状在我身上将会持续多久？

examples.en: There's really no way to continue this conversation any longer.
examples.zh: 这场谈话真是无法再进行下去了。

examples.en: She asked me to continue writing to your father.
examples.zh: 她叫我继续写信给你的父亲。

continuous.definition: a. continuing in time or space without interruption\na. of a function or curve; extending without break or irregularity
continuous.translation: a. 连续的, 继续的, 连续不断的\n[计] 连续的

examples.en: But your function isn't Lipschitz continuous!
examples.zh: 可是你的函数不符合利普希茨条件！

examples.en: The cerebellum requires continuous blood supply.
examples.zh: 小脑需要连续不断的血液供给。

contract.definition:
n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
n. (contract bridge) the highest bid becomes the contract setting the number of tricks that the bidder must make
n. a variety of bridge in which the bidder receives points toward game only for the number of tricks he bid
v. enter into a contractual arrangement
contract.translation: n. 合约, 婚约, 契约\nvt. 使皱缩, 使缩短, 感染, 订约, 缔结\nvi. 皱缩, 订约, 收缩

examples.en: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
examples.zh: 你在签字前必须仔细看合同。

examples.en: They made him sign the contract against his will.
examples.zh: 他被强迫签了约。

examples.en: This company and I have signed a three-year contract.
examples.zh: 我跟公司签了一份三年的合同。

contractor.definition: n. someone (a person or firm) who contracts to build things\nn. the bridge player in contract bridge who wins the bidding and can declare which suit is to be trumps\nn. (law) a party to a contract
contractor.translation: n. 立契约的人, 承包商\n[化] 承包者; 承包工厂

examples.en: I can't calculate the final cost without first discussing it with our contractors.
examples.zh: 不先与我们的承包商讨论的话我无法计算出最后的费用。

contradict.definition: v. be in contradiction with\nv. deny the truth of
contradict.translation: vt. 反驳, 与...抵触, 与...矛盾\nvi. 反驳

examples.en: I cannot forbid a person to marry several wives, for it does not contradict Scripture.
examples.zh: 我不能禁止一个人娶好几个妻子，因为这与圣经不矛盾。

contradiction.definition: n. opposition between two conflicting forces or ideas\nn. (logic) a statement that is necessarily false\nn. the speech act of contradicting someone
contradiction.translation: n. 反驳, 矛盾\n[法] 矛盾, 否认, 反驳

examples.en: From what stems this contradiction between our hopes and our reality?
examples.zh: 希望与现实之间的矛盾，因何而起？

contrary.definition:
n. exact opposition
n. a logical relation such that two propositions are contraries if both cannot be true but both can be false
s. very opposed in nature or character or purpose
s. of words or propositions so related that both cannot be true but both may be false
contrary.translation: a. 相反的, 矛盾的, 对立的\nn. 相反, 对立面\nadv. 相反地

examples.en: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.
examples.zh: 然而，相反的理论往往也是真的。

examples.en: On the contrary, I've never said such a thing.
examples.zh: 正好相反，我从没说过这样的话。

examples.en: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.
examples.zh: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。

contrast.definition:
n. the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared
n. the act of distinguishing by comparing differences
n. the perceptual effect of the juxtaposition of very different colors
n. the range of optical density and tone on a photographic negative or print (or the extent to which adjacent areas on a television screen differ in brightness)
contrast.translation:
n. 差别, 对比, 对照物
vt. 使对比
vi. 成对照
[计] 反差; 对比度

examples.en: The picture is colorful in contrast with this one.
examples.zh: 和这幅比起上来，那幅画的色彩鲜艳多了。

examples.en: The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
examples.zh: 下面的解释是通过比较和对比各种不同的理论。

examples.en: Slender and form-fitting with a high cut, the new qipao contrasted sharply with the traditional one.
examples.zh: 新的旗袍又修长又紧身，也有短裙摆，与传统式样构成了鲜明的对比。

contribute.definition: v. contribute to some cause\nv. be conducive to
contribute.translation: vt. 有助于, 捐助, 投稿\nvi. 出力, 捐献, 投稿

examples.en: Tom has contributed a lot of money to this hospital.
examples.zh: 汤姆捐献了很多钱给这间医院。

examples.en: Melting polar icecaps could also contribute to an increase in sea levels.
examples.zh: 融化中的极地冰盖也可以使海平面上涨的势态更加严重。

examples.en: How do I contribute audio in Tatoeba?
examples.zh: 我如何在Tatoeba贡献音频?

contribution.definition:
n. the part played by a person in bringing about a result
n. a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause
n. act of giving in common with others for a common purpose especially to a charity
n. an amount of money contributed
contribution.translation: n. 捐助, 捐助之物, 贡献\n[经] 贡献, 捐款, 补助品

examples.en: Thank you for all your contributions. We expect to see you again soon.
examples.zh: 谢谢您的贡献。预计我们很快又会见面。

control.definition:
n. power to direct or determine
n. a relation of constraint of one entity (thing or person or group) by another
n. (physiology) regulation or maintenance of a function or action or reflex etc
n. the activity of managing or exerting control over something
control.translation: n. 控制, 管理, 克制, 控制器, 操纵装置\nvt. 控制, 操纵, 抑制\n[计] 控制; 控制器

examples.en: You should learn how to control that mood of yours.
examples.zh: 您应该学会控制自己的情绪。

examples.en: When it comes to sweets, I just can't control myself.
examples.zh: 一看到甜点，我就无法自拔。

examples.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
examples.zh: 分支和合并是版本控制的两种基本操作。

controversial.definition: a. marked by or capable of arousing controversy
controversial.translation: a. 争论的, 论争的, 被议论的

examples.en: He sows discord by raising controversial subjects.
examples.zh: 他挑起争议性高的话题，制造纷争。

examples.en: This theory is very controversial.
examples.zh: 这个理论很有争议。

examples.en: This movie is highly controversial.
examples.zh: 这个电影很有争议。

controversy.definition: n. a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
controversy.translation: n. 论争, 辩论, 论战, 争论\n[法] 论战, 争论, 争吵

examples.en: He has a taste for controversy for its own sake.
This artwork excited much controversy in the world of art.
Suddenly, Mary found herself in the middle of a controversy.

convenience.definition: n. the state of being suitable or opportune\nn. the quality of being useful and convenient
convenience.translation: n. 方便, 便利的事物, 方便的时候

examples.en: Why don't you drop in for tea at your convenience?
examples.zh: 你有空的时候来喝杯茶吧。

examples.en: It started raining on my way to the convenience store.
examples.zh: 在我去便利商店的路上，天开始下雨了。

examples.en: I bought meat buns at the convenience store and ate them.
examples.zh: 我在便利店买了肉包吃了。

convenient.definition: a. suited to your comfort or purpose or needs
convenient.translation: a. 方便的, 合宜的\n[法] 适当的, 合理而可行的, 方便的

examples.en: It's convenient for me to see you at ten tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚10点见你比较方便。

examples.en: What's the most convenient way to get to Tokyo Station?
examples.zh: 去东京站怎么走最方便？

examples.en: What is the most convenient route to your place?
examples.zh: 去您那儿怎么走最方便？

convention.definition:
n. a large formal assembly
n. something regarded as a normative example
n. (diplomacy) an international agreement
n. the act of convening
convention.translation: n. 大会, 协定, 惯例, 约定\n[计] 约定

examples.en: Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.
examples.zh: 不遵守命名规则会导致解析错误。

examples.en: The first time, I spoke pretty much no Chinese at all, and didn't understand China's conventions and customs.
examples.zh: 第一次，我差不多完全不会普通话，而且不懂中国的常规和传统。

conventional.definition:
a. following accepted customs and proprieties
s. conforming with accepted standards
a. (weapons) using energy for propulsion or destruction that is not nuclear energy
a. unimaginative and conformist
conventional.translation: a. 传统的, 习惯的, 约定的\n[经] 惯例的, 常规的, 传统的

examples.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
examples.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。

conversation.definition: n. the use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
conversation.translation: n. 会话, 说话, 交谈\n[法] 交谈, 社交, 性交

examples.en: What is your reason for soliciting a conversation with me?
examples.zh: 你恳求与我谈话的原因是什么？
