compatibility.definition: n. a feeling of sympathetic understanding\nn. capability of existing or performing in harmonious or congenial combination
compatibility.translation: n. 兼容性\n[计] 兼容性

examples.en: Availability may vary by region and device compatibility.
examples.zh: 实际提供内容可能因地区与装置相容性而异。

examples.en: The actual content provided may vary depending on the region and device compatibility.
examples.zh: 实际提供内容可能因地区与装置相容性而异。

complacency.definition: n. the feeling you have when you are satisfied with yourself
complacency.translation: n. 满足, 自鸣得意, 自满

examples.en: All economic problems would be solved, if they made complacency taxable.
His complacency won't make him many friends.
“I can't let any confidence become complacency.”

complementary.definition: s. of words or propositions so related that each is the negation of the other
complementary.translation: a. 补充的, 补足的\n[经] 补足的, 补充的

examples.en: Complementary colors are opposite one another on a color wheel.
The Yin and the Yang are complementary rather than opposite forces.
It is likely that these two consonants are in complementary distribution.

completion.definition: n. (American football) a successful forward pass in football\nn. a concluding action
completion.translation: n. 完成\n[经] 完井, 结束, 完工

examples.en: This building is near completion.
examples.zh: 这座建筑物快完工了。

complimentary.definition: a. conveying or resembling a compliment\ns. costing nothing
complimentary.translation: a. 问候的, 称赞的, 夸奖的

examples.en: First class plane flights come with complimentary alcohol.
He was very complimentary about her riding.
Yes. I'm pretty sure there are complimentary tickets that haven't been used somewhere.

composer.definition: n. someone who composes music as a profession
composer.translation: n. 作曲家, 作家, 调停者

examples.en: Who is the greatest composer of all time?
examples.zh: 谁是有史以来最伟大的作曲家？

examples.en: Tom said that Mozart was his favorite composer.
examples.zh: 汤姆说莫札特是他最喜欢的作曲家。

examples.en: Who's the greatest composer of all time?
examples.zh: 谁是有史以来最伟大的作曲家？

compression.definition: n. the process or result of becoming smaller or pressed together\nn. encoding information while reducing the bandwidth or bits required\nn. applying pressure
compression.translation: n. 压缩, 压紧\n[计] 压缩

examples.en: Data compression algorithms can be classified in two categories: those with data loss and those without data loss.
examples.zh: 压缩数据的算法能分为两种：一种会造成数据损失，另一种则不会。

comprise.definition: v be composed of\nv include or contain; have as a component\nv form or compose

examples.en: The committee is comprised of ten members.
examples.zh: 这委员会有 10 位成员。

examples.en: The committee comprises ten members.
examples.zh: 这委员会有 10 位成员。

examples.en: The United States comprises 50 states.
examples.zh: 美国由五十个州组成。

comrade.definition: n. a fellow member of the Communist Party

examples.en: Comrades! Let's transform Moscow into a model communist city.
examples.zh: 同志们，让我们转换莫斯科为理想的共产主义城市。

examples.en: Learn from Comrade Lei Feng.
examples.zh: 向雷锋同志学习。

conceit.definition:
n. an elaborate poetic image or a far-fetched comparison of very dissimilar things
n. a witty or ingenious turn of phrase
n. an artistic device or effect
n. the trait of being unduly vain and conceited; false pride
conceit.translation: n. 自负, 空想, 狂妄

examples.en: The world tolerates conceit from those who are successful, but not from anybody else.
examples.zh: 世界只能容忍有成就的人的自傲。

conception.definition: n. the act of becoming pregnant; fertilization of an ovum by a spermatozoon
conception.translation: n. 观念, 概念\n[医] 妊娠, 受孕; 概念

examples.en: His species has three sexes, and conception requires all three.
According to Judaism, life begins at birth and not at conception.
Tom had no conception of what fatherhood entailed.

concerted.definition: s. involving the joint activity of two or more
concerted.translation: a. 商定的, 协定的, 一致的\n[法] 一致的, 协力的, 共同的

examples.en: Concerted action by a pair of bishops can decide a match.
A concerted effort is required to eradicate malaria in the country.
All the neighbours made a concerted effort to clean up the park.

concurrent.definition: s occurring or operating at the same time
concurrent.translation: n. 同时发生的事件\na. 同时发生的, 一致的\n[计] 并行的; 并发的; 同时发生的; 共行的

examples.en: Are increases in life expectancy accompanied by a concurrent postponement of disability and functional limitations?
Sami is also serving a concurrent sentence of 60 years for attempting to kill Layla's infant daughter.

conditioner.definition: n. exercise that conditions the body\nn. a trainer of athletes\nn. a substance used in washing (clothing or hair) to make things softer
conditioner.translation: n. 调节器, 土壤团粒结构促进剂\n[计] 调节器, 整形器

examples.en: I want a compact car with an air conditioner.
examples.zh: 我想要一辆有空调的小型车。

examples.en: The air conditioner has got out of order.
examples.zh: 空调坏了。

examples.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
examples.zh: 实验室里的空调坏了。

conducive.definition: s. tending to bring about; being partly responsible for
conducive.translation: a. 有益于...的, 有助于...的, 助长的

examples.en: When cowardice is conducive to self-preservation, it is called intelligence.
Your behavior is not conducive to the desired environment.
Soft music is often conducive to sleep.

confederate.definition:
n. a supporter of the Confederate States of America
n. someone who assists in a plot
v. form a confederation with; of nations
s. of or having to do with the southern Confederacy during the American Civil War
confederate.translation: n. 同盟者, 同盟国\na. 同盟的, 联合的\nv. (使)联盟, (使)联合

examples.en: I think that the Confederate Flag is a racist symbol.
General Lee and the Confederate Army lost the great battle.
I don't want any Confederate flag in my town.

confide.definition: v. reveal in private; tell confidentially
confide.translation: vt. 吐露, 委托\nvi. 信赖

examples.en: Tom confided in his friend that he was going to hang himself.
examples.zh: 汤姆向他的朋友吐露他要上吊自杀。

examples.en: I congratulate you on your engagement.
examples.zh: 我为你的订婚祝贺。

examples.en: I should congratulate you.
examples.zh: 我要恭喜你。

examples.en: He congratulated me on my success.
examples.zh: 他为我的成功恭贺我。

congratulation.definition: n. the act of acknowledging that someone has an occasion for celebration\nn. (usually plural) an expression of pleasure at the success or good fortune of another

examples.en: I wired him a message of congratulation on his graduation.
It made me nervous when I was asked by the host to offer some words of congratulation.

congratulatory.definition: s. expressive of sympathetic pleasure or joy on account of someone's success or good fortune
congratulatory.translation: a. 庆祝的, 祝贺的

examples.en: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
examples.zh: 当计数器的数值达到预设的「幸运号码」时，就会显示一则恭喜讯息。

congregate.definition: v. come together, usually for a purpose
congregate.translation: v. (使)集合, (使)聚集\na. 集合在一起的, 集体的

examples.en: In the winter the elk congregate on the golf course.
A pub is a place where people congregate to drink beer.
Lions are pack animals and congregate in prides.

connotation.definition: n. an idea that is implied or suggested

examples.en: Pitbulls often get this connotation of being the dangerous dogs.
For most Americans, "Allahu akbar" fails of the crucial connotation: "And you're not."
This word has a negative connotation.

conqueror.definition: n. someone who is victorious by force of arms
conqueror.translation: n. 征服者, 胜利者

examples.en: Mehmed the Conqueror conquered Istanbul in 1453, when he was 21 years old.
Why would I want to be a conqueror?
In love's war, he who flies is conqueror.

consequent.definition: s following or accompanying as a consequence
consequent.translation: n. 随后发生的事情, 结果\na. 作为结果的, 合乎逻辑的

examples.en: Affirming the consequent is an example of a formal logical fallacy.
Consequent conduct is specified.

considerate.definition: a. showing concern for the rights and feelings of others
considerate.translation: a. 体贴的, 体谅的, 考虑周到的

examples.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.
examples.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。

examples.en: You are so considerate.
examples.zh: 你真体贴。

consistency.definition:
n. the property of holding together and retaining its shape
n. a harmonious uniformity or agreement among things or parts
n. logical coherence and accordance with the facts
n. (logic) an attribute of a logical system that is so constituted that none of the propositions deducible from the axioms contradict one another
consistency.translation: n. 坚硬性, 黏稠度, 一致性\n[化] 稠度; 一致性

examples.en: I'm so busy running about year in, year out. My life has no consistency.
examples.zh: 长年累月东奔西走忙死了，生活太没有规律了。

conspire.definition: v. engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together\nv. act in unison or agreement and in secret towards a deceitful or illegal purpose
conspire.translation: vi. 阴谋, 协力, 共谋\nvt. 图谋

examples.en: Sami and Layla were trying to conspire against Farid.
The world has sworn to conspire against me.
What makes you think that everyone is conspiring against you?

constraint.definition: n. the state of being physically constrained\nn. the act of constraining; the threat or use of force to control the thoughts or behavior of others
constraint.translation: n. 强制, 约束\n[计] 约束

examples.en: Following the rules was a constraint on my creativity.
I think I've showed considerable constraint under the circumstances.
The cost of electricity is a chief constraint for Senegal's development.

consulate.definition: n. diplomatic building that serves as the residence or workplace of a consul
consulate.translation: n. 领事, 领事任期, 领事馆\n[经] 领事馆

examples.en: In France did you work at the embassy or in the consulate?
examples.zh: 在法国，你在大使馆工作还是领事馆？

consultative.translation: a. 商议的, 协议的, 咨询的\n[法] 咨询的, 商议的, 协议的

examples.en: The abbreviation of "Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference" is "CPPCC".
examples.zh: “中国人民政治协商会议”的简称是“人民政协”。

contented.definition: a. satisfied or showing satisfaction with things as they are
contented.translation: a. 满足的, 心安的

examples.en: Happy is the man who is contented.
examples.zh: 知足常乐。

examples.en: Despite his riches, he's not contented.
examples.zh: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。

contention.definition: n. a point asserted as part of an argument
contention.translation: n. 争论, 争辩, 所持的论点\n[计] 争用

examples.en: Spread the table, and contention will cease.
The division of the property was a bone of contention between the brothers.
However there are still many points of contention, which could sidetrack a deal before a self-imposed January deadline.

contestant.definition: n. a person who participates in competitions
contestant.translation: n. 竞争者\n[法] 争辩者, 竞争者

examples.en: Linda is one of the contestants in the pageant.
examples.zh: 琳达是大会的参赛者之一。

contingent.definition:
n. a gathering of persons representative of some larger group
n. a temporary military unit
s. possible but not certain to occur
s. determined by conditions or circumstances that follow
contingent.translation: a. 或许发生的, 附随的, 偶然发生的\nn. 偶然事件, 分遣队

examples.en: Our departure tomorrow is contingent on fair weather.
His success is contingent upon his efforts.

contraction.definition: n. (physiology) a shortening or tensing of a part or organ (especially of a muscle or muscle fiber)\nn. a word formed from two or more words by omitting or combining some sounds\nn. the act of decreasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope
contraction.translation: n. 收缩, 缩写式, 害病\n[医] 收缩; 挛缩; 牙弓内缩

examples.en: I used to think "shalt" was a contraction of "shall not."
"Can't" is a contraction of "can" and "not."
What am I but a microscopic and temporary contraction of Infinite Space?

contradictory.definition: n. two propositions are contradictories if both cannot be true (or both cannot be false) at the same time\ns. of words or propositions so related that both cannot be true and both cannot be false\ns. unable to be both true at the same time
contradictory.translation: a. 反驳的, 反对的, 抗辩的\nn. 矛盾因素, 对立物

examples.en: The president has voiced a wide range of often contradictory views.
This will almost certainly have contradictory consequences and effects.
The Khmer Rouge often used parables to justify their contradictory actions.

contributor.definition: n. a writer whose work is published in a newspaper or magazine or as part of a book
contributor.translation: n. 贡献者, 捐助者, 赠送者, 投稿者\n[法] 捐助人, 捐赠人, 投搞人

examples.en: The more contributors there are, the more useful Tatoeba will become!
examples.zh: 做贡献的人越多，Tatoeba就越有用！

examples.en: Sentences past this ID are sentences added by contributors of Tatoeba Project.
examples.zh: 过去这个ID的句子是被Tatoeba计划的贡献者所添加的。

contrive.definition: v make or work out a plan for; devise\nv come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort\nv put or send forth
contrive.translation: v. 发明, 设计, 图谋

examples.en: He doesn’t know what causes it, but just wait. He’ll contrive an explanation.

convene.translation: vt. 集合, 召集, 召唤\nvi. 聚集, 集合

examples.en: They convene every evening at the library.
I shan't go to the meeting Tom convened.
The students convened in front of the school.

convincing.definition: a. causing one to believe the truth of something
convincing.translation: a. 使人信服的, 有力的, 令人心悦诚服的

examples.en: He is convincing.
examples.zh: 他很有说服力。

convoy.definition:
n. a procession of land vehicles traveling together
n. a collection of merchant ships with an escort of warships
n. the act of escorting while in transit
v. escort in transit
convoy.translation: n. 护送, 护卫\nvt. 护航, 护送

examples.en: We need to arrange an ambush and destroy the convoy.
The convoy of army trucks was blocking the road.
We got ourselves a convoy.
His cordiality may not be authentic.
He greeted her with cordiality.

corrosion.definition: n. a state of deterioration in metals caused by oxidation or chemical action\nn. erosion by chemical action
corrosion.translation: n. 腐蚀, 侵蚀, 腐蚀产生的物质, 铁锈, 锈\n[计] 腐蚀

examples.en: She noticed rust and corrosion in the pipes under her kitchen sink.
There was corrosion around the battery terminals.
During an annual inspection, the aviation mechanic discovered corrosion in the wing spar.

councilor.definition: n. A member of a council.
councilor.translation: n. 地方议会成员, 议会委员, 顾问, 评议员, 参赞

examples.en: The councilor tabled a number of controversial motions.

counteract.definition: v. oppose and mitigate the effects of by contrary actions
counteract.translation: vt. 抵消, 阻碍, 中和\n[法] 抵抗, 阻碍, 抵销

examples.en: To counteract calcification, do mental gymnastics at Tatoeba.
Reality and dreams counteract each other.
Intellect is no great help in counteracting feelings of guilt, which originate in the heart.

counteraction.definition: n action intended to nullify the effects of some previous action
counteraction.translation: n. 抵消, 反作用, 中和\n[医] 对抗作用

cowardice.definition: n. the trait of lacking courage

examples.en: When cowardice is conducive to self-preservation, it is called intelligence.
It was actually his cowardice that saved his life.
A lot of people think that was cowardice.

cowboy.definition: n. a hired hand who tends cattle and performs other duties on horseback\nn. a performer who gives exhibitions of riding and roping and bulldogging\nn. someone who is reckless or irresponsible (especially in driving vehicles)
cowboy.translation: n. 牛仔, 牛郎, 牧童

examples.en: Tom was wearing a cowboy hat when I saw him.
Did you see the cowboy film on TV last night?
Mary was wearing a cowboy hat when I saw her.

crackdown.translation: n. 制裁, 镇压, 痛击

examples.en: The government is expelling illegal aliens as part of a crackdown.
The police began a crackdown on illegal parking.

cracker.definition: n. a thin crisp wafer made of flour and water with or without leavening and shortening; unsweetened or semisweet\nn. a programmer who cracks (gains unauthorized access to) computers, typically to do malicious things\nn. a party favor consisting of a paper roll (usually containing candy or a small favor) that pops when pulled at both ends
cracker.translation: n. 饼干, 爆竹\n[计] 破袭者

examples.en: The cracker contains only a gram of fat.
I wouldn't throw him out of bed for eating crackers.
You're being one crabby cracker this morning. Did you get enough sleep?

cram.definition: v. put something somewhere so that the space is completely filled\nv. study intensively, as before an exam\nv. prepare (students) hastily for an impending exam
cram.translation: vt. 塞满, 填满, 猛吃\nvi. 贪吃\nn. 极度拥挤, 死记硬背

examples.en: I work at a cram school.
examples.zh: 我在补习班工作。

examples.en: He spent all night cramming for the test.
examples.zh: 他通宵备考。

crate.definition: n. a rugged box (usually made of wood); used for shipping\nn. the quantity contained in a crate\nv. put into a crate; as for protection
crate.translation: n. 板条箱, 装货箱\n[建] 篓, 筐

examples.en: I suppose you'll need a crowbar to open that crate.
I do not know what is in the crate.
I do not know the contents of the crate.

craze.definition: n. state of violent mental agitation\nn. a fine crack in a glaze or other surface\nv. develop a fine network of cracks
craze.translation: n. 狂热, 大流行\nv. (使)发狂, (使)开裂

examples.en: I am still keeping up my tennis craze.
examples.zh: 我仍然热爱着网球运动。

examples.en: She follows the latest craze.
examples.zh: 她对当下的流行很敏感。

credibility.definition: n. the quality of being believable or trustworthy
credibility.translation: n. 可信用, 确实性, 可靠\n[法] 证据能力, 可信程度, 确实性

examples.en: This will erode our credibility.
examples.zh: 这会损害我们的信誉。

examples.en: Tom lost his credibility.
examples.zh: 汤姆失去了信誉。

credible.definition: a. capable of being believed\ns. (a common but incorrect usage where `credulous' would be appropriate) credulous\ns. appearing to merit belief or acceptance
credible.translation: a. 可信的, 可靠的\n[法] 可信的, 可靠的

examples.en: If you want to be credible, tell people only what they believe.
examples.zh: 如果你想使他人相信你的话，那就只说他已经相信的东西吧。

creep.definition:
n. someone unpleasantly strange or eccentric
n. a slow longitudinal movement or deformation
n. a pen that is fenced so that young animals can enter but adults cannot
v. grow or spread, often in such a way as to cover (a surface)
creep.translation: n. 爬, 徐行, 蠕动\nvi. 爬, 蔓延, 潜行

examples.en: Sometimes it's fun to creep yourself out thinking about it.
examples.zh: 偶尔偷偷地去想这个问题，还是很有意思的。

examples.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
examples.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。

cripple.definition: n. someone who is unable to walk normally because of an injury or disability to the legs or back\nv. deprive of strength or efficiency; make useless or worthless\nv. deprive of the use of a limb, especially a leg
cripple.translation: n. 跛者, 残废\nvt. 使跛, 使成残废, 削弱\na. 跛的, 残废的

examples.en: Mama had a crippled face.
examples.zh: 妈妈有一张残缺的脸。

cruelty.definition: n. a cruel act; a deliberate infliction of pain and suffering\nn. feelings of extreme heartlessness\nn. the quality of being cruel and causing tension or annoyance
cruelty.translation: n. 残酷, 野蛮, 残酷行为\n[法] 残酷, 残忍, 虐待

examples.en: Cruelty in young people is fostered by violent movies and PC games.
examples.zh: 暴力电影和电脑游戏助长了年轻人的残暴行为。

examples.en: I cannot abide to see such cruelty.
examples.zh: 我不忍目睹这种残酷的行径。

examples.en: He was treated with great cruelty.
examples.zh: 他受到严重的虐待。

crumble.definition: v. fall apart\nv. break or fall apart into fragments
crumble.translation: v. (使)粉碎, (使)成为碎屑, 瓦解, 崩溃, 败落

examples.en: Algeria isn't going to crumble.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚不会崩溃。

examples.en: Algeria will not crumble.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚不会崩溃。

crunch.definition:
n. the sound of something crunching
n. a critical situation that arises because of a shortage (as a shortage of time or money or resources)
v. make a crushing noise
v. press or grind with a crushing noise
crunch.translation: v. 嘎吱嘎吱的咬嚼, 压碎, 嘎吱嘎吱地踏过\nn. 咬碎, 咬碎声

examples.en: When it came to the crunch she just gave in.
I'm hungry so I'll go and crunch on some ice.
Ziri heard a crunch of leaves in the vicinity.

cue.definition: n. an actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech\nn. sports implement consisting of a tapering rod used to strike a cue ball in pool or billiards
cue.translation: n. 提示, 线索\nvt. 给...暗示(或提示)\n[计] 尾接指令

examples.en: Damiano's loud argument with Isabella was John's cue to leave.
You can't play pool without a cue stick.
A set of quality pool cues can be pretty expensive.

culminate.definition:
v. end, especially to reach a final or climactic stage
v. bring to a head or to the highest point
v. reach the highest or most decisive point
v. reach the highest altitude or the meridian, of a celestial body
culminate.translation: vi. 到绝顶, 达于极点, 达到高潮\nvt. 使到绝顶, 使达到高潮

examples.en: I hope this year will culminate in something good.
I find striptease frustrating, as it doesn't often culminate in actual sex.
I don't think it'll culminate in forgiveness.

culmination.definition: n. (astronomy) a heavenly body's highest celestial point above an observer's horizon
culmination.translation: n. 顶点, 高潮, 最高点

examples.en: This project is the culmination of a lifetime of work.
This is the culmination of years of work.
This is the culmination of a long journey.

cumulative.translation: a. 累积的\n[医] 蓄积的, 累积的

examples.en: Lost sleep has a cumulative effect, I've been told.
The graph shows the cumulative interest as a function of time.

curable.definition: a. curing or healing is possible\ns. capable of being hardened by some additive or other agent
curable.translation: a. 可医治的, 医得好的\n[医] 可愈的, 能治愈的

examples.en: Love has been described as an affection curable by marriage.
All the past endures because it is not curable.
Love is a temporary insanity curable by marriage.

curfew.definition: n. the time that the curfew signal is sounded\nn. a signal (usually a bell) announcing the start of curfew restrictions\nn. an order that after a specific time certain activities (as being outside on the streets) are prohibited
curfew.translation: n. 晚钟, 打晚钟时刻, 宵禁\n[法] 宵禁, 宵禁令

examples.en: There is a curfew in effect from dusk to dawn.
He was given a detention for being out after curfew.
The curfew is in effect until 6:00 in the morning.

curtail.definition: v place restrictions on\nv terminate or abbreviate before its intended or proper end or its full extent
curtail.translation: vt. 缩减, 剥夺, 简略\n[法] 剥夺特权

examples.en: Netanyahu wants to severely curtail the powers of the judiciary.
Their efforts to curtail spending didn't quite succeed.
In this country, the freedom to browse the Internet is curtailed.

cyberspace.definition: n a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange

examples.en: No one says "cyberspace" anymore.
examples.zh: 现在没有人说「网际空间」了。

cynicism.definition: n. a cynical feeling of distrust

examples.en: Cynicism is just a mean way to tell the truth.
The wording of the refusal was striking in its cynicism.
Cynicism is the weapon of the weak.

carpenter.definition: n. a woodworker who makes or repairs wooden objects\nv. work as a carpenter

examples.en: The carpenter brought his tools along.
examples.zh: 木匠带了工具。

examples.en: He is a good carpenter.
examples.zh: 他是个好木匠。

examples.en: My grandfather is a carpenter.
examples.zh: 我爷爷是个木匠。

centigrade.definition: a. of or relating to a temperature scale on which the freezing point of water is 0 degrees and the boiling point of water is 100 degrees
centigrade.translation: a. 百分度的, 摄氏的\n[医] 百分度

examples.en: Water freezes at 0 degrees Centigrade.
examples.zh: 水在摄氏0度时结成冰。

cheque.definition: v. withdraw money by writing a check

examples.en: I haven't got any cash. Can I write a cheque?
examples.zh: 我没现金，写张支票可以吗？

examples.en: Cheques are made of paper.
examples.zh: 支票是纸做的。

examples.en: Cheques are made from paper.
examples.zh: 支票是纸做的。

civilize.definition: v. raise from a barbaric to a civilized state
civilize.translation: vt. 使开化, 使文明\nvi. 变文明

examples.en: Europeans tried to civilize the tribe.
examples.zh: 欧洲人试着去教化部落的人

examples.en: All civilized countries are against war.
examples.zh: 所有文明的国家都反对战争。

clement.definition: a. (of weather or climate) physically mild\na. (used of persons or behavior) inclined to show mercy
clement.translation: a. 仁慈的, 宽厚的, 温和的

examples.en: Clement Atlee was elected prime minister in 1945.
Though autumn gales are less clement than summer zephyrs, they are more exciting.
Be a little more clement!

cocaine.definition: n. a narcotic (alkaloid) extracted from coca leaves; used as a surface anesthetic or taken for pleasure; can become powerfully addictive
cocaine.translation: n. 可卡因, 古柯碱\n[化] 可卡因; 古柯碱

examples.en: Did you know that Tom and Mary were using cocaine?
I didn't know that Tom was a cocaine addict.
I thought it might be cocaine, but it was only flour.

coercive.definition: s. serving or intended to coerce
coercive.translation: a. 强制的, 强压的, 强迫的\n[法] 强制的, 强迫的, 强行的

examples.en: The police used coercive techniques when questioning suspects.
Consent can't exist in coercive situations.

collage.definition: n. a paste-up made by sticking together pieces of paper or photographs to form an artistic image\nn. any collection of diverse things

examples.en: I glued the last piece of my collage with success.
Tom submitted a collage poem drawn from various medical journals.
Your mother put your collage in the top drawer.

concerned.definition: a. feeling or showing worry or solicitude\ns. involved in or affected by or having a claim to or share in
concerned.translation: a. 关心的, 有关的, 参与的, 担心的

examples.en: As far as English is concerned, nobody can beat me.
examples.zh: 在英语能力方面，没有人能比我好。

examples.en: As far as I'm concerned, this coffee is too strong.
examples.zh: 这咖啡对我来说太浓了。

examples.en: As far as I'm concerned, English is not easy.
examples.zh: 英语对我来说并不容易。

constituent.definition: n. a member of a constituency; a citizen who is represented in a government by officials for whom he or she votes\nn. (grammar) a word or phrase or clause forming part of a larger grammatical construction\ns. constitutional in the structure of something (especially your physical makeup)
constituent.translation: n. 成分, 选民, 构成物\na. 构成的, 组织的, 选举的

examples.en: What are the constituents of a gin and tonic?
When the scandal broke, the Congressman's constituents were seething.
The legislator talked at length with his constituents about beach erosion.

cordial.definition: s. politely warm and friendly\ns. sincerely or intensely felt
cordial.translation: n. 兴奋剂, 补品\na. 热忱的, 诚恳的, 有兴奋作用的

examples.en: I was pleased no end by the cordial welcome.
William's relationship with his boss is professional but cordial.
Tom is just as cordial as I am.

cosmetics.definition: n a toiletry designed to beautify the body
cosmetics.translation: n. 装饰品；化妆品（cosmetic的复数）

examples.en: There is nothing wrong with boys wearing cosmetics.
examples.zh: 男孩化粧没有甚么问题。

cricket.definition: n. leaping insect; male makes chirping noises by rubbing the forewings together\nn. a game played with a ball and bat by two teams of 11 players; teams take turns trying to score runs\nv. play cricket

examples.en: A caged cricket eats just as much as a free cricket.
examples.zh: 笼子里的蟋蟀吃得跟野生的蟋蟀一样多。

examples.en: My uncle is an amateur cricket player.
examples.zh: 我的舅舅爱好打板球。

examples.en: That's not a cricket, that's a grasshopper.
examples.zh: 那不是蟋蟀。是蚂蚱！

crown.definition:
n. the Crown (or the reigning monarch) as the symbol of the power and authority of a monarchy
n. the part of a tooth above the gum that is covered with enamel
n. a wreath or garland worn on the head to signify victory
n. an ornamental jeweled headdress signifying sovereignty
crown.translation: n. 王冠, 王权, 顶点\nvt. 使成王, 加冕, 居...之顶

examples.en: The crown is adorned with dozens of divinely lustrous gemstones.
examples.zh: 王冠上镶嵌著数十颗光彩夺目的宝石。

examples.en: The Queen's crown was made of gold.
examples.zh: 皇后的后冠是用黄金铸成的。

examples.en: The girl in the picture is wearing a crown not of gold but of flowers.
examples.zh: 画中的女孩头上戴著的是花冠，不是金皇冠。

cafeteria.definition: n. a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
cafeteria.translation: n. 自助餐厅\n[经] 自助餐厅

examples.en: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
examples.zh: 餐厅的饭菜很便宜，而且很好吃。

examples.en: I'd like to work at the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 我想在餐厅工作。

examples.en: A cafeteria is a self-service style restaurant.
examples.zh: 自助餐厅是一种自助式的餐厅。

calculator.definition: n. an expert at calculation (or at operating calculating machines)\nn. a small machine that is used for mathematical calculations
calculator.translation: n. 计算者, 计算器\n[计] 计算器

examples.en: The calculator on the table is mine.
examples.zh: 桌上的计算器是我的。

examples.en: The batteries in my calculator are dead.
examples.zh: 我计算机的电池没电了。

calibration.definition: n. the act of checking or adjusting (by comparison with a standard) the accuracy of a measuring instrument
calibration.translation: n. 口径测定, 刻度, 校准\n[化] 校准

canteen.definition:
n. a flask for carrying water; used by soldiers or travelers
n. sells food and personal items to personnel at an institution or school or camp etc.
n. a restaurant outside; often for soldiers or policemen
n. a recreation room in an institution
canteen.translation: n. 水壶, 军中俱乐部, 临时流动餐馆, 小卖部

examples.en: I ate in the canteen.
examples.zh: 我是在食堂吃的饭。

examples.en: Is the canteen open yet?
examples.zh: 食堂开了吗？

examples.en: Which way is the canteen?
examples.zh: 食堂怎么走？

capacitance.definition: n. an electrical phenomenon whereby an electric charge is stored

examples.en: How does one calculate the capacitance of a capacitor?

capacitor.definition: n. an electrical device characterized by its capacity to store an electric charge
capacitor.translation: n. 电容器\n[化] 电容器

examples.en: How does one calculate the capacitance of a capacitor?
A capacitor allows current to flow through empty space.
Tom accidentally broke off a capacitor on his motherboard.

cassette.definition: n. a container that holds a magnetic tape used for recording or playing sound or video
cassette.translation: n. 盒式磁带, 珠宝箱, 暗盒\n[计] 字盒

examples.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
examples.zh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

catalogue.definition: v. make an itemized list or catalog of; classify\nv. make a catalogue, compile a catalogue
catalogue.translation: n. 目录, 大学情况一览\nvt. 编入目录

examples.en: Brahe catalogued over 1000 stars.
examples.zh: 布拉赫为一千多颗恒星做了编目。

catholic.definition: n. a member of a Catholic church\na. of or relating to or supporting Catholicism\ns. free from provincial prejudices or attachments
catholic.translation: n. 天主教徒\na. 天主教的, 普遍的, 广泛的, 宽宏大量的

examples.en: The Catholic Church doesn't condone the use of condoms.
examples.zh: 天主教廷不同意避孕套的使用。

examples.en: The Catholic Church is opposed to divorce.
examples.zh: 天主教教会反对离婚。

examples.en: In Colombia, Catholic customs prevail.
examples.zh: 在哥伦比亚，天主教习俗盛行。

causal.definition: s. involving or constituting a cause; causing
causal.translation: a. 原因的, 因果关系的, 表示原因或理由的\nn. 表示原因的连词

examples.en: Is there a causal relationship?
examples.zh: 有因果关系吗？

cent.definition: n. a fractional monetary unit of several countries

examples.en: Fifty-two per cent of British women prefer chocolate to sex.
examples.zh: 有百分之五十二的英国女性喜欢巧克力胜于性。

examples.en: These cardboard boxes are a hundred per cent recyclable.
examples.zh: 这些纸板盒是百分之百可回收的。

examples.en: You gave me only fifty cents.
examples.zh: 你只给了我五十美分。

centimetre.definition: n a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter

examples.en: I am around 190 centimetres tall.
examples.zh: 我1米9几。

centralize.translation: vt. 集聚, 集中, 施行中央集权\nvi. 集中

examples.en: Algeria needs to get rid of its centralized bureaucracy.
Your money is like a ghost, living in a centralized computer.
Although Algeria is a big country, it has a centralized system.

centre.definition: n. a low-lying region in central France
centre.translation:
n. 中心, 中心点, 中锋
a. 中央的, 位在正中的
vt. 集中, 定中心
vi. 居中

examples.en: She rented a flat close the to the city centre.
examples.zh: 她在离市中心不远处租了间公寓。

examples.en: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
examples.zh: 抱歉，地铁几号线去市中心？

examples.en: Employees of the call centre answer all customer service calls.
examples.zh: 呼叫中心的员工负责接听所有客服电话。

certainty.definition: n. the state of being certain\nn. something that is certain
certainty.translation: n. 确定, 确实的事情\n[法] 确定, 肯定, 必然的事

examples.en: I can say with certainty that he hates me.
examples.zh: 我能确定地说他恨我。

chasm.definition: n. a deep opening in the earth's surface

examples.en: The chasm is twenty feet wide and very deep.
He's standing on the edge of the chasm.
This silence feels like a chasm between us.

chatter.definition:
n. the rapid series of noises made by the parts of a machine
n. the high-pitched continuing noise made by animals (birds or monkeys)
v. click repeatedly or uncontrollably
v. cut unevenly with a chattering tool
chatter.translation: n. 饶舌, 啁啾, 喋喋不休\nvi. 喋喋不休地谈, (鸟)啭鸣

examples.en: Don't chatter! I have to study.
examples.zh: 别唠叨！我需要学习。

examples.en: You can't chatter during class.
examples.zh: 上课时不能闲聊。

chemist.definition: n. a scientist who specializes in chemistry
chemist.translation: n. 化学家, 药剂师\n[化] 化学家; 化学师; 化学工作者; 药剂师; 药房

examples.en: The young chemist decided to open a pharmacy.
examples.zh: 年轻的药剂师决定要开一家药房。

examples.en: Johnny was a chemist; now Johnny is no more. For what he thought was water, was H2SO4.
examples.zh: Johny以前是个化学家，但现在Johny不再是了。他以前所想的是水，是硫酸。

chestnut.definition:
n. wood of any of various chestnut trees of the genus Castanea
n. any of several attractive deciduous trees yellow-brown in autumn; yield a hard wood and edible nuts in a prickly bur
n. edible nut of any of various chestnut trees of the genus Castanea
n. the brown color of chestnuts
chestnut.translation: n. 栗子, 栗树, 栗色\na. 栗色的

examples.en: Chestnuts have to be boiled for at least fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 栗子至少要煮15分钟。

examples.en: Boil chestnuts for at least 15 minutes.
examples.zh: 栗子至少要煮15分钟。

cigaret.definition: n finely ground tobacco wrapped in paper; for smoking
cigaret.translation: n. 纸烟, 卷烟, 香烟

examples.en: You have to put out the cigaret.
He arose and, going to a table, secured a tobacco pouch and a book of cigaret papers.

classmate.definition: n an acquaintance that you go to school with

examples.en: Today, my classmate saw you guys shopping at Auchan.
examples.zh: 今天我同学看到你们在欧尚买东西。

examples.en: He is on goods terms with all of his classmates.
examples.zh: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。

examples.en: Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?
examples.zh: 你还和你的高中同学保持联系吗？

cleanliness.definition: n. the habit of keeping free of superficial imperfections\nn. diligence in keeping clean

examples.en: Algiers should become a model of order and cleanliness.
Teach other family members the importance of sink cleanliness.
He is obsessed with cleanliness and spends hours cleaning his apartment.

clearly.definition: r. without doubt or question\nr. in an easily perceptible manner

examples.en: Look at this table; it has been written out clearly.
examples.zh: 你看这张表吧，上面已经写清楚了。

examples.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
examples.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

examples.en: Before understanding the situation clearly, he hastily gave his opinion.
examples.zh: 他还没有把情况了解清楚就急忙发表意见。

closely.definition: r. in a close relation or position in time or space\nr. in a close manner

examples.en: We observed this plant closely for a few weeks.
examples.zh: 我们密切地关注这家工厂几个星期了.

examples.en: If you listen closely enough you'll be able to hear it.
examples.zh: 靠近一点听，你就会听到了。

examples.en: We need to study the cause and effect of the accident closely.
examples.zh: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。

clown.definition: n. a rude or vulgar fool\nn. a person who amuses others by ridiculous behavior\nv. act as or like a clown

examples.en: The clown made a funny face.
examples.zh: 小丑做了个鬼脸。

examples.en: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
examples.zh: 他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。

coastal.definition: a. of or relating to a coast\na. located on or near or bordering on a coast
coastal.translation: a. 海岸的, 沿海的, 沿岸的\n[法] 海岸的, 沿海的

examples.en: Chinese coastal cities are generally more developed than the inland ones.
examples.zh: 中国大陆的沿海城市普遍比内陆城市发达。

cock.definition:
n. obscene terms for penis
n. adult male chicken
n. adult male bird
v. tilt or slant to one side
cock.translation: n. 公鸡, 雄禽, 龙头, 头目, 锥形小干草堆\nvt. 使耸立, 使竖起, 堆成锥形小干草堆\nvi. 大摇大摆地走, 翘起

examples.en: I don't like using dildos, I prefer real cocks.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢假阳具，我更偏爱真的𣬠𣬶。

examples.en: I've got a big cock!
examples.zh: 我的鸡巴很大！

coefficient.definition: n. a constant number that serves as a measure of some property or characteristic

examples.en: How do you solve for the coefficient of a fraction?
The quadratic coefficient in this term is questionable.
We assessed reliability using the Cronbach's alpha coefficient and validity using the correlation analysis.

colonist.definition: n a person who settles in a new colony or moves into new country
colonist.translation: n. 殖民地居民, 移民

examples.en: This outfit was typical of a colonist at that time.
The criminal actions of the colonists must be denounced.
The first American colonists arrived in the 17th century.

comb.definition:
n. a flat device with narrow pointed teeth on one edge; disentangles or arranges hair
n. the fleshy red crest on the head of the domestic fowl and other gallinaceous birds
n. any of several tools for straightening fibers
n. ciliated comb-like swimming plate of a ctenophore
comb.translation: n. 头梳, 鸡冠\nvt. 梳头发, 梳毛\nvi. (浪)涌起

examples.en: She put the comb in the drawer.
examples.zh: 她把梳子放在抽屉里面。

examples.en: Comb your hair before you go out.
examples.zh: 在你出门之前，把你的头发梳一梳。

examples.en: Where is my comb?
examples.zh: 我的梳子在哪里呢？

combustion.definition: n. a process in which a substance reacts with oxygen to give heat and light\nn. a state of violent disturbance and excitement
combustion.translation: n. 燃烧, 骚动\n[化] 燃烧

examples.en: Internal combustion engines burn a mixture of fuel and air.
People say that if you're angry enough, you'll achieve spontaneous combustion.
This is a building used for combustion testing.

commonly.translation: adv. 一般, 普通, 通常

examples.en: Standard Chinese, commonly referred to as Mandarin, is based on Pekinese.
examples.zh: 中文的标准语，也就是人们常说的普通话，以北京口音为基础。

examples.en: Celebrating Spring Festival is commonly referred to as 'passing the year'.
examples.zh: 庆祝春节俗称过年。

examples.en: Sodium bicarbonate is commonly known as baking soda.
examples.zh: 碳酸氢钠通常被称为小苏打。

commonsense.translation: a. 有常识的, 一望而知的, 明明白白的

examples.en: Though commonsense is necessary for everyone, it is not always easily acquired.

communism.definition: n. a form of socialism that abolishes private ownership\nn. a political theory favoring collectivism in a classless society

examples.en: The American mission is to eliminate communism from the world.
examples.zh: 美国的任务是将共产主义从世界上消除。

examples.en: Communism is the system practiced in the Soviet Union.
examples.zh: 共产主义是在苏联被实行的制度。

examples.en: Communism will never be reached in my lifetime.
examples.zh: 在我有生之年，共产主义不可能达到。

comparatively.definition: r in a relative manner; by comparison to something else
comparatively.translation: adv. 比较地, 相对地

examples.en: The extent of damage in those areas is comparatively less.
The sales figures for this book are still comparatively low.
There's a comparatively large cinema complex inside the mall.

compatriot.definition: n. a person from your own country
compatriot.translation: n. 同国人\na. 同国的, 同胞的

examples.en: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.
examples.zh: 他不愿意为同胞作证。

completely.definition: r. so as to be complete; with everything necessary
completely.translation: adv. 完全地, 十分地, 圆满地

examples.en: No two rivers in the world are completely the same.
examples.zh: 世界上没有两条完全相同的河流。

examples.en: The path through the forest was completely covered in snow.
examples.zh: 山林小道被雪完全覆盖住了。

examples.en: Tom worked all day and was completely worn out.
examples.zh: Tom工作了一天，感到筋疲力尽。

concentrated.definition: a. gathered together or made less diffuse\ns. of or relating to a solution whose dilution has been reduced\ns. intensely focused
concentrated.translation: a. 集中的, 浓缩的\n[建] 浓的

examples.en: He concentrated on his studies.
examples.zh: 他专心于学习。

confirmation.definition: n. additional proof that something that was believed (some fact or hypothesis or theory) is correct\nn. information that confirms or verifies\nn. a ceremony held in the synagogue (usually at Pentecost) to admit as adult members of the Jewish community young men and women who have successfully completed a course of study in Judaism
confirmation.translation: n. 证实, 证明, 批准, 确认\n[计] 确认

examples.en: Do not make any modifications before you get confirmations.
examples.zh: 在得到确认之前不要进行任何修改。

conformity.definition: n. correspondence in form or appearance\nn. acting according to certain accepted standards\nn. orthodoxy in thoughts and belief
conformity.translation: n. 遵照, 适合, 一致, 相似\n[计] 符合度

examples.en: Some people prefer conformity, while others seek novelty.
examples.zh: 有些人喜欢循规蹈矩，而有些人总喜欢寻求刺激。

confrontation.definition:
n. a bold challenge
n. discord resulting from a clash of ideas or opinions
n. a hostile disagreement face-to-face
n. the act of hostile groups opposing each other

examples.en: Everybody knows that Cold War is the confrontation between two nations.
examples.zh: 是人都知道冷战是两国的对峙。

congest.definition: v become or cause to become obstructed
congest.translation: vt. 使充满, 使拥塞, 使充血\nvi. 充塞, 充血, 拥挤

examples.en: Algiers' streets are getting congested.
examples.zh: 阿尔及尔的街道越来越堵塞了。

consistently.definition: r in a systematic or consistent manner
consistently.translation: adv. 坚固, 坚实, 一致, 始终如一, 连贯\n[计] 相容地

examples.en: However, apart from Buddhists, hardly anyone can consistently follow this principle.
examples.zh: 不过，除了佛教者以外，没有任何人可以一直遵循这个原则。

consultancy.definition: n. the practice of giving expert advice within a particular field
consultancy.translation: n. 商量, 协商, 磋商, 会诊, 与...商量, 咨询, 请教, 找(医生)看病, 查阅, 考虑\n[经] 咨询业务, 咨询服务

examples.en: Mary works at a prestigious consultancy firm.
“Vietnam is emerging as a key player in Southeast Asia’s medical tourism industry,” the consultancy says.

contamination.definition: n. the state of being contaminated\nn. the act of contaminating or polluting; including (either intentionally or accidentally) unwanted substances or factors
contamination.translation: n. 污染, 污物\n[化] 污染; 沾污

examples.en: People are suffering from the contamination of the water supply.
Make sure you seal food properly to avoid contamination.
It is essential to prevent salmonella contamination in hen egg production.

contrived.definition: s. showing effects of planning or manipulation
contrived.translation: a. 人造的, 勉强的, 不自然的

examples.en: He contrived a means of speaking to Nancy privately.
examples.zh: 他用了一些手段来和Nancy私下交谈。

conversely.definition: r. with the terms of the relation reversed
conversely.translation: adv. 相反, 逆, 颠倒, 反题, 反

examples.en: 2ch, where there are many posts praising specific companies, or, conversely, denigrating their rivals.
Conversely, hard-pressed refugees talk of discrimination, exploitation by landlords and even greater abuses flowing from local resentment.

cooperative.definition: n. a jointly owned commercial enterprise (usually organized by farmers or consumers) that produces and distributes goods and services and is run for the benefit of its owners\nn. an association formed and operated for the benefit of those using it\na. done with or working with others for a common purpose or benefit

examples.en: I try to be cooperative.
examples.zh: 我尽量保持合作。

examples.en: Tom has been quite cooperative.
examples.zh: 汤姆很合作。

correction.definition:
n. the act of offering an improvement to replace a mistake; setting right
n. a quantity that is added or subtracted in order to increase the accuracy of a scientific measure
n. something substituted for an error
n. a rebuke for making a mistake
correction.translation: n. 订正, 改正, 改正的地方\n[化] 校正

examples.en: A proper test does not allow the use of correction fluid.
examples.zh: 正规的考试不允许使用涂改液。

examples.en: My correction fluid has run out, so now I only write in pencil.
examples.zh: 我的涂改液用完了，现在写字只用铅笔。

examples.en: Thank you for the corrections.
examples.zh: 谢谢你的修改。

correctly.translation: adv. 对, 正确, 恰当, 符合一般性准则, 符合行为准则, 端正, 符合

examples.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
examples.zh: 检查一下用户名和密码有没有填错。

examples.en: Do you know how to correctly hold chopsticks?
examples.zh: 你知道要怎么拿筷子才是正确的吗？

examples.en: Everyone can help ensure that sentences sound correct, and are correctly spelled.
examples.zh: 每个人都可以协助确保句子念起来正确且拼写正确。

correlation.definition: n. a reciprocal relation between two or more things\nn. a statistical relation between two or more variables such that systematic changes in the value of one variable are accompanied by systematic changes in the other
correlation.translation: n. 相互关系, 相关, 关联\n[医] 相关, 联系

examples.en: Correlation does not imply causation.
examples.zh: 相关关系不导致因果关系。

counseling.definition: n something that provides direction or advice as to a decision or course of action\nv give advice to

examples.en: Tom and Mary have decided to go to marriage counseling.
Sami humbled himself down and agreed to go to counseling.
Sami and Layla were willing to go to counseling.

crank.definition:
n. a hand tool consisting of a rotating shaft with parallel handle
v. start by cranking
v. rotate with a crank
v. fasten with a crank
crank.translation:
a. 不稳的, 脾气暴燥的, 易怒的
n. 曲柄, 奇想
vt. 装曲柄
vi. 转动曲柄

examples.en: Hey! I don't want any crank calls - not at this hour.
These crank shafts are precision balanced for smooth high revving engines.
An office machine is cranking out a stream of documents.

crippling.definition: s. that cripples or disables or incapacitates
crippling.translation: (往复)曲折, 断裂, 临界的, 极限的

examples.en: The people of Gaza are living under a crippling blockade.
My fear of making another mistake is crippling my progress.
Algiers is known for its crippling traffic jams.

criteria.definition: n a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated\nn the ideal in terms of which something can be judged

examples.en: Mennad met all the criteria and passed all the tests.
Does Tom meet all the criteria for the perfect husband?
Did Tom meet the criteria for passing this class?

cubic.translation: a. 立方体的, 立方的\n[机] 立方的, 立方体的

examples.en: The actual volume of the truck is thirty cubic meters.
Volumes are usually measured in liters; cubic centimetres or meters.
Natural gas reserves amount to an estimated 155 billion cubic meters.

cuckoo.definition: n. any of numerous European and North American birds having pointed wings and a long tail\nv. repeat monotonously, like a cuckoo repeats his call
cuckoo.translation: n. 杜鹃鸟, 布谷鸟

examples.en: People call this kind of bird a cuckoo.
examples.zh: 人们把这种鸟叫做布谷鸟。

examples.en: This bird is known as a cuckoo.
examples.zh: 这种鸟被称为布谷鸟。

curative.definition: s. tending to cure or restore to health
curative.translation: a. 治病的, 有疗效的\nn. 药物, 治疗法

examples.en: The brain is the center of all curative energy.

curl.definition:
n. American chemist who with Richard Smalley and Harold Kroto discovered fullerenes and opened a new branch of chemistry (born in 1933)
v. form a curl, curve, or kink
v. twist or roll into coils or ringlets
v. play the Scottish game of curling
curl.translation: n. 拳曲, 鬈发\nvt. 弄卷\nvi. 拳曲, 弯曲

examples.en: Layla started curling her hair.
examples.zh: 莱拉开始卷头发。

examples.en: My hair curls easily.
examples.zh: 我的头发很容易打卷。

curly.definition: a. (of hair) having curls or waves
curly.translation: a. 拳曲的, 卷毛的, 弯曲的

examples.en: We're having curly kale today.
examples.zh: 我们今天吃羽衣甘蓝。

examples.en: We're eating curly kale today.
examples.zh: 我们今天吃羽衣甘蓝。

curt.definition: s marked by rude or peremptory shortness\ns brief and to the point; effectively cut short; `yes'"
curt.translation: a. 简略的, 简短的, 生硬的

examples.en: Don't you think it's rude to give people such a curt reply like that?
examples.zh: 你回答得这么简短，不觉得有点没礼貌吗？

cutter.definition:
n. someone who carves the meat
n. someone whose work is cutting (as e.g. cutting cloth for garments)
n. a sailing vessel with a single mast set further back than the mast of a sloop
n. a cutting implement; a tool for cutting
cutter.translation: n. 裁剪者, 切割者, 切割器\n[化] 刀具; 剪切机; 切刀; 切胶机

examples.en: Ziri cut the sheet metal with a plasma cutter.
Mary made some star-shaped gingerbread cookies using a star-shaped cookie cutter.
Yanni stripped the wire with a box cutter.
